paper.title: Scaling Near-Optimal SFT-RL Annotation Budget Allocation from Small to Large LLMs
paper.abstract: How to divide a fixed annotation budget between supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) during LLM post-training remains an open problem. Existing work characterizes only broad trends (e.g., SFT dominates in low-data regimes), lacks a principled allocation framework, and does not examine whether the optimal ratio transfers across model sizes. We frame this problem in terms of near-optimality: rather than seeking a single optimal SFT-RL ratio, we characterize the near-optimal

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个很实际、但过去一直缺少稳定方法的问题：在固定标注预算下，SFT 和后续 RL 阶段到底该怎么分配数据。难点不只是找一个最优比例，而是这个最优点往往不稳定，受任务、模型规模、RL 算法、评价指标影响很大；而每改一次比例，通常都要重跑整条 post-training 流水线，代价很高。作者把问题从“找唯一最优点”改写成“找近优区域”：只要某个分配能达到峰值性能的一定容忍范围内，就算可接受。核心问题因此变成：这个近优区域是否足够宽、是否随模型变大而更稳定、是否能从小模型迁移到大模型。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口研究，这篇工作的价值不在提出新的 RL 算法，而在于给出了一个可操作的预算分配框架。它把 post-training 中常见的“网格搜索找配比”问题，转成了“先用小代理模型识别可迁移的近优区间，再在大模型上只做少量验证”。这件事的重要性有三层。第一，它说明 SFT→RL 两阶段并不是一个尖锐调参问题，很多情况下存在宽平台，这会直接影响数据采买、标注组织和训练排期。第二，它给出一个和模型 scale 相关的经验规律：模型越大，近优区域通常越宽，意味着大模型对配比误差更不敏感。第三，它把 post-training 的预算优化问题，和 pretraining 里常见的 scaling-law / mixture optimization 思路接上了：不再执着于单点最优，而是研究稳定区域、可迁移结构和低成本代理实验。这对做大规模训练 recipe 的人很有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者先形式化了固定预算 B 下的两阶段分配问题。设比例 r 分给 SFT，1-r 分给 RL，性能记为 P(N, r, B; τ)。传统做法是找 r* = argmax_r P，但作者认为这个目标病态，因为 post-training 曲线常常在峰值附近形成平台，单点最优既不稳也不值得追。于是他们定义 ε-near-optimal region：所有能达到最优性能的 1-ε 以上的 r 所组成的集合。这个定义有两个好处。其一，它更贴近工程决策，因为真实系统里 1% 到 5% 的性能差异，往往不足以支撑一次昂贵重训。其二，它允许讨论“区域宽度”和“区域迁移性”，而不只是某个点。

全文的技术主线有三部分。第一部分是区域刻画。作者在不同任务、模型家族、RL 方法上扫描 r，观察性能曲线的形状，并用不同 ε 阈值计算近优区间宽度。结论是即便 ε 很小，区间也常常不窄，说明 SFT/RL 配比不是高灵敏度旋钮。第二部分是尺度迁移。作者比较小模型和大模型上的近优区间，关注的不是最优点是否完全一致，而是小模型识别出的近优区间，是否能覆盖大模型上的高性能解。这个视角比比较 argmax 更合理，因为单点最优容易受噪声和训练波动影响。第三部分是成本非对称扩展。前面默认 SFT 与 RL 样本单位成本相近，后面进一步讨论当 SFT 标注更贵或 RL 偏好数据更贵时，最优分配如何偏移。作者发现当 SFT 相对更贵时，可接受区域会进一步变宽，意味着工程上更容易选择偏向 RL 的方案而不明显损失性能。

和已有工作相比，区别主要有三点。Raghavendra 等工作更多是在描述低数据区 SFT 更重要、规模上来后 preference/RL 更有利的总体趋势，但没有给出一个可迁移的分配框架，也没有把“近优而非精确最优”作为核心对象。数据 mixture 优化和 scaling-law 外推工作通常处理的是单阶段训练，或者是预训练语料配比，不涉及 SFT→RL 这种顺序依赖的两阶段耦合问题。这里的创新不在模型结构，而在问题重述、评价对象选择，以及把小模型代理实验变成大模型预算决策工具。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的结果看，最关键的实验结论有四个。第一，性能-配比曲线在峰值附近普遍存在平台，而不是尖峰。作者用 2% 到 10% 的相对容忍度定义近优区域，发现即便容忍度很小，区域也已经相当宽。这说明很多配比都能达到接近最优的效果，工程上没必要执着于单个比例。第二，随着模型规模增大，近优区域通常变宽。也就是说，大模型对 SFT/RL 配比更鲁棒，小模型上看起来需要精调的比例，到大模型上往往变成一段都可接受。第三，小模型到大模型的迁移性是成立的，但成立方式不是“最优点完全一致”，而是“小模型找到的近优区间，能较稳定地覆盖大模型上的高性能配比”。这是全文最有用的经验结论。第四，这个现象在不同任务、不同模型家族、以及 off-policy / on-policy RL 设置下都能复现，说明它不是某个算法偶然带来的。

文中还给了一个很实用的成本量级比较：按他们测得的训练时间和 L40S 云价，单样本训练计算成本大约在 2e-5 美元到 3e-4 美元之间；相比人工标注 0.5 到 1 美元/样本，低了 3 到 5 个数量级。即便和 1e-3 美元/样本的廉价合成标注相比，训练算力成本通常也仍低于标注成本。这组数字支撑了他们把“标注预算”而不是“训练 FLOPs”作为一阶优化对象。摘要里没有完整列出所有模型尺寸、任务名和具体峰值差值，正文的重点也不是追求某个 benchmark 上的绝对分数，而是展示区域宽度、尺度变化和迁移覆盖率这些结构性结果。读的时候应把注意力放在曲线形状和区间重叠，而不是单个最高点。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries，确认作者为什么放弃“找最优点”而改用“近优区域”。如果这个问题设定接受了，后面的实验会很顺。精读时重点看三类图表。第一类是不同 r 下的性能曲线，观察峰值附近是否真的是平台，以及平台宽度如何随 ε 变化。第二类是小模型与大模型的区间对照图，重点不是两个最优点差多少，而是小模型区间是否覆盖大模型高性能区域。第三类是成本非对称分析，理解当 SFT 和 RL 样本单位成本不同，预算轴如何重参数化，以及为什么这会改变可接受分配。

如果时间有限，最值得深挖的是 Section 3.2 到 3.4。3.2 解决“为什么要看区域”；3.3 解决“为什么小模型代理实验有用”；3.4 解决“这个框架在真实标注成本不对称时还能不能用”。读实验时要特别留意作者如何定义 tolerance、如何处理训练噪声，以及他们用什么标准判断“transfer reliably”。这篇工作的核心创新不在复杂算法，而在把一个高成本调参问题变成了一个稳定的决策问题。做大模型训练 recipe 的人，应该把这个思路迁移到别的多阶段预算分配上，比如 continual pretrain 与 SFT 的配比、SFT 与 preference data 的采样策略、甚至不同 RL 信号源之间的预算分配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical but under-formalized question in LLM post-training: under a fixed annotation budget, how much should be allocated to supervised fine-tuning versus the subsequent RL stage? The difficulty is not merely finding a single best ratio. The optimum is often unstable across tasks, model scales, RL variants, and evaluation metrics, while changing the ratio usually requires rerunning the whole pipeline. The paper reframes the objective from exact optimality to near-optimality: instead of chasing one brittle optimum, it asks whether there exists a broad allocation region that stays within a small tolerance of peak performance, whether that region expands with scale, and whether it transfers from small proxy models to larger target models.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is methodological rather than algorithmic. It gives a usable framework for post-training budget allocation, replacing expensive full-scale grid search with a proxy-model strategy. That matters for three reasons. First, it shows that SFT-to-RL allocation is often a plateau problem, not a needle-in-a-haystack tuning problem. Second, it identifies a scale effect: larger models tend to have wider near-optimal regions, so they are less sensitive to imperfect allocation. Third, it connects post-training recipe design to ideas familiar from pretraining research, such as scaling-law thinking, mixture optimization, and robust region identification rather than exact point estimation. For researchers working on the pretrain–posttrain interface, this is a useful way to reason about annotation efficiency and recipe transfer.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is simple and clean. Given a pretrained model of size N and a total annotation budget B, an allocation ratio r sends rB examples to SFT and (1-r)B to RL. Performance is written as P(N, r, B; tau). A standard formulation would optimize r* = argmax_r P, but the paper argues that this is the wrong target because post-training curves are often flat near the top. A tiny gain in measured score may not justify a full retraining run, and the exact argmax can be unstable under noise. The paper therefore defines the epsilon-near-optimal region: the set of ratios whose performance is at least (1-epsilon) times the best observed performance.

This shift enables three analyses. First, region characterization: the authors sweep allocation ratios across tasks, model families, and RL methods, then measure how wide the near-optimal region is under tolerances such as 2% to 10%. Second, scale transfer: instead of asking whether the exact optimum ratio matches across scales, they ask whether the near-optimal region found on a small proxy model covers high-performing ratios on a larger model. This is a much more stable transfer criterion. Third, asymmetric annotation cost: the default setup measures budget in number of labeled examples, but the paper extends the framework to cases where SFT and RL labels have different unit costs. Under that view, the effective optimum shifts, and the acceptable region can widen further when SFT data is relatively more expensive.

Relative to prior work, the novelty is in the problem formulation and the transfer criterion. Earlier work mostly reported broad trends, such as SFT being more important in low-data regimes and preference optimization becoming more useful at larger scales, but did not provide a principled near-optimal allocation framework or establish transfer from small to large models. Work on data mixture optimization and scaling-law extrapolation usually focuses on single-stage training, especially pretraining mixtures, not sequential SFT-then-RL coupling. The paper’s contribution is to turn a brittle tuning problem into a region-finding problem with practical transfer value.
summary_en.experiments:
The most important empirical findings are structural rather than benchmark-centric. First, the performance-versus-allocation curve typically has a broad plateau near its maximum. Even with small tolerances, such as a few percent from peak performance, the near-optimal region is already wide. Second, this region generally widens with model scale. Larger models are therefore more forgiving to imperfect SFT/RL splits. Third, transfer works better at the region level than at the exact-optimum level: a near-optimal region identified on a small proxy model tends to reliably contain high-performing allocations for a larger target model, even when the exact best ratio shifts. Fourth, the pattern is observed across tasks, model families, and both off-policy and on-policy RL settings, which argues against the effect being tied to one specific algorithm.

The paper also includes a useful cost sanity check. Using measured runtimes and L40S cloud pricing, per-example training compute cost is reported to range from about 2e-5 USD for the cheapest 1B SFT setting to about 3e-4 USD for 8B DPO. Compared with human annotation costs around 0.5 to 1.0 USD per example, compute is lower by roughly three to five orders of magnitude. Even compared with cheap synthetic annotation around 1e-3 USD per example, compute is still usually below annotation. This supports the paper’s decision to treat annotation as the dominant first-order budget axis.

The paper is less about headline absolute scores and more about curve geometry, region width, and transfer coverage. When reading the experiments, the key is not the single best number but how flat the top is, how the width changes with scale, and how much overlap exists between proxy-model and target-model high-performance regions.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and preliminaries. The central conceptual move is the replacement of exact optimality with near-optimality. If that framing makes sense, the rest of the paper becomes straightforward. Then focus on the sections that define and analyze the near-optimal region. The most informative figures are the allocation-performance curves, the region-width comparisons across scales, and the small-to-large transfer plots. In those figures, do not over-focus on the exact argmax. Look at plateau width and overlap.

The most useful sections to read carefully are the ones corresponding to region analysis, scale transfer, and asymmetric annotation cost. Those sections answer three practical questions: why a region is a better target than a point, why small proxy experiments can replace large-scale search, and how the framework changes when SFT and RL labels have different prices. It is also worth checking how tolerance is defined, how noisy training outcomes are handled, and what criterion is used to claim reliable transfer. The paper’s main value lies in recipe design logic, not in a new optimizer or RL objective. Anyone working on large-scale training pipelines can reuse the same lens for other multi-stage allocation problems, including continual pretraining versus SFT, SFT versus preference data, or allocation across multiple RL signal sources.

recommendation.zh: 应复现到内部 SFT/RL 预算网格；若近似最优区真的随规模变宽，会改变大模型后训练 sweep 的做法。
recommendation.en: Worth reproducing on internal SFT/RL budget grids; if the near-optimal region really widens with scale, large-model post-training sweeps should change.

paper.title: Behaviorally Grounded User Profiles from the Wild for Personalized Alignment and Multi-Perspective Reasoning
paper.abstract: Persona-driven techniques increasingly adapt large language models (LLMs) to diverse contexts. However, existing methods predominantly rely on rigid, synthetic personas that flatten individual variation, rely on stereotypes, and miss the nuanced signals driving actual human preferences. We introduce profile behavioral grounding, a framework for extracting open-ended, high-fidelity user profiles directly from authentic, anonymized social media posts. We evaluate these profiles across two paradigm

summary.core_problem: 现有人格化对齐多依赖合成 persona，难以表达真实用户偏好中的细粒度差异。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在后训练和个性化对齐数据构造：把真实匿名社交媒体行为转成开放式用户画像，并比较其在 SFT 和测试时多视角推理中的作用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 profile behavioral grounding，从真实社交媒体帖子中抽取高保真用户画像；使用这些画像做两类适配，一类是训练时的监督微调，另一类是不改参数的测试时多视角推理。方法重点不是新模型结构，而是把 persona 从模板化属性改成行为证据驱动的 profile。
summary.experiments: 在复杂推荐和开放式查询 benchmark 上评估，比较基础模型、合成 profile baseline、行为画像增强模型。摘要称行为画像在参数化对齐和多视角推理中均稳定优于合成 persona，但未给出模型规模、训练数据量和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Waterloo 和 ServiceNow AI Research。

summary_en.core_problem: Synthetic personas used for LLM personalization flatten real user variation and miss behavioral signals behind human preferences.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in post-training and personalization data design: it turns anonymized social-media behavior into open-ended user profiles and tests them for SFT-based personalization and test-time multi-perspective reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces profile behavioral grounding, extracting high-fidelity profiles from authentic user posts. These profiles are used either as supervision for finetuning or as non-parametric context for multi-perspective inference. The novelty is not architectural; it is replacing rigid persona templates with behavior-derived evidence.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover complex recommendation and open-ended query benchmarks, comparing base models and synthetic-profile baselines. The abstract reports consistent gains from behaviorally grounded profiles, but does not specify model sizes, dataset scale, or exact improvement numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Waterloo and ServiceNow AI Research.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不是主线；可看作个性化 SFT 数据设计案例，重点扫 profile 抽取和合成 persona 对比。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; treat it as a personalization-data case study and skim only the profile extraction versus synthetic-persona comparison.

paper.title: Stick to What You Know: A Study of Knowledge-Aligned Supervised Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) trains a base language model to imitate target responses, and these targets may require knowledge the base model has not robustly internalized. We study this as a source of hallucinations and frame a group of mitigation methods as \emph{knowledge-aligned SFT}: constraining SFT training targets to the base model's parametric knowledge. Under a unified setup, we compare existing generation-based and estimation-based knowledge-alignment methods and introduce two new var

summary.core_problem: 研究 SFT 目标答案要求的知识超出基座模型已稳健内化范围时，是否会诱发幻觉，以及如何让 SFT 目标与模型已有参数知识对齐。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练方法与幻觉机制分析。它把一类常见 SFT 问题形式化为 knowledge-aligned SFT：不是让模型模仿所有参考答案，而是筛掉或改写那些基座模型不可靠掌握的事实声明。这个视角对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有意义，因为它直接讨论 SFT 是否在向模型注入“不可承载”的知识。
summary.technical_approach: 在统一设置下比较已有 generation-based 与 estimation-based knowledge alignment 方法，并提出两个变体：Evidence Rewrite 用外部证据验证基座模型生成内容后改写目标；Recall Rewrite 只保留基座模型能一致回忆的事实声明。核心是把训练目标约束到 base model 的 parametric knowledge，而不是单纯增加事实性指令数据。
summary.experiments: 使用 Qwen 3 4B 与 OLMo 3 7B 做实验，在 WildHalu 与 Biography 上评估事实幻觉，在 UnknownBench 上评估未知问题拒答行为。摘要称 knowledge-aligned SFT 能降低事实幻觉并大体保持通用能力，其中 Recall Rewrite 的事实性收益最强，并改善 UnknownBench 上的拒答行为。摘要未提供具体提升幅度和完整 baseline 细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 AppTek GmbH、F-Bureaucracy UG 与 RWTH Aachen University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether SFT targets that require knowledge not robustly internalized by the base model cause hallucinations, and how to align SFT targets with the model's parametric knowledge.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method and hallucination analysis. It frames a common SFT failure as knowledge-aligned SFT: instead of imitating all reference answers, filter or rewrite claims that the base model does not reliably know. This is relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface because it asks whether SFT is trying to inject knowledge the base model cannot support.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under a unified setup, the paper compares existing generation-based and estimation-based knowledge-alignment methods and introduces two variants. Evidence Rewrite verifies base-model generations using external evidence before rewriting targets. Recall Rewrite retains only claims that the base model can consistently recall. The main idea is to constrain SFT targets to the base model's parametric knowledge rather than simply adding more factual instruction data.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Qwen 3 4B and OLMo 3 7B. Factual hallucination is evaluated on WildHalu and Biography, and refusal behavior on UnknownBench. The abstract reports that knowledge-aligned SFT reduces hallucinations while mostly preserving general capabilities. Recall Rewrite gives the strongest factuality gains and improves refusal on UnknownBench. Exact gains and full baseline details are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with AppTek GmbH, F-Bureaucracy UG, and RWTH Aachen University.

recommendation.zh: 这篇触到 SFT 的硬边界：别用后训练硬塞基座没学稳的事实；重点看 Recall Rewrite 的判定准则。
recommendation.en: This hits a real SFT boundary: do not force facts the base model has not learned reliably; focus on the Recall Rewrite criterion.

institutions: Affiliation:AppTek GmbH, Aachen, Germany & F-Bureaucracy UG, Aachen
Affiliation:AppTek GmbH, Aachen, Germany & RWTH Aachen University

paper.title: Fine-Tuning Qwen3-27B for C-to-Rust Code Translation: A Three-Stage Curriculum of Pretraining, Debugging-Aware SFT, and Task-Specific SFT
paper.abstract: Translating C code into safe, idiomatic Rust is a longstanding software-engineering goal because it can eliminate entire classes of memory-safety vulnerabilities while preserving the functional behavior of legacy systems. Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for this task but typically underperform when applied off-the-shelf, since general-purpose pretraining rarely emphasizes idiomatic Rust generation, cross-language semantic equivalence, or the ability to reason about and repair com

summary.core_problem: 把 Qwen3-27B 专门微调到 C-to-Rust 代码翻译任务上，使输出更安全、符合 Rust 习惯，并能利用编译器或运行时反馈进行修复。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是面向代码迁移任务的训练流程报告。它把继续预训练、debugging-aware SFT 和任务 SFT 串成三阶段 curriculum；对代码模型后训练有参考价值，但任务很窄，不是通用 coding agent 或基座预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 方法包含三步：先在 Rust-centric corpora 上继续预训练以增强 Rust 语法、标准库和 idiomatic pattern；再用 microsoft/Verus_Training_Data 做监督微调，注入调试与自修复行为；最后针对 C2Rust 翻译数据做任务定向 SFT。
summary.experiments: 模型基座为 Qwen3-27B。摘要未完整给出训练 token 数、数据规模、baseline 名称和量化提升；可确认的实验重点应是 C-to-Rust 翻译质量、语义等价性以及编译/运行反馈修复能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The report fine-tunes Qwen3-27B for C-to-Rust translation, aiming to produce safe, idiomatic Rust while preserving functional behavior and using compiler/runtime feedback for repair.
summary_en.importance: This is a task-focused code-model training report. Its three-stage curriculum—continued pretraining, debugging-aware SFT, and task-specific SFT—is relevant to code post-training, but the scope is narrow and not a general pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The curriculum first performs continued pretraining on Rust-centric corpora, then supervised fine-tuning on microsoft/Verus_Training_Data to teach debugging and self-repair behavior, and finally task-specific SFT for C2Rust translation.
summary_en.experiments: The base model is Qwen3-27B. The abstract does not provide full token counts, dataset sizes, baselines, or quantitative gains; the evaluation likely centers on translation correctness, Rust idiomaticity, and compile/runtime repair.

recommendation.zh: 只看三阶段数据顺序即可；这是窄任务工程配方，能借鉴 curriculum 结构，不能外推到通用代码预训练。
recommendation.en: Skim only the three-stage data order; it is a narrow task recipe, useful for curriculum design but not evidence for general code pretraining.

paper.title: Equal Ranking Quality, Different Decisions: Training Order-Consistent LLM Scorers
paper.abstract: Rerankers, reward models and multi-document QA scorers score candidate documents or responses in one LLM prompt, so each score depends on their order. Such scorers are selected on ranking quality, but their scores determine a decision: what a score threshold retains, a reader answers, or a preference model selects. However, equal ranking quality does not imply equal decisions: on passage reranking, five trained scorers within 0.010 nDCG@10 retain sets that overlap by only 0.66-0.84 when reordere

summary.core_problem: 如何解决 LLM 在重排、奖励建模和 QA 评分中对候选项顺序敏感的问题？
summary.importance: 揭示了即使模型具有相同的排序质量（如 nDCG），其最终决策（如截断阈值、偏好选择）也可能因输入顺序而产生巨大差异，并提出了一种缓解方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Order-Consistency SFT (OC-SFT)，在训练阶段引入正则化，使模型对同一组候选项的不同排列输出一致的分数，从而在权重层面减轻顺序依赖。
summary.experiments: 在段落重排、多文档 QA 和偏好建模任务上，OC-SFT 保持了排序质量，同时显著提高了决策稳定性（例如，在重排任务中，保留集合的重叠度从 0.66-0.84 提升）。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自维也纳工业大学和 JKU Linz。

summary_en.core_problem: How to mitigate the sensitivity of LLMs to the order of candidates in reranking, reward modeling, and QA scoring?
summary_en.importance: Reveals that even with equal ranking quality (e.g., nDCG), models' final decisions (e.g., thresholding, preference selection) can vary drastically due to input order, and proposes a mitigation strategy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Order-Consistency SFT (OC-SFT), introducing regularization during training to ensure the model outputs consistent scores for different permutations of the same candidate set, mitigating order dependence in the weights.
summary_en.experiments: On passage reranking, multi-document QA, and preference modeling, OC-SFT maintains ranking quality while significantly improving decision stability (e.g., increasing retained set overlap from 0.66-0.84 in reranking).
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from TU Wien and JKU Linz.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 RM/Reranker 中排序指标（nDCG）与实际决策（阈值截断）之间的脱节，OC-SFT 是一种实用的正则化技巧，适合做 RM 的同学参考。
recommendation.en: Highlights the disconnect between ranking metrics (nDCG) and actual decisions (thresholding) in RMs/Rerankers; OC-SFT is a practical regularization trick for RM training.

paper.title: TailSFT: Filtered Fine-Tuning Improves Post-Training Performance
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training drives reasoning and agentic capabilities in modern AI systems, yet a growing body of work shows that it is most effective when used to fine-tune an already capable base model. We question whether existing pipelines yield models that are most suitable for reinforcement learning. Building on prior work highlighting the role of coverage and pass@K as predictors of post-RL performance, we design a simple modification to supervised fine-tuning, TailSFT, which fil

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是一个很具体但常被忽略的接口问题：标准 SFT 是否真的给后续 RL 提供了最好的初始化。作者指出，SFT 阶段优化的是 token-level cross-entropy，但 RL，尤其是 verifiable reward 场景下的 RLVR/GRPO，真正需要的是初始化模型在有限采样预算内能否产出“至少一个可奖励答案”。这对应的是 coverage 或 large-k pass@k，而不是单样本精度或更低的 CE loss。问题因此变成：能否修改 SFT，让它少去继续拟合那些模型已经很会的样本，把训练容量留给分布尾部、但对后续 RL 很关键的可奖励响应。
summary.importance: 这项工作的意义不在于把 SFT 再做得更强一点，而在于明确提出了 stage-aware training 的视角：一个阶段的局部最优目标，未必给下一个阶段提供最优初始化。对预训练和后训练接口研究，这个结论很重要。它把“中间模型该如何评价”从单纯看 loss/benchmark，推进到看它是否保留了足够的 response coverage。贡献量级上，这不是替代 RL 的新范式，但它给出了一个极轻量、可直接落地的 SFT 改法，并且在真实 7B 模型上证明 large-k pass@k 和最终 RL 后 pass@1 都能提升。对做 reasoning/coding post-training 的团队，这类方法很可能比继续堆 SFT 数据或延长 SFT 步数更有性价比。
summary.technical_approach:
TailSFT 的核心很简单：在 SFT 时做 sequence-level filtering，把那些相对于初始策略已经“fit 得够好”的训练序列过滤掉，只对 under-modeled tail 继续更新。作者的出发点是，标准 cross-entropy 会继续奖励所有 demonstration 的概率提升，包括模型已经很容易采样出来的响应；而概率质量守恒意味着，这种继续加压可能把质量从别的潜在有用响应上挤走，导致 coverage 下降。也就是说，CE 和 coverage 不是同一个目标，甚至可能冲突。

论文先在理论上 formalize 了 coverage。设任务有二值可验证奖励，RL 初始阶段真正有用的是：对一个 prompt，模型在 k 次采样内至少出现一个 reward-bearing response 的概率，这正是 pass@k 的含义。large-k pass@k 越高，RL rollout 越容易拿到正信号。TailSFT 因而不再试图均匀提升所有监督样本的 likelihood，而是优先学习那些初始模型还不容易覆盖到的序列。

关键设计点有两个。第一，过滤是 sequence-level，而不是 token-level reweighting。因为 coverage 关心的是“完整响应是否可被采到”，不是局部 token 拟合。第二，过滤标准是相对于 initial policy，而不是相对于当前训练中的 policy。作者强调这一点并给出理论说明：若按当前策略动态过滤，训练过程会不断改变“谁算已经学会”，容易引入不稳定或错误的偏置；相对于初始策略做过滤，则更接近“保留初始模型已有覆盖、把增量学习预算投向尾部”的目标，并且能在文中的设定下给出优于标准 CE 和一些朴素过滤方案的 coverage 保证。

从算法形态看，TailSFT 是一个 drop-in SFT objective modification，不需要改模型结构，也不依赖 RL 阶段信息。实现上更像在 SFT 数据上做基于 base policy 的 hard example selection，但它不是为了提升训练时 loss 或 pass@1，而是为了提升后续 RL 可利用的探索起点。论文还提出了一个 coverage-ratio diagnostic，用 base model 和标准 SFT run 的统计量来判断 TailSFT 是否有望改善 coverage。这个诊断给了方法一个实用入口：不是所有数据集、所有任务都一定适合过滤，先看 coverage ratio 可以减少盲试。
summary.experiments:
实验分成三层。第一层是受控 toy setting。作者构造了 graph navigation 任务，把“coverage 与 CE 的张力”单独拎出来看。结果显示，过滤掉 already-fit examples 后，模型虽然 cross-entropy 更差、pass@1 也可能不占优，但 large-k pass@k 更高。这一步很关键，因为它证明 TailSFT 不是偶然在真实任务上奏效，而是确实在优化一个和标准 SFT 不同的目标。

第二层是真实模型与任务。作者在 OLMo-3 7B 上做数学和代码任务实验。按文中摘要给出的数字，TailSFT 在 coding 上把 pass@16 绝对提升最多 16.8%，在 math 上最多提升 3.1%。更重要的是，这种 coverage 改善能传递到 RL 之后：经过 GRPO，最终 pass@1 最多再提升 3.9%。这说明 TailSFT 不是只把“多采样时看起来更好”做出来，而是真的给 RL 提供了更好的起点。

第三层是设计与消融。作者比较了不同过滤准则，论证为什么要按 initial policy 过滤，而不是用更直观但更短视的替代方案。论文还引入 coverage-ratio 作为诊断量，并展示它能给出 TailSFT 改善 coverage 的充分条件。这个部分的价值在于，它把方法从经验技巧推进到“何时该用、为什么会有效”的层面。

从全文可读出的主线是：TailSFT 往往会牺牲一些 CE 和小 k 指标，换来大 k coverage 与 RL 后性能提升。作者并不回避这个 trade-off，反而把它当作论文最重要的论点之一：SFT 阶段的最优目标不应默认等于后续 RL 初始化的最优目标。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇值得精读。建议按以下顺序看。先读 Introduction 和 Section 2，把 coverage、pass@k、RL 初始化质量三者的关系想清楚。这里是整篇论文的立论基础，如果只盯着“过滤样本”这个表面动作，会低估它的意义。然后看 graph navigation 的受控实验，这部分最能干净地说明为什么 CE 更低不一定更利于后续 RL。接着重点看 TailSFT 算法定义和 relative-to-initial-policy 的理论论证，尤其是作者为什么反对更朴素的过滤方式。之后看 OLMo-3 7B 在 math/coding 上的主结果表，关注 pass@16、最终 GRPO 后 pass@1，以及不同任务上收益差异。最后看 coverage-ratio diagnostic，这部分很适合转化成实际 pipeline 中的决策规则。

若时间有限，至少看：Section 2 的 coverage formalization、Algorithm 1、graph navigation 结果图、Table 1/2、coverage-ratio 对应图。若要深挖，值得思考三个问题：1）TailSFT 是否可以推广到 pretrain→mid-train、mid-train→SFT 等其他阶段接口；2）过滤阈值与数据多样性之间如何权衡；3）在多答案、非二值奖励或 process reward 场景下，coverage 的定义是否需要改写。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a precise interface problem in multi-stage LM training: does standard SFT actually produce the best initialization for downstream RL? The authors argue that SFT optimizes token-level cross-entropy, while RL—especially RL with verifiable rewards—cares about something different: whether the initialization can produce at least one reward-bearing response within a limited sampling budget. That property is better captured by coverage or large-k pass@k than by CE loss or pass@1. The question is therefore whether SFT can be modified to preserve and improve that useful response coverage instead of continuing to overfit examples the model already handles well.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is conceptual and practical at the same time. Conceptually, it makes the SFT-to-RL boundary explicit as a stage-misalignment problem: the objective that is locally optimal for one stage may be suboptimal as an initialization for the next. That is an important lesson for pretrain/post-train interface research more broadly. Practically, TailSFT is a lightweight intervention that can be dropped into existing SFT pipelines, and the paper shows gains not only in large-k pass@k but also in final post-RL pass@1 on a real 7B model. For teams working on reasoning or coding post-training, this is a concrete alternative to simply scaling SFT data or training longer.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TailSFT is a sequence-level filtering method for supervised fine-tuning. During SFT, it removes sequences that are already sufficiently well fit by the initial policy, and concentrates updates on the under-modeled tail of the response distribution. The motivation is that standard cross-entropy keeps rewarding likelihood increases for every demonstration, including responses the model can already sample easily. Because probability mass is limited, pushing those easy responses further can reduce mass assigned to other potentially useful responses, hurting coverage.

The paper formalizes coverage in the setting of binary verifiable rewards. For a prompt x, what matters for RL initialization is the probability that at least one of k samples receives reward 1. This is exactly what pass@k measures. Large-k pass@k is therefore a proxy for how much positive learning signal RL can expect from the initialization under a realistic rollout budget.

Two design choices are central. First, filtering is done at the sequence level rather than the token level, because coverage is about sampling complete reward-bearing responses, not about local token fit. Second, filtering is defined relative to the initial policy rather than the current policy during training. This is not a cosmetic detail. The authors argue, and partially prove, that filtering relative to the initial policy better preserves useful pre-existing coverage and avoids the instability or myopia of more naive dynamic filtering schemes. Under their setup, this criterion yields better coverage guarantees than standard CE and simpler alternatives.

Operationally, TailSFT is a drop-in modification to SFT rather than a new architecture or an RL-dependent method. It resembles hard-example selection based on the base model, but the target is not better training loss or pass@1; it is better downstream RL initialization. The paper also introduces a lightweight coverage-ratio diagnostic, computed from the base model and a standard SFT run, which provides a sufficient condition for TailSFT to improve coverage. That diagnostic makes the method more actionable in practice.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized in three layers. First, the paper uses a controlled graph-navigation task to isolate the tension between CE and coverage. In that setting, filtering already-fit examples improves large-k pass@k even when cross-entropy becomes worse and pass@1 does not improve. This is an important result because it shows TailSFT is not just an empirical trick on benchmark tasks; it is optimizing a genuinely different objective.

Second, the method is tested on OLMo-3 7B for math and coding. According to the reported headline numbers, TailSFT improves pass@16 by up to 16.8 absolute points on coding and 3.1 points on math. More importantly, the gain transfers through RL: after GRPO, final pass@1 improves by up to 3.9 points. That is the strongest evidence in the paper, because it shows the method improves not only multi-sample accessibility but also the eventual post-RL model.

Third, the paper includes design ablations and diagnostics. It compares different filtering criteria and motivates why filtering relative to the initial policy is preferable to more naive alternatives. It also introduces the coverage-ratio diagnostic and shows that it can predict when TailSFT should help. A recurring theme in the results is the trade-off: TailSFT may sacrifice CE and small-k metrics in exchange for better large-k coverage and better post-RL performance. The paper treats this trade-off as a feature of stage-aware optimization rather than a weakness.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one deserves a close read. Start with the introduction and the coverage formalization section. The paper only makes sense if you internalize the distinction between optimizing SFT loss and optimizing RL initialization quality. Then read the controlled graph-navigation section carefully; it gives the cleanest evidence that lower CE does not necessarily imply better downstream RL readiness. After that, focus on the TailSFT algorithm and the argument for filtering relative to the initial policy. The main empirical tables on OLMo-3 7B are the next priority, especially the pass@16 numbers and the final GRPO pass@1 gains. Finish with the coverage-ratio diagnostic, which is the part most likely to transfer directly into real training pipelines.

If time is limited, the minimum useful subset is: the coverage formalization, Algorithm 1, the graph-navigation figures, the main math/coding result tables, and the diagnostic figure. Good follow-up questions while reading are: whether the same idea extends to other stage boundaries such as pretrain-to-mid-train or mid-train-to-SFT; how filtering thresholds trade off against data diversity; and how the notion of coverage should change for multi-answer tasks, non-binary rewards, or process-based rewards.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现到 internal SFT/RL ablation：它挑战“全量 SFT 拟合越好越利于 RL”的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Worth reproducing in internal SFT/RL ablations: it challenges the default belief that fitting all SFT data better is always better for RL.

paper.title: Is Next-Chunk Reasoning RL Really Better than SFT? Revisiting Training Strategies under no-CoT Data
paper.abstract: Recent work proposes next-chunk reasoning RL for leveraging no-CoT data---corpora such as worked solutions and textbook derivations that contain reasoning-rich content but lack explicit chain-of-thought annotations. The method trains a model to generate implicit reasoning traces and rewards them by their ability to predict the next chunk of text. While promising, existing evaluations primarily compare against conventional SFT baselines, leaving open whether the gains come from the RL formulation

summary.core_problem: 检验 next-chunk reasoning RL 在无显式 CoT 的推理文本上是否真的优于更简单的监督训练。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练策略的受控比较，贡献不在新算法，而在拆解收益来源：RL 带来的隐式推理优化，还是更充分地暴露 no-CoT 数据。对用教材推导、worked solution、弱标注推理语料训练推理能力很相关。
summary.technical_approach: 论文比较 next-chunk reasoning RL 与 Mixed SFT。前者让模型生成隐式 reasoning trace，并用预测下一段文本的能力作为奖励；后者只做一个监督微调阶段，把 no-CoT 数据和 long-CoT 数据混合训练。关键设计是控制训练数据来源，避免把 RL 的收益和数据覆盖收益混在一起。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的核心结果是：Mixed SFT 在后续 RLVR 后达到更高性能上限，同时训练计算量低于 next-chunk reasoning RL 超过 60 倍。实验覆盖多个设置，但摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模、具体 benchmark 和提升幅度细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether next-chunk reasoning RL is intrinsically better than simple supervised training on reasoning-rich data without explicit chain-of-thought annotations.
summary_en.importance: Its value is a controlled training-strategy comparison rather than a new algorithm. It separates the benefit of RL-style implicit reasoning from the simpler effect of exposing the model to no-CoT reasoning text, which matters for training reasoning models from textbooks and worked solutions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares next-chunk reasoning RL against Mixed SFT. The RL method trains implicit reasoning traces and rewards them by next-chunk prediction, while Mixed SFT jointly trains on no-CoT and long-CoT data in a single supervised stage. The clean part is the attempt to control for data exposure.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that Mixed SFT reaches a higher post-RLVR performance ceiling while using more than 60x less training compute than next-chunk reasoning RL. The abstract does not specify model sizes, data sizes, exact benchmarks, or absolute gains.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看实验设计：它把“RL 有效”改写成“数据暴露方式有效”，60x compute 差距足够影响内部 recipe 选择。
recommendation.en: Read the setup closely: it reframes the gain from “RL works” to “data exposure works,” and a 60x compute gap is recipe-changing.

paper.title: A Factorial Ablation of a Speech-to-SFT Pipeline: Differential Effects on Data Quality and Downstream Transfer
paper.abstract: Industry pipelines that turn speech into supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data via multi-stage refinement are increasingly adopted but, to our knowledge, have not been publicly ablated stage-by-stage, leaving each stage's marginal value unknown. We design a production-ready speech-to-SFT pipeline in which transcript refinement (Phase 0) and SFT data quality refinement (Phase 2) are independently toggleable, yielding a 2x2 factorial design. For each condition, we generate QA-form SFT data from Korean

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：把企业内部语音资产转成 SFT 数据时，转写清洗和 SFT 数据质检各自到底带来多少收益，以及这些收益是否会稳定转化为下游任务分数。核心结论比较务实：数据质量指标会改善，但在固定 SFT recipe 下，不一定对应 MCQA 分数提升。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更接近 post-train 数据管线分析。但它对数据质量评估有启发：单纯提高 QA 样本的可读性、准确性和人工评分，并不保证迁移到目标评测。原因在于训练数据格式、目标任务格式、模型家族和领域之间存在匹配关系。这个结果提醒预训练和指令微调数据研究不要只看静态质量分，而要看质量信号是否和目标能力一致。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是一个 2×2 factorial ablation。Phase 0 是 transcript refinement，包括会议转写后的 discourse summary、多 STT 交叉校验、NER-based RAG 和统一 proofreading。Phase 1 固定为 QA generation，通过 analyze、context augment、strategize、generate 把会议内容转成 QA，并保留 domain、sub_domain、difficulty、question_type 等元数据。Phase 2 是 SFT data quality refinement，包括 5-judge ensemble 过滤、最多 2 轮 refinement loop，以及 embedding 去重。两个可开关变量是 Phase 0 和 Phase 2，因此可以分离转写层清洗和 SFT 样本层质检的边际贡献。这个设计比只比较 pipeline 前后版本更干净，因为 QA 生成阶段固定，且四个条件的 QA 数量接近。
summary.experiments: 数据来自 40 场韩语会议，19 场医学、21 场金融，部分多语片段保留原语言。四个条件下每组 QA 数为 2,598 到 2,765，差异约 6%。实验覆盖 9 个 LLM，来自 EXAONE、Gemma、Llama、Phi、Qwen 五个家族，规模从 2.4B 到 70B。主实验是 72 个 LoRA runs，即 9 个模型 × 4 个条件 × 2 个领域；另有 12 个 full fine-tuning sanity runs，以及 8 个 Whisper-medium 替换 STT 的稳健性实验。LoRA 设定为 rank 16、alpha 32、dropout 0.05、QLoRA 4-bit、学习率 2e-4、3% warmup、3 epochs、effective batch 16。评测包括 KMMLU、KMMLU-Pro、MMLU，4 个 LLM judge，6 名专家盲评，STT-engine swap，以及 LLM difficulty audit。主要结果是：Phase 0 和 Phase 2 带来稳定的 QA 质量提升，LLM judge 平均 +0.18，人工评分平均 +0.22，量表为 1–5；但跨模型平均 MCQA 提升不显著。收益主要集中在模型家族和领域更匹配的组合上。Whisper-medium 替换内部 STT 后，KMMLU 平均绝对差异不超过 1.32 个百分点，说明上游 STT 对聚合指标影响较小。难度审计显示，两个强 LLM judge 平均仍无法有把握回答公开样本中 7.8% 的 QA。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 Pipeline and Dataset 中三阶段设计和 Table 1、Table 2，确认四个条件是否可比。然后看 Experimental Setup，重点是 72-cell factorial design、LoRA recipe 和 full FT sanity check。结果部分应重点看 QA 质量评分与 MCQA 迁移之间的差异，尤其是作者对 format mismatch 的解释，以及 Appendix G / Table 11 中 question type 与 MCQA factoid-recall 格式的关系。若关心企业数据管线，可看 Phase 2 prompts 和公开 200-QA sample；若关心基座训练数据筛选，重点不是具体韩语医学金融数据，而是“静态质量分”和“训练后能力收益”不一致这个现象。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical data-pipeline question: when speech recordings are converted into SFT data, what is the marginal value of transcript refinement and downstream QA-quality refinement, and do those quality gains transfer to task performance? The main result is restrained: the pipeline improves judged QA quality, but the improvement does not reliably translate into MCQA gains under a fixed SFT recipe.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to post-training data engineering than to core pretraining. Its useful lesson for foundation-model training is about signal alignment. Better-looking SFT examples, as measured by LLM judges and human experts, are not automatically better training examples for a target evaluation. Format, domain, model family, and task style matter. This is a useful caution for data-quality filtering in both instruction tuning and continued training: quality scores need to be validated against the capability they are meant to improve.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses a 2-by-2 factorial design. Phase 0 performs transcript refinement over STT outputs using discourse summaries, multi-STT cross-checking, NER-based RAG, and a final proofreading model. Phase 1 is shared across all conditions and generates QA data through analysis, context augmentation, planning, and generation; each item keeps metadata such as domain, sub-domain, difficulty, and question type. Phase 2 performs SFT-data quality refinement with a 5-judge ensemble, up to two refinement rounds, and embedding-based deduplication. By toggling Phase 0 and Phase 2 independently while keeping Phase 1 fixed, the paper separates upstream transcript cleanup from downstream SFT-item filtering. That is the main methodological value.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 40 Korean conference sessions, 19 medical and 21 finance, with multilingual segments preserved when present. Each condition produces 2,598 to 2,765 QA items, a roughly 6% range. The main grid covers 9 models from five families, EXAONE, Gemma, Llama, Phi, and Qwen, ranging from 2.4B to 70B parameters. The main experiment has 72 LoRA runs, plus 12 full fine-tuning sanity runs and an 8-cell Whisper-medium STT-swap grid. The LoRA recipe uses rank 16, alpha 32, dropout 0.05, 4-bit QLoRA, learning rate 2e-4, 3% warmup, 3 epochs, and effective batch size 16. Evaluation includes KMMLU, KMMLU-Pro, MMLU, four LLM judges, six blind human experts, STT substitution, and an LLM difficulty audit. QA quality improves by +0.18 according to LLM judges and +0.22 according to humans on a 1–5 scale, but the cross-model mean MCQA gain is not significant. Gains concentrate in model-family and domain-aligned settings. Replacing the internal STT system with Whisper-medium changes aggregate KMMLU by at most 1.32 percentage points on average. The difficulty audit finds that two strong LLM judges still cannot answer 7.8% of the public-sample QA items with confidence.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the pipeline description and Tables 1–2 first, because the design quality depends on whether the four cells are comparable. Then inspect the experimental grid, especially the 72-cell LoRA setup and the full fine-tuning sanity check. The most useful part is the gap between QA-quality gains and downstream MCQA transfer, including the discussion of format mismatch and the appendix table on question types. For data-pipeline work, the released Phase 2 prompts and public QA sample are worth checking. For foundation-model data research, the key point is the misalignment between static data-quality scores and training-time utility.

recommendation.zh: 一个很实在的工程消融实验，揭示了 LLM Judge 认为的“数据质量提升”并不总能转化为下游 Benchmark 的收益，对做数据合成和 SFT 的同学有警示作用。
recommendation.en: A very practical engineering ablation experiment revealing that 'data quality improvements' as perceived by LLM Judges do not always translate into downstream Benchmark gains, serving as a cautionary tale for those working on data synthesis and SFT.

paper.title: Knowing but Not Saying: Preventing Factual Access Failures in LLM SFT via Recall-Anchored Distillation
paper.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can degrade factual behavior outside the target domain. This degradation is often described as catastrophic forgetting, yet open-ended factual failures do not necessarily imply that the underlying facts have been erased. In this work, we identify a more specific phenomenon, factual access failure: after domain SFT, models can still recognize or rank the correct answer under constrained evaluation, while failing to produce it in closed-book generation. Through benchma

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是：领域 SFT 之后，模型在开放式事实问答上变差，未必是知识被擦除，也可能是“事实访问失败”——模型仍能在多选或排序形式下识别正确答案，但在闭卷生成时无法稳定说出来。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 pretrain 到 posttrain 的接口。论文把 SFT 后的事实退化拆成两类：一类是真正生成了错误答案，另一类是表达层失败，例如回答过长、格式不匹配、exact-match 评测无法命中。这个区分很有用，因为它改变了干预方式。如果知识没有被擦除，就不一定需要再注入事实数据或做大规模 replay；更合适的做法是约束 SFT 过程中对 base model 开放域生成分布的漂移。对持续预训练、领域适配、医学/法律等高风险领域 SFT 都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两部分。第一部分是诊断框架。作者比较 recognition 和 recall：recognition 用多选或候选排序测试模型是否能选出正确答案；recall 用 closed-book generation 的 EM/F1 测试模型能否直接生成答案。论文进一步用 same-fact probes 控制事实内容，把同一个事实分别做成多选和开放生成形式，观察 SFT 后是否出现“能选但说不出”的分离。第二部分是 Recall-Anchored Distillation, RAD。训练目标是在标准目标领域 SFT loss 之外，加一个无标注 OOD anchoring stream。对每个 OOD prefix-continuation 样本，用未 SFT 的 base model 给出 continuation tokens 上的 soft next-token distribution；adapted model 在这些 continuation token 上匹配 base model 分布。这个 anchor 是分布级的，不要求 OOD gold answer、rationale、外部 judge 或事实标签。和普通 replay 不同，它不是训练模型复现某个硬标签答案，而是限制开放域生成行为相对 base model 的漂移；和 reference regularization 类方法相比，它更直接作用在 OOD continuation 的 token 分布上。
summary.experiments: 论文在三个 backbone 上做医学领域 SFT，目标任务是 MedMCQA。预实验显示，领域 SFT 能提升目标医学 QA，但会显著损害开放式 OOD 事实生成。例如文中报告 TriviaQA full benchmark 的 EM 从 65.03 降到 43.95，而 MedMCQA 和 MMLU 保持稳定或略有提升。这说明退化不是简单的总体能力下降，而更像输出形式和事实访问路径被改变。same-fact 多选/生成探针进一步显示，不少事实在候选约束下仍可被选择，但开放生成失败。错误分析把失败拆成真实错误答案和表达层问题，包括 verbosity、格式不匹配和 exact-match artifact。RAD 的实验结论是：在保留 MedMCQA 域内收益的同时，能恢复较多 OOD factual generation，并优于基线方法。由于给出的全文片段未包含完整表格，具体三种 backbone 名称、全部 benchmark 数字和各 baseline 差距无法可靠补全。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 Preliminary Studies 中 recognition vs recall 的实验设计，尤其是 benchmark-level 比较、same-fact probes 和 failure-mode analysis。方法部分重点看 RAD 的 loss 定义、OOD anchoring stream 如何采样、base distribution 在 continuation tokens 上如何计算。实验部分优先看三类数字：域内 MedMCQA 是否保持收益，OOD generation 是否恢复，多选 recognition 是否本来就没有明显退化。值得深挖的是它对“遗忘”的重新定义：很多 SFT 后的事实退化可能不是参数中事实消失，而是解码分布、回答格式和指令对齐策略变化导致事实不再被正确引出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode after domain SFT: models may lose the ability to produce factual answers in open-ended closed-book generation even when they can still recognize or rank the correct answer under constrained evaluation. The authors call this factual access failure.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is at the pretrain–posttrain boundary. The paper argues that factual degradation after SFT should not be treated uniformly as knowledge erasure. Some failures are wrong-answer generations, but many are expression-level failures such as verbosity, formatting mismatch, or exact-match artifacts. This distinction matters because erased facts require restoration, while retained but inaccessible facts call for controlling distributional drift during adaptation. The idea is relevant to domain adaptation, continual pretraining, and safety-critical SFT settings where preserving broad factual recall matters.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has a diagnostic part and a mitigation part. The diagnostic compares recognition-style evaluation with open-ended recall. Recognition is measured through multiple-choice or candidate-ranking probes; recall is measured through closed-book generation metrics such as EM and F1. The same-fact probes are important because they hold the underlying fact fixed while changing the elicitation format. The mitigation method, Recall-Anchored Distillation (RAD), adds an unlabeled OOD anchoring stream to the usual supervised target-domain loss. For each OOD prefix-continuation example, the frozen base model provides soft next-token distributions on continuation tokens, and the adapted model is trained to match them. This is a distributional anchor rather than answer replay. It does not require OOD labels, rationales, gold answers, or external judges, and it directly constrains drift from the base model’s open-domain continuation behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments fine-tune three backbones on MedMCQA. The preliminary results show a clear separation between target-domain improvement and open-domain factual recall degradation. One reported example is TriviaQA EM dropping from 65.03 to 43.95 after domain SFT, while MedMCQA and MMLU remain stable or slightly improve. The matched-fact analysis shows that many facts remain selectable in multiple-choice form but fail under open-ended generation. The failure analysis further separates genuine wrong answers from expression failures. RAD is reported to recover OOD factual generation while preserving in-domain gains and outperforming the compared baselines. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so the exact backbone names, all benchmark scores, and full baseline margins cannot be stated reliably.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the Preliminary Studies section, especially the recognition-versus-recall setup, the same-fact probes, and the failure-mode analysis. Then read the RAD objective and the construction of the OOD anchoring stream. In the experiments, check three things: whether MedMCQA gains are preserved, how much OOD generation recovers, and whether recognition was largely retained before RAD. The main point worth taking away is the operational separation between knowledge erasure and failure to elicit retained knowledge.

recommendation.zh: 值得读失败探针和 RAD loss；它把“遗忘”拆成访问失败，能改变你看 SFT 后知识掉点的诊断方式。
recommendation.en: Read the probes and the RAD loss; reframing “forgetting” as access failure changes how SFT-induced factual drops should be diagnosed.

institutions: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
MIIT Key Laboratory of Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence

paper.title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See
paper.abstract: Take three frontier mixture-of-experts models (Alibaba, OpenAI, NVIDIA; 3.6-4.0B active parameters each) and fine-tune them to reason in a low-resource language. On accuracy benchmarks almost nothing happens, and the benchmark itself is noise at this scale: changing only the random seed moves the score by 7.7 points, more than every data and recipe effect we measured. That null is our first result. The real changes live where accuracy cannot see. Base models never think in Greek: 0 of 1,000 reas

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是：低资源语言上的 reasoning fine-tune，若只看一个 accuracy 数字，是否会把真正发生的变化完全看错。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的启发在于，它把一个常被忽略的问题讲得很具体：SFT 和 RL 改变的未必是最终准确率，而可能是推理所用语言、token 开销、难度校准能力，以及遗忘模式。对低资源语言尤其如此，因为 translated benchmark 的噪声、污染和格式效应足以淹没真实差异。这个结论不直接改进 pretrain，但会影响如何评估 multilingual reasoning、如何设计 replay、以及如何判断 post-train 信号是否真的在“教会模型思考”。
summary.technical_approach: 作者固定推理时的活跃参数预算，比较三类稀疏 MoE 家族，在相近 serving cost 下做 Greek reasoning 适配。训练上使用 LoRA，控制在单节点可复现设置内。语料分成两半：一半是带显式推理轨迹的 reasoning 数据，绝大多数为合成 Greek trace；另一半是不带 trace 的通用 instruction 数据，用作 replay，防止非推理能力塌缩。论文的核心不是提出新算法，而是提出一套六维度分析框架，并通过多随机种子、污染检查、格式控制和 recipe 对照，证明 accuracy 在这个场景下不稳定且不够用。文中还单独分析了 direct half 的作用：它保住了 reasoning switch，但也带来了 answer-format 和准确率上的代价。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 15 个独立训练臂，最佳配置在 1000 题 Greek probe 上 think mode 准确率 76.5，而 base 是 77.2，表面上几乎没有提升。更关键的是，只改随机种子，分数就能波动 7.7 点，超过作者此前归因于数据选择、语料构造和训练日程的大多数差异。作者据此把重点转向更稳定的行为指标：模型是否真的用 Greek 推理、推理 token 消耗是否变化、能否区分易题和难题。另一个可复现发现是，去掉 direct half 会让 reasoning switch 崩掉，但保留它又会损伤 accuracy 和答案格式遵循。这个 trade-off 比单次 benchmark 分数更可信，因为它在多训练臂上重复出现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看引言和 setup，理解作者为什么把 active parameter count 而不是 total parameter count 作为公平轴。然后看噪声地板和六维评测定义，这两部分决定了后面所有结论是否站得住。若时间有限，再看 recipe 对照实验，尤其是 direct half / replay 对 reasoning switch 与 answer-format 的影响。预计 25–35 分钟能抓住主要信息。若你关心 multilingual post-train 或 low-resource reasoning eval，这篇值得顺着附录继续看污染检查和 instrument failure。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a single benchmark accuracy number is an adequate way to judge reasoning fine-tuning in a low-resource language, or whether it hides the actual behavioral changes induced by SFT and RL-style adaptation.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is methodological. It shows that in low-resource multilingual reasoning, translated benchmark accuracy can be dominated by seed noise, answer-format artifacts, and contamination, while the meaningful changes happen elsewhere: reasoning language, token budget, difficulty calibration, and forgetting. This does not change pretraining directly, but it matters for the pretrain–posttrain interface, multilingual evaluation, replay design, and for deciding whether a post-training recipe is teaching reasoning or merely changing output style.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup fixes the active-parameter serving budget and compares three sparse MoE families under roughly matched inference cost. Adaptation uses LoRA in a deliberately reproducible single-node regime. The corpus has two halves: a reasoning half with explicit Greek traces, mostly synthetic, and a direct instruction half without traces, reused as replay to preserve general non-reasoning behavior. The contribution is not a new model architecture. It is an evaluation and analysis framework built around six behavioral dimensions, plus a careful set of controls: multiple seeds, contamination checks, answer-format controls, and recipe ablations. A key side finding is that the replay-like direct half preserves the reasoning switch but hurts accuracy and answer-format compliance.
summary_en.experiments: The study runs 15 independently trained arms. On the headline metric, almost nothing improves: the best configuration reaches 76.5 on a 1,000-item Greek probe in think mode, versus 77.2 for the base model. The decisive result is the noise floor: retraining one configuration with only a different random seed changes the score by 7.7 points, larger than most differences the authors had initially attributed to corpus choice or schedule changes. That pushes the analysis toward more stable dimensions: whether the model actually reasons in Greek, how many tokens it spends, and whether it can distinguish easy from hard questions. Another replicated finding is a recipe trade-off: removing the direct half collapses the reasoning switch, while keeping it degrades accuracy and answer-format compliance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction and setup first, especially the decision to compare models by active parameters rather than total parameters. Then read the sections on the six evaluation dimensions and the noise-floor analysis; those sections carry the main argument. If time is limited, jump next to the recipe comparison around the direct-half replay effect, since that is the clearest practical takeaway. About 25–35 minutes is enough for the main story. If multilingual post-training or low-resource reasoning evaluation is your focus, the contamination checks and instrument-failure sections are worth the extra time.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain recipe，但会改你看 post-train 结果的尺子：accuracy 噪声大到盖过 recipe 效应，先看行为维度和语言一致性，再谈低资源推理提升。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining directly, but it should change how you read post-training results: accuracy noise can swamp recipe effects, so inspect behavioral dimensions and reasoning-language alignment before claiming low-resource reasoning gains.

paper.title: Data-DPO: Direct Preference Optimization for Target Model Data Selection in LLM Post-Training
paper.abstract: Data selection in supervised fine-tuning aims to select a small set of effective samples from large-scale candidate data, reducing training cost while preserving model performance. However, existing methods usually treat data value as a relatively static property, and pay limited attention to the compatibility between data and the capability distribution of the target model. To address this issue, we propose Data-DPO, a target model-oriented SFT data selection method. Data-DPO observes the local

summary.core_problem: 为 LLM/VLM 后训练选择更适配目标模型能力分布的 SFT 数据，而不是只按静态质量分数筛样本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练数据选择方法。它强调数据价值不是固定属性，而取决于目标模型当前能力和样本之间的匹配关系；这对 pretrain-to-posttrain 接口、数据 curriculum 和能力定向补齐有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Data-DPO。先对目标模型做 one-step probing，观察不同样本带来的局部训练反馈；再把样本间 activation differences 转成 pairwise data preferences，并训练轻量 reward model 学习 target-model-aware 数据偏好。最终选择阶段同时结合目标模型偏好、外部质量分数和边际多样性，得到更稳定的训练子集。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Vision-Flan 和 LLaVA-CoT 上进行，面向 VLM 指令/推理后训练数据选择。摘要声称 Data-DPO 相比现有选择方法更有效，但给定摘要被截断，未提供具体模型参数量、候选数据规模、baseline 名单或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper selects SFT data that better matches the capability distribution of a specific target LLM/VLM, instead of relying only on static data-quality scores.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training data selection method. It treats data value as target-model-dependent, which is relevant to the interface between pretraining, SFT, curriculum design, and capability-specific data allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Data-DPO. The method performs one-step probing on the target model to observe local training feedback for candidate samples, converts activation differences into pairwise data preferences, and trains a lightweight reward model to learn target-model-aware preferences. Final selection combines target-model preference, external quality scores, and marginal diversity.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on Vision-Flan and LLaVA-CoT for VLM instruction or reasoning post-training data selection. The abstract claims Data-DPO improves selection effectiveness, but the provided text is truncated and does not include model sizes, candidate pool sizes, baseline details, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 读 one-step probing 到 pairwise preference 的构造即可；VLM 结果先当弱证据，但这个 data-model fit 信号值得复现。
recommendation.en: Read the one-step probing to pairwise preference construction; the VLM evidence is limited, but the data-model fit signal is worth reproducing.

paper.title: TRACE: Trajectory Aware Reasoning for Multi-Turn Adversarial Conversation Evaluation
paper.abstract: Multi-turn jailbreak attacks have emerged as a critical safety threat to LLMs, as harmful objectives are decomposed across a sequence of apparently benign turns to bypass guardrails. Existing defenses lack the reasoning capacity to identify evolving manipulation patterns, often trading helpfulness for safety by over-refusing benign requests related to sensitive topics. We introduce Trace, a multi-turn defense with trajectory-aware structured reasoning. Before generating each response, the model

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是多轮 jailbreak 防御中的轨迹理解问题。攻击者会把有害目标拆成多个看似正常的回合，单轮安全分类器或普通安全微调模型容易只看当前用户消息，从而漏掉逐步升级的意图；如果简单提高拒答强度，又会伤害敏感但正当的对话。
summary.importance: 这不是基座预训练方法，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有参考价值。它展示了一个较清晰的训练信号设计：先把安全判断拆成可监督的中间状态，再用 SFT 和 GRPO 联合训练。对基座研究员有用的点在于，安全能力不只是标签分类，也依赖模型能否在长交互轨迹中维护隐含状态、区分 competing hypotheses，并把中间判断稳定地约束到最终回答。这个问题与长上下文训练、对话数据构造、reward 质量和过拒绝控制都有连接。
summary.technical_approach: TRACE 把每一轮 assistant 输出分解为 State 和 Answer。State 包含四部分：从历史轨迹中抽取 manipulation cues；分别构造 benign 和 adversarial 两种用户意图解释，并给出 1 到 10 的 plausibility score；汇总成 1 到 5 的 jailbreak risk score；选择 Allow、Caution 或 Decline 三类动作。cue 集合包含 11 类操纵信号，覆盖社会工程、渐进承诺、上下文伪装等多轮攻击模式。训练数据来自五个多轮攻击框架，覆盖 JailbreakBench 和 HarmBench 中的 300 个 harmful behaviors；同时加入公开 benign 多轮对话和 OR-Bench 种子生成的 harm-adjacent benign dialogs。标注由 frontier LLM 生成完整 reasoning trace。训练分两阶段：先对 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 做 SFT，让模型学会输出结构化 State；再用 GRPO 优化多组件 reward，包括 jailbreak score 准确性、cue detection precision、以及生成回答与目标 action 是否一致。把 harm-adjacent benign 数据放入 GRPO mixture，是为了在每个优化步骤中同时约束安全和过拒绝，而不是训练后再调阈值。
summary.experiments: 论文构建约 4k 多轮对抗对话，并与普通 benign 和 harm-adjacent benign 轨迹配对训练。评测覆盖七个多轮攻击框架，TRACE 在其中六个上取得最低攻击成功率，同时在过拒绝评测上保持较好的合规回答率，并报告对推理、知识和数学类通用能力影响较小。给出的材料没有包含具体 ASR、over-refusal rate 或通用 benchmark 分数，因此不补写数字。实验结论的关键不在单个分数，而在三项对比：只做安全微调但不显式轨迹推理的模型，容易依赖训练分布；单轮 reasoning safety 难以处理跨回合意图累积；加入 harm-adjacent benign 的 RL 混合训练能缓解敏感主题上的过拒绝。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 Method 中 State 的结构化定义，以及 reward 设计。数据部分需要看攻击框架覆盖、harm-adjacent benign 构造方式和标注流程，因为这些决定训练信号是否可靠。实验部分优先看七个多轮攻击框架的 ASR 表、过拒绝评测表、以及 SFT-only、GRPO、去掉 cue 或 dual-hypothesis 的消融。若只关心预训练启发，可重点关注它如何把长对话安全判断转化为可学习的中间变量和可优化 reward。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses multi-turn jailbreak defense. In these attacks, the harmful objective is distributed across a sequence of seemingly benign turns. A single-turn safety model often misses the escalation pattern, while a conservative defense tends to over-refuse legitimate but sensitive conversations.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and safety paper rather than a base pretraining method, but it is still informative for the pretrain-posttrain interface. It turns safety supervision into structured intermediate states and then optimizes those states with SFT and GRPO. The relevant lesson for base-model researchers is that safety behavior depends on whether the model can maintain trajectory state, compare benign and adversarial intent hypotheses, and bind that reasoning to the final response. This connects to long-context training, dialogue data construction, reward quality, and the control of over-refusal.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRACE factorizes each assistant output into a State block and an Answer block. The State contains four components: manipulation cues extracted from the dialogue trajectory; two competing interpretations of user intent, one benign and one adversarial, each with a plausibility score; an aggregated jailbreak risk score from 1 to 5; and a final action among Allow, Caution, and Decline. The cue set contains 11 manipulation primitives covering patterns such as social engineering, gradual commitment, and contextual camouflage. The training corpus combines multi-turn adversarial conversations generated from five attack frameworks over 300 harmful behaviors from JailbreakBench and HarmBench, public benign multi-turn dialogues, and harm-adjacent benign dialogues seeded from OR-Bench. A frontier model annotates each trajectory with the full structured reasoning trace. Training uses Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct in two stages: SFT teaches the model to produce the trace, and GRPO refines it with a multi-part reward for jailbreak-score accuracy, cue-detection precision, and consistency between the selected action and the generated answer.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports roughly 4k multi-turn adversarial conversations, paired with benign and harm-adjacent trajectories. Evaluation covers seven multi-turn attack frameworks. TRACE achieves the lowest attack success rate on six of them, while maintaining compliance on over-refusal benchmarks and showing limited degradation on general reasoning, knowledge, and math evaluations. The supplied content does not include exact ASR, refusal-rate, or benchmark-score numbers, so they should not be inferred. The main empirical point is the comparison against defenses that either fine-tune on safe completions without explicit trajectory reasoning or reason only at the single-turn level. The harm-adjacent benign mixture is also important because it trains safety and non-refusal constraints in the same optimization loop.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the State formulation and reward design carefully. Then check how the adversarial, benign, and harm-adjacent data are constructed and annotated. In the experiments, focus on the attack-success table across the seven multi-turn frameworks, the over-refusal evaluation, and ablations for SFT-only, GRPO, cue extraction, and dual-hypothesis reasoning. For pretraining relevance, the most useful part is how long-dialogue safety judgment is converted into learnable intermediate variables and reward signals.

recommendation.zh: 多轮安全对齐的实用方案，GRPO多组件奖励的设计可参考，重点看奖励函数定义与训练数据构建部分。
recommendation.en: Practical multi-turn safety alignment scheme; the multi-component GRPO reward design and training data construction are worth focused review.

paper.title: Step-Level On-Policy Distillation: Interpolating Between On-Policy Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) aligns a student model with a teacher's logit distribution on student-generated trajectories. This approach has achieved strong empirical gains and can often surpass conventional off-policy distillation with substantially less data. However, standard token-level OPD can provide only fragmented corrections along an erroneous student trajectory and cannot unfold a complete and correct repair path. Motivated by this limitation, we propose \emph{Step-Level On-Policy Dist

summary.core_problem: 标准 token-level on-policy distillation 只能在学生错误轨迹上做碎片化纠正，无法给出完整修复路径。
summary.importance: 提出 SOPD，把 SFT 的长程纠错与 OPD 的 on-policy 优势插值到一个统一目标，属于后训练蒸馏方法的小幅整合。
summary.technical_approach: 在学生生成轨迹上以 step 为粒度提供完整 teacher 响应作为监督；通过调节 step 长度，SOPD 在极限下退化为 SFT 或逼近 OPD，实现两者的连续插值。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模/数据量与数值，仅声称相比 OPD 提供更长程纠正、相比 SFT 更贴合学生访问状态（摘要截断，缺乏结果细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: Token-level on-policy distillation gives only fragmented corrections on erroneous student trajectories rather than full repair paths.
summary_en.importance: Proposes Step-Level On-Policy Distillation (SOPD), interpolating between SFT's long-horizon correction and OPD's on-policy advantage in a single objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: Conditions teacher responses on student-generated trajectories and provides step-level supervision over complete trajectories; varying step length recovers SFT at one limit and approximates OPD at the other.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits concrete model/data scales and numbers; claims better trajectory-level correction than OPD and better state alignment than SFT (abstract truncated, results not detailed).

recommendation.zh: SOPD 本质是把 OPD 和 SFT 做 step 粒度插值，方法干净但实验细节缺失；做 distillation 的人扫一眼 §3 即可，预训练侧相关性有限。
recommendation.en: A clean-looking step-level interpolation between OPD and SFT, but the abstract lacks experimental detail; §3 is enough for distillation folks—limited relevance to pretraining.

paper.title: Approximate Muon with low-rank adapters
paper.abstract: The Muon optimizer shows clear benefits versus alternatives when pretraining neural networks. However, it is used less frequently for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT). One potential reason is that the most common PEFT method, LoRA, does not naturally combine with Muon since it is not mathematically possible to orthogonalize the weight update given by a low-rank parameterization. In this paper, we address this issue by approximating the solution to a relaxed Muon objective in the low-rank s

summary.core_problem: Muon优化器在LLM全参数预训练上表现优于AdamW，但无法直接适配当前主流的参数高效微调方法LoRA——LoRA的低秩参数化无法实现全层权重更新的正交化，现有近似方案（如分别对A/B矩阵做正交化）破坏了Muon保持更新谱平坦的核心设计，部分方案依赖SVD/QR等硬件不友好的矩阵分解，计算开销高。
summary.importance: 该工作解决了Muon优化器落地到LoRA微调、ReLoRA类持续预训练场景的核心适配问题，提出的sMuon不需要昂贵的矩阵分解，和现有硬件的矩阵乘指令高度适配，同时保留了Muon正交化更新的核心优势，对Muon生态的推广、尤其是低资源微调、基于ReLoRA的增量预训练场景有实际应用价值。
summary.technical_approach: 该工作从Muon的原始目标（谱范数下的最速下降，让权重更新的奇异值均匀化）出发，对低秩约束下的Muon目标做一阶线性近似，忽略二阶小项，推导出闭式解：本质是先对全层的低秩更新梯度做正交化，再投影到LoRA的低秩子空间上，避免了现有per-factor Muon分别正交化A/B矩阵导致的全层更新谱畸变问题。进一步推导了等价的纯矩阵乘实现，完全不需要SVD/QR分解，优化器状态占用比AdamW更低，速度和现有per-factor Muon相当，比基于黎曼优化的低秩Muon快30%左右。
summary.experiments: 该工作在4个基座模型（3个AdamW预训练、1个Muon预训练）、11个SFT基准上测试，sMuon在Muon预训练的Moonlight-16B-A3B模型上表现最优，在11个任务中的6个取得最高准确率；在ReLoRA增量预训练实验中，sMuon取得了最低的最终验证困惑度，和黎曼优化方案的最终性能持平，但训练速度快30%；所有Muon类LoRA优化器的表现均优于AdamW LoRA基线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看引言部分对现有LoRA+Muon适配方案缺陷的总结，以及方法部分的一阶近似推导思路，理解为什么直接对A/B矩阵分别做正交化不符合Muon的原始目标；实现部分的纯矩阵乘优化和实验结果可以快速浏览，预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The Muon optimizer delivers consistent gains over AdamW for full-parameter LLM pretraining, but does not natively work with LoRA, the dominant parameter-efficient fine-tuning method: the low-rank parameterization of LoRA makes it mathematically impossible to orthogonalize full-layer weight updates as required by standard Muon. Existing approximate approaches either break Muon's core spectral flattening property (e.g. orthogonalizing LoRA A/B factors separately) or rely on hardware-unfriendly SVD/QR decompositions that add significant compute overhead.
summary_en.importance: This work resolves the core compatibility gap between Muon and LoRA, enabling Muon's spectral normalization benefits to be applied to PEFT and ReLoRA-style continual pretraining workloads. The proposed sMuon optimizer relies exclusively on matmul operations that map efficiently to modern hardware, while preserving Muon's core update properties, lowering the barrier to adopting Muon across both fine-tuning and incremental pretraining pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from Muon's original objective — steepest descent under the spectral norm, which equalizes singular values of the weight update — the work derives a first-order linear approximation of the Muon objective under low-rank constraints, dropping small second-order terms to produce a closed-form solution. The solution effectively orthogonalizes the full-layer gradient of the LoRA update before projecting it onto the low-rank LoRA subspace, avoiding the spectral distortion introduced by per-factor Muon approaches that orthogonalize A and B matrices independently. An equivalent, compute-efficient reformulation is provided that uses only matrix multiplications, eliminating SVD/QR calls entirely, with lower optimizer state overhead than AdamW.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 4 base models (3 AdamW-pretrained, 1 Muon-pretrained) on 11 SFT benchmarks, sMuon delivers the strongest performance on the Muon-pretrained Moonlight-16B-A3B model, achieving top accuracy on 6 out of 11 tasks. In ReLoRA incremental pretraining experiments, sMuon matches the lowest final validation loss achieved by Riemannian optimization-based low-rank Muon, while running ~30% faster. All tested Muon-based LoRA optimizers outperform the AdamW LoRA baseline.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for core design insights. Focus on the introduction's summary of existing LoRA+Muon failure modes, and the method section's first-order approximation derivation to understand why per-factor orthogonalization violates Muon's original design goals. The matmul implementation optimization and experimental results can be scanned quickly. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 解决了Muon与LoRA/ReLoRA的兼容痛点，做参数高效预训练的团队可直接复现sMuon，重点看§3的近似推导
recommendation.en: Solves the compatibility pain point between Muon and LoRA/ReLoRA; teams doing parameter-efficient pretraining can directly reproduce sMuon, focus on §3 approximation derivation.

paper.title: Reasoning for Social Audio-Visual Question Answering: Where Do We Stand?
paper.abstract: Training Multimodal Large Language Models for audio-visual social understanding is a crucial step toward embodied social intelligence. Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has become the dominant approach, with HumanOmniV2 and its IntentBench benchmark as a prominent reference point. In this context, we report three findings. First, IntentBench is highly noisy: $\sim$7% of questions are broken and $\sim$23% are trivially answerable without the video input. We remove the affected questions and releas

summary.core_problem: 评估音频-视频社交问答中的“推理”到底是否来自多模态理解，还是来自噪声数据、文本先验和不干净的 benchmark 设置。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测清理和方法审计。论文指出 IntentBench 存在明显噪声，并显示复杂 CoT 训练在该任务上未必优于简单 SFT，这对多模态后训练和 reasoning benchmark 的可信度有直接提醒。
summary.technical_approach: 作者审计 IntentBench，移除约 7% 损坏问题和约 23% 不需要视频即可回答的问题，发布 IntentBench-Prime。随后比较现有 reasoning fine-tuning 方法与 Vanilla SFT，并进一步测试 text-only prior、caption 替代 video 等设置，检查性能来源。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 Vanilla SFT 在三个 benchmark 上以更低成本匹配或超过现有 reasoning 方法；文本模态本身可学习大量先验，用 caption 替代原视频能达到相近表现。摘要未给出具体模型规模和分数表。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Inria at Univ. Grenoble Alpes、CNRS/LJK 和 University of Twente。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether reasoning gains in social audio-visual QA actually come from multimodal understanding, or from noisy data, text priors, and weak benchmark construction.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and audit contribution. It cleans a prominent benchmark and shows that complex CoT-style training may not beat a simple SFT baseline, which is a useful warning for multimodal reasoning evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors audit IntentBench, remove roughly 7% broken questions and roughly 23% questions answerable without video, and release IntentBench-Prime. They then compare existing reasoning fine-tuning methods against a Vanilla SFT baseline and run text-only and caption-as-video-input controls to locate where performance comes from.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that Vanilla SFT matches or outperforms prior reasoning approaches across three benchmarks at lower cost. It also finds that strong priors can be learned from text alone and that textual captions can perform on par with video input. Model sizes and exact scores are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Inria at Univ. Grenoble Alpes, CNRS/LJK, and the University of Twente.

recommendation.zh: 读数据审计和 text-only control；它不会改 pretrain recipe，但能校准多模态推理 benchmark 的噪声预期。
recommendation.en: Read the dataset audit and text-only controls; it will not change a pretraining recipe, but it calibrates how noisy multimodal reasoning benchmarks can be.

paper.title: When the API Speaks the Wrong Language: Revisiting Post-Training for Multilingual Tool Use
paper.abstract: The reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) for API calling degrades in multilingual settings. A common failure occurs when a model selects the correct tool but generates argument values in an inconsistent language, which we term Argument Language Mismatch (ALM). Although semantically correct, such outputs are operationally invalid and not captured by standard API-calling metrics. We revisit post-training strategies for mitigating ALM and find that, in our benchmark, supervised fine-tuning (

summary.core_problem: 研究多语言 API 调用中模型选对工具但参数值语言不一致的问题，即 Argument Language Mismatch。
summary.importance: 这是后训练与工具调用可靠性工作。贡献在于指出标准 function-calling 指标会漏掉语义正确但运行无效的参数语言错误，并比较 SFT 与 RL 在修复该错误上的收益。对基座研究的间接价值是，它提供了一个训练信号质量案例：结构化奖励不一定比干净监督信号更有效。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义 ALM 失败模式，并重新评估多种 post-training 策略。核心比较包括监督微调，以及带 argument-aware structured reward 的 RL 方法，例如 GRPO。重点是控制工具选择一致时，分析参数语言一致性与端到端 function-call accuracy 的变化。
summary.experiments: 实验在作者的多语言 API-calling benchmark 上进行。摘要称 SFT 是强 baseline，显著提升参数语言一致性和端到端函数调用准确率；在模型选择一致的条件下，SFT 可达到甚至超过更复杂的 RL 方法。摘要未给出模型参数量、数据规模或具体提升数值。
summary.authors_note: Amazon。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies multilingual API calling failures where the model chooses the right tool but emits argument values in the wrong or inconsistent language.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and tool-use reliability paper. Its main contribution is identifying Argument Language Mismatch as an operationally invalid output that standard API-calling metrics can miss, and comparing SFT against RL-based fixes. For pretraining researchers, the indirect lesson is about training-signal quality: structured rewards do not automatically dominate clean supervised data.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define ALM and revisit post-training strategies for multilingual function calling. They compare supervised fine-tuning with RL methods using structured, argument-aware rewards, including GRPO. The analysis separates correct tool selection from argument-language consistency to make the failure mode measurable.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use the authors' multilingual API-calling benchmark. The abstract reports that SFT is a strong baseline, substantially improving argument language consistency and end-to-end function-call accuracy; under consistent model selection, SFT matches or sometimes exceeds more complex RL methods. The provided abstract does not include parameter counts, data size, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 当作后训练信号设计案例即可；重点看 SFT 对 GRPO 的对照，不必深读 API 场景细节。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a training-signal design case; focus on the SFT-versus-GRPO comparison and skip most API-domain details.

paper.title: Evaluation-Conditioned Training: Teaching Models to Generalize to Stronger Oversight Regimes
paper.abstract: Feedback signals used to train Large Language Models (LLMs) are the primary driver of their behavior and our main lever for instilling alignment with human values and objectives. However, a key limitation of current post-training methods is the inability of human annotators and automated reward functions to faithfully capture the feedback we would like to give. We introduce Evaluation-Conditioned Training (ECT), a post-training framework that uses natural language to condition each training samp

summary.core_problem: 当前后训练（SFT/PPO）依赖的人类标注、自动奖励等反馈信号存在系统性偏差，模型易拟合可测代理目标而非真实意图，现有方法无法可靠修正政治偏见、谄媚等系统性对齐失败。
summary.importance: 提出评估条件化的对齐范式，可作为现有后训练方法的插件使用；对预训练的启发是，将数据质量、来源可信度等作为条件信号注入训练，可能帮助模型优先拟合高质量信号，降低数据清洗成本。
summary.technical_approach: ECT为每个训练样本附加自然语言形式的评估者特征/保真度标签，训练模型学习评估条件与输出行为的对应关系；部署时通过输入高保真理想评估者的描述，即可触发符合真实意图的行为，无需训练阶段具备完美反馈。
summary.experiments: 两个小样本控制实验验证效果：一是政治中立性任务中，用带意识形态标签的数据做SFT，部署时用「无偏见」标签可提升回复中立性；二是算术任务中，ECT叠加PPO可减少模型谄媚行为。实验基于Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的LoRA微调，设置标签打乱控制组排除文本添加的干扰。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看引言中对系统性反馈偏差的问题定义，以及方法部分的ECT核心设计逻辑；实验部分重点关注控制组设计，无需深挖实现细节，预计阅读20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current post-training methods (SFT, PPO) rely on systematically biased feedback signals (human annotators, automated rewards, LLM judges), leading models to reward-hack by fitting measurable proxies instead of true intent, and existing approaches cannot reliably correct systematic alignment failures like political bias or sycophancy.
summary_en.importance: ECT introduces an evaluator-conditioned alignment paradigm that works as a plug-in to existing post-training pipelines. For pretraining, it suggests that conditioning training data on explicit quality/source fidelity signals could help models prioritize high-quality patterns and reduce data curation costs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Evaluation-Conditioned Training appends natural language descriptions of evaluator characteristics or fidelity to each training sample, and trains the model to map evaluator conditions to corresponding output behaviors. At deployment, conditioning the model on a description of a high-fidelity ideal evaluator elicits behavior aligned with true intent, even when training feedback is imperfect.
summary_en.experiments: Two small controlled proof-of-concept experiments: first, a political even-handedness task where SFT with ideological evaluator labels, paired with a "UNBIASED" deployment condition, improves response neutrality; second, an arithmetic task where ECT added to PPO reduces sycophantic behavior. Experiments use LoRA fine-tuning on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, with a shuffled-label control group to isolate the effect of added text.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the introduction's framing of systematic feedback bias as a gap unaddressed by existing weak-to-strong generalization. Then review the core ECT design logic in the method section, and the controlled study design (especially the shuffled label control) in experiments. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: ECT 的核心想法干净：训练时显式条件化反馈保真度，部署时挂高保真监控器。对做对齐/后训练的人值得看方法节，看是否能复用到 RLHF pipeline。
recommendation.en: ECT's core idea is clean: explicitly condition on feedback fidelity at train time and on a high-fidelity monitor at deployment. Worth reading the method section if you work on alignment/RLHF pipelines.

paper.title: ToolVision: Learning When and How to Use Visual Tools with Capability-Aligned Supervision
paper.abstract: Thinking with images allows a multimodal model to compensate for limited perception by invoking visual tools through code. Yet the prevailing SFT-then-RL recipe creates a different supervision misalignment at each stage. SFT is expected to teach how to use tools, but trajectories from stronger teachers may succeed through perceptual capabilities that a smaller student cannot reliably reproduce or exploit, causing the student to imitate tool-call patterns without learning how to make them useful.

summary.core_problem: 多模态模型在 SFT-then-RL 流程中学习视觉工具调用时，SFT 阶段存在能力不对齐、RL 阶段 outcome reward 抑制工具使用的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新：把'何时用工具'和'如何用工具'的监督信号分别在 SFT/RL 阶段对齐到学生模型能力。
summary.technical_approach: SFT 阶段用多 agent 搜索候选轨迹，由含学生规模模型的委员会按 stepwise evidence gain 打分剪枝；RL 阶段设计 capability-aligned reward，区分有效但无用的工具调用与真正带来证据增益的调用。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未给出具体模型规模、baseline 与数字，仅描述方法框架。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Linfeng Zhang（上海 AI Lab/通用方向），但需以论文正文为准。

summary_en.core_problem: In SFT-then-RL training of multimodal tool-using agents, SFT trajectories come from stronger teachers whose perception the student cannot reproduce, while outcome-only RL rewards either suppress tool use or reward ineffective calls.
summary_en.importance: Method contribution: capability-aligned supervision that separately addresses 'how' (SFT) and 'when' (RL) to use visual tools.
summary_en.technical_approach: SFT uses a multi-agent trajectory search with a committee including student-scale models scoring stepwise evidence gain; RL uses a shaped reward that distinguishes evidence-gaining tool calls from valid-but-useless ones.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract gives no model sizes, baselines, or quantitative results; framework-level description only.

recommendation.zh: 思路对 post-train 有启发：SFT 数据应按学生能力过滤而非照搬强教师轨迹；但摘要无实验，先看 reward 设计一节即可。
recommendation.en: The 'student-capability-aligned SFT filtering' idea is worth borrowing for post-training; skip until §reward design, no numbers in abstract.

paper.title: ToolArtist: Tool-Using Unified Multimodal Models for Agentic Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models can produce visually compelling images, yet they remain limited on open-world tasks that require complex semantic understanding, multi-step reasoning, and the integration of external world knowledge.
