paper.title: A Few Teacher Steps Go a Long Way: Cost-Efficient On-Policy Data Augmentation for Agent Post-Training
paper.abstract: For LLM agents, supervised fine-tuning is not only about teacher labels' quality, but also about which interaction contexts those labels condition on. Pure behavioral cloning uses full teacher demonstrations, creating a mismatch between teacher-induced contexts seen in training and student-induced contexts encountered at test time. Recent work addresses this mismatch by querying a teacher at contexts reached by the student, often with increasingly elaborate filtering of the teacher's continuatio

summary.core_problem: LLM智能体的有监督微调（SFT）中，纯行为克隆存在分布不匹配问题：训练时的上下文由教师演示生成，测试时的上下文由学生自身决策生成，导致模型性能下降。现有on-policy数据构造方法未在有限教师监督预算下做系统比较，不清楚如何分配教师推理预算才能最大化SFT效果。
summary.importance: 该工作将智能体SFT的数据构造建模为预算分配问题，提供了统一的on-policy数据增强框架，量化了不同数据构造策略的成本效益比。其得出的实用规则（先用纯行为克隆得到初始模型，再用短教师续跑做on-policy增强）对智能体后训练的数据策略有直接指导意义，也可为预训练数据分布对齐的相关研究提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两个成本度量指标：Ci（过滤前的总教师推理成本）和Ctr（每个SFT轮次保留的教师监督训练成本），区分数据生成成本和训练成本。构建统一的on-policy数据增强框架，明确化五个设计维度：rollout策略、切换时间分布、续跑长度、过滤规则、诱导的上下文分布。研究一轮增强的典型设置：先用纯行为克隆训练初始学生模型，再用学生在训练任务上rollout，采样学生诱导的上下文并让教师续跑，最后在原始BC数据加on-policy数据上重新训练。核心变种OP-Short保留所有采样的教师续跑，但限制教师续跑轮数为K，在「覆盖更多学生诱导状态的广度」和「更长教师续跑的深度」之间做权衡。对比基线包括纯BC（预算用于更多完整教师演示）、OP-Success（只保留成功的教师续跑）、OP-Critical（只在学生失败的任务上查询教师）。
summary.experiments: 在三个智能体基准上测试：HotpotQA（带搜索工具的问答）、ALFWorld（文本具身规划）、Terminal-Bench-Dev（命令行编码任务）。关键结果：1）相同监督预算下，OP-Short的表现优于纯BC的规模扩展。2）在HotpotQA上，未过滤的少步续跑根据成本维度的不同，表现持平或超过过滤后的变体。3）ALFWorld和Terminal-Bench-Dev上的最优续跑长度比HotpotQA更大，但增加教师轮数并不会单调提升性能。4）在Terminal-Bench-Dev上，仅用小部分SFT语料且无RL阶段的OP-Short，就能匹配使用完整语料加RL的OpenThoughts-Agent基线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看引言部分的问题定义和成本度量设计，以及实验部分的主要对比结果和各基准上的成本效益曲线，跳过具体实现细节。预计阅读时间20-30分钟。如果要深挖，可以关注统一框架的形式化定义和不同过滤策略的消融实验。

summary_en.core_problem: In LLM agent supervised fine-tuning (SFT), pure behavioral cloning suffers from a distribution mismatch: training contexts are generated by teacher demonstrations, while test-time contexts are produced by the student's own decisions, degrading model performance. Existing on-policy data construction methods lack systematic comparison under limited teacher supervision budgets, leaving unclear how to allocate teacher inference budget to maximize SFT effectiveness.
summary_en.importance: This work frames agent SFT data construction as a budget allocation problem, provides a unified on-policy data augmentation framework, and quantifies the cost-effectiveness of different data construction strategies. Its practical finding — using pure BC for an initial model followed by short teacher continuations for on-policy augmentation — directly guides data strategy for agent post-training, and offers insights for research on pretraining data distribution alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two cost metrics are proposed: Ci (total teacher inference cost before filtering) and Ctr (retained teacher supervision training cost per SFT epoch), which separate data generation cost from training cost. A unified on-policy data augmentation framework is built, explicitly specifying five design dimensions: rollout policy, switch-time distribution, continuation horizon, filtering rules, and induced context distribution. The study focuses on a one-round augmentation setting: first train an initial student with pure BC, then roll out the student on training tasks, sample learner-induced contexts and ask the teacher to continue from them, and finally retrain on the original BC data plus on-policy data. The core variant OP-Short keeps all sampled teacher continuations but caps the number of teacher turns at K, trading off breadth (covering more learner-induced states) and depth (longer teacher continuations). Baselines include Pure-BC (budget spent on more full teacher demonstrations), OP-Success (only keep successful continuations), and OP-Critical (only query teachers on tasks the student fails).
summary_en.experiments: Tested on three agent benchmarks: HotpotQA (QA with search tool), ALFWorld (text-based embodied planning), and Terminal-Bench-Dev (command-line coding tasks). Key results: 1) Under matched supervision budgets, OP-Short outperforms scaling Pure-BC. 2) On HotpotQA, unfiltered few-step continuations match or exceed filtered variants depending on the cost axis. 3) Optimal continuation length on ALFWorld and Terminal-Bench-Dev is larger than on HotpotQA, but adding more teacher turns does not monotonically improve performance. 4) On Terminal-Bench-Dev, OP-Short with a small fraction of the SFT corpus and no RL stage matches the OpenThoughts-Agent baseline that uses the full corpus plus RL.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the problem definition and cost metric design in the introduction, plus main comparison results and cost-effectiveness curves across benchmarks in the experiments section. Skip detailed implementation specifics. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes. For deeper dive, examine the formal definition of the unified framework and ablation studies of different filtering strategies.

recommendation.zh: 把on-policy数据构造形式化为预算分配问题的视角不错，做Agent SFT的可以看§3的形式化框架。
recommendation.en: The perspective of formalizing on-policy data construction as budget allocation is insightful; those working on agent SFT should read §3.

paper.title: Decomposer: Learning to Decompile Symbolic Music to Programs
paper.abstract: Musical performance involves executing a set of high-level musical instructions, yet recovering those instructions from the performance is a challenging inverse problem. We present Decomposer, a post-training framework for symbolic music decompilation: the task of recovering executable, editable music programs from symbolic music. We instantiate the task as MIDI-to-Strudel decompilation, where the model takes symbolic MIDI as input and produces a program in Strudel, a music programming language,

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是低资源程序语言下的“符号音乐反编译”：给定 MIDI，生成可执行、可编辑的 Strudel 程序，并且执行后能尽量还原原始音乐。难点不只是匹配音符，而是在 faithful reconstruction 和 readable program abstraction 之间取平衡；简单逐音符转写很准，但代码不可读、不可编辑。
summary.importance: 这不是通用 LLM 预训练论文，但对 post-training 有清楚启发：当目标可以通过执行器验证时，SFT 可以提供语法和结构 warm start，RL 可以用无标注执行反馈继续提升 grounding。它展示了一个低资源代码/DSL 场景中的训练闭环：先用合成 paired data 学会输出合法程序，再用 execution-based reward 适配真实输入分布。对代码模型、工具调用、程序合成类 RL 数据构造有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: DECOMPOSER 将 MIDI-to-Strudel 建成两阶段后训练框架。第一阶段用合成的 MIDI–Strudel paired data 做 SFT，让模型先学会 Strudel 语法、常见音乐结构和可执行输出格式。第二阶段做 execution-based RL：模型生成 Strudel 程序，执行渲染回 MIDI，再用渲染结果和输入 MIDI 的匹配程度给 faithfulness reward；同时加入 readability reward，避免模型退化为逐音符列表。奖励中显式处理两个目标：一边用 onset/frame/instrument 等指标约束音乐还原，一边用可读性 rubric 鼓励抽象结构。与直接让 frontier LLM zero-shot/ few-shot 生成代码不同，它把“执行后是否还原”变成训练信号；与 heuristic converter 不同，它不追求机械转写，而是用可读性奖励限制不可编辑输出。
summary.experiments: 主实验比较了 heuristic converter、Claude-Opus-4.6、Gemini-3.5-Flash、GPT-5.5、Qwen3-4B/8B base、SFT、SFT+RL。Qwen3 base 几乎不能直接完成任务。SFT 显著提升可执行和可读性，但真实 MIDI 上迁移弱。SFT+RL 后，Qwen3-8B 在 STRUDEL-SYNTH 上达到 Comp 0.99、Onset F1 0.73、Frame F1 0.69、Inst F1 0.72、Rubric 0.74；在 LMD 上达到 Comp 0.99、Onset F1 0.60、Frame F1 0.53、Inst F1 0.58、Rubric 0.61。相对 frontier LLM，LMD 上 Onset F1 提升明显，文中报告 8B 模型相对最佳 frontier LLM 提升 +0.32。相对 heuristic converter，faithfulness 接近，但 rubric 从 0.05/0.09 提升到 0.61–0.74 区间。消融显示 readability 权重 w2 越大，可读性越好但还原度下降，主实验取 w2=0.5；没有 SFT 初始化时，RL 很早停在低奖励退化解，说明 execution RL 需要先把策略放到能编译、能表达结构的区域。泛化实验覆盖 longer LMD、GigaMIDI、NES-MDB、Nottingham；已给出的 Best@5 结果中，STR-SYNTH 上 GPT-5.5 Onset/Rubric 为 0.70/0.37，DECOMPOSER 为 0.86/0.69；LMD <30s 上 GPT-5.5 为 0.44/0.29，DECOMPOSER 为 0.70/0.56。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看方法中的数据构造、execution reward、readability reward 定义，再看 Table 2、Figure 4、Figure 5。Table 2 说明 RL 相对 SFT 的主要收益来自真实分布 grounding；Figure 4 是 reward tradeoff 的关键；Figure 5 说明为什么不能直接从 base model 做 RL。若关注代码模型 RL 或工具执行反馈，值得细看 reward 如何避免“高还原、低抽象”的退化路径。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies symbolic music decompilation: given a MIDI performance, generate an executable and editable Strudel program whose rendering reconstructs the input. The central difficulty is the tradeoff between musical fidelity and program readability. A note-by-note converter can be accurate, but it does not produce useful code.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a core LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to post-training methodology. It gives a concrete example of using execution feedback when paired supervision is scarce: SFT teaches syntax and structure, while RL uses label-free execution signals to improve grounding on real inputs. The pattern is applicable to code generation, DSL synthesis, and tool-based RL settings where outputs can be run and evaluated.
summary_en.technical_approach: DECOMPOSER uses a two-stage post-training pipeline for MIDI-to-Strudel. First, the model is supervised on synthetic MIDI–Strudel pairs, which gives it a workable prior over Strudel syntax and musical abstractions. Then it is optimized with execution-based RL. Generated Strudel programs are rendered back to MIDI, and the render is compared with the input using faithfulness metrics such as onset, frame, and instrument matching. A separate readability reward discourages literal note-list transcriptions and pushes the model toward more abstract, editable programs. This differs from frontier LLM prompting, which lacks task-specific grounding, and from heuristic conversion, which is faithful but tends to produce unreadable transliterations.
summary_en.experiments: The main comparison includes a heuristic converter, Claude-Opus-4.6, Gemini-3.5-Flash, GPT-5.5, and Qwen3-4B/8B with no tuning, SFT, and SFT+RL. Untuned Qwen models perform poorly. SFT improves executability and readability, but transfers weakly to real MIDI. With SFT+RL, Qwen3-8B reaches Comp 0.99, Onset F1 0.73, Frame F1 0.69, Inst F1 0.72, and Rubric 0.74 on STRUDEL-SYNTH; on LMD it reaches Comp 0.99, Onset F1 0.60, Frame F1 0.53, Inst F1 0.58, and Rubric 0.61. The paper reports a +0.32 Onset F1 gain over the best frontier LLM on LMD. Compared with the heuristic converter, DECOMPOSER keeps high reconstruction quality while moving rubric scores from 0.05/0.09 to the 0.61–0.74 range. Ablations show a clear readability–faithfulness tradeoff as the readability weight increases, with w2=0.5 used in the main setting. RL without SFT initialization plateaus at a degenerate low-reward solution, showing that execution feedback needs a syntactic and structural warm start. Generalization experiments cover longer LMD, GigaMIDI, NES-MDB, and Nottingham; reported Best@5 results include STR-SYNTH Onset/Rubric of 0.86/0.69 for DECOMPOSER versus 0.70/0.37 for GPT-5.5, and LMD <30s scores of 0.70/0.56 versus 0.44/0.29.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most LLM researchers. Focus on the synthetic-pair construction, the execution reward, the readability reward, Table 2, Figure 4, and Figure 5. Table 2 shows where RL helps beyond SFT. Figure 4 is the main evidence for the reward tradeoff. Figure 5 is useful for understanding why direct RL from a base model fails in low-resource executable-generation tasks.

recommendation.zh: 低资源结构化输出任务的后训练参考，合成数据+RL的组合思路可借鉴，无需深读正文
recommendation.en: Post-training reference for low-resource structured output tasks; synthetic data + RL combo is worth noting, no deep read required

paper.title: CLAP: Closed-Loop Training, Evaluation, and Release Control for Domain Agent Post-training
paper.abstract: Domain agents often face noisy business data, uncertain post-training gains, offline/application mismatch, and adapter-release risk. This paper presents CLAP (Closed-Loop Agent Post-training), a closed-loop method that converts business data into structured SFT samples, decision-preference samples, holdout sets, risk diagnostics, and release-gate records. CLAP combines data validation, target/evidence normalization, reward/KL diagnosis, offline gates, and application-chain replay to decide wheth

summary.core_problem: 领域 Agent 后训练面临业务数据噪声、离线收益不确定、离线-线上 mismatch 与 LoRA 适配器发布风险，缺乏闭环质量管控机制。
summary.importance: 工程系统贡献：提出领域 Agent 后训练的闭环管控流程，覆盖数据构造、诊断、离线门禁与线上回放验证全链路。
summary.technical_approach: CLAP 闭环方法：将业务数据转化为结构化 SFT 样本、决策偏好样本、留出集、风险诊断项与发布门禁记录；融合数据校验、目标/证据归一化、reward/KL 诊断、离线门禁与应用链回放，判断适配器是否可上线。
summary.experiments: 在 5 组匿名制造场景批次上测试：QLoRA 式 LoRA-SFT 平均总分提升 0.0098、通过率提升 0.0240、证据准确率提升 0.0280，幻觉与错误事实下降；仅 3/5 批次有提升，部分批次退化，GRPO 暴露高 KL 风险；同等 3B 骨干下应用链回放显示 RAG 对事实抽取必要。

summary_en.core_problem: Domain agent post-training faces noisy business data, uncertain offline gains, offline-online mismatch, and LoRA adapter release risks, with no closed-loop quality control mechanism available.
summary_en.importance: Engineering system contribution: proposes a closed-loop control pipeline for domain agent post-training, covering data construction, diagnosis, offline gating, and online replay verification end-to-end.
summary_en.technical_approach: CLAP closed-loop method: converts business data into structured SFT samples, decision-preference samples, holdout sets, risk diagnostics, and release-gate records; combines data validation, target/evidence normalization, reward/KL diagnosis, offline gates, and application-chain replay to decide adapter release eligibility.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 5 anonymized manufacturing batches: QLoRA-style LoRA-SFT yields average gains of 0.0098 overall score, 0.0240 pass rate, 0.0280 evidence accuracy, with reduced hallucination and wrong facts; only 3/5 batches improve, some regress, GRPO exposes high KL risks; application-chain replay under the same 3B backbone shows RAG is necessary for factual extraction.

recommendation.zh: 领域 Agent 后训练的工程化管控经验，GRPO 高 KL 风险的观察可做弱信号，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Engineering control experience for domain agent post-training; the high KL risk observation for GRPO serves as weak signal, no deep reading needed.

paper.title: Mastermind: Strategy-grounded Learning for Repository-Scale Vulnerability Reproduction
paper.abstract: Repository-level vulnerability reproduction is a demanding software engineering (SE) task: an agent must inspect a codebase, infer the input grammar that reaches a vulnerable path, construct a proof-of-conceptv(PoC), and verify that the crash disappears on the patched build. Recent LLM agents can often execute these steps when the approach is correct, yet they still fail by choosing the wrong strategy. This paper argues that strategy, rather than the full action trajectory, is the right learning

summary.core_problem: 解决仓库级漏洞复现任务中LLM智能体因策略选择错误导致失败的问题，提升复杂软件工程任务的规划能力。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出将可迁移策略而非完整动作轨迹作为软件工程智能体的学习单元，结合SFT与GRPO实现策略复用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Mastermind双循环框架：可训练规划器通过SFT和基于里程碑的GRPO学习可复用的漏洞复现策略；经验循环维护任务局部策略记录，指导后续尝试；将策略学习与任务特定经验分离，实现跨尝试的策略迁移。
summary.experiments: 面向仓库级漏洞复现任务，对比现有LLM智能体基线，通过策略复用提升任务成功率。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the high failure rate of LLM agents in repository-level vulnerability reproduction caused by incorrect strategy selection in complex software engineering tasks.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing transferable strategy (rather than full action trajectory) as the learning unit for SE agents, combining SFT and GRPO for strategy reuse.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Mastermind, a dual-loop framework: a trainable planner learns reusable vulnerability-reproduction strategies via SFT and milestone-based GRPO; an experience loop maintains task-local strategy records to guide subsequent attempts, separating transferable strategy learning from task-specific experience.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on repository-level vulnerability reproduction tasks, improving success rate over existing LLM agent baselines via strategy reuse.

recommendation.zh: 软件工程智能体的策略学习思路有一定参考性，关注GRPO在长程规划中的用法即可，无需深读正文。
recommendation.en: The strategy learning formulation for SE agents has some reference value; focus on the GRPO usage for long-horizon planning only.

paper.title: The Model Organism Lottery: Model Organism Interpretability Strongly Depends on Training Methodology
paper.abstract: Model organisms (MOs) - language models trained to exhibit undesired or unnatural behaviours - are frequently used as testbeds for evaluating white-box interpretability techniques. Current MOs are typically constructed via post-hoc supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on behavioural transcripts or synthetic documents. Prior research has shown that interpretability methods can easily identify hidden behaviours in these MOs. However, recent work suggests that such post-hoc training methods may make interp

summary.core_problem: 当前用于白盒可解释性技术评测的主流测试集是模型有机体（Model Organism, MO）——即被刻意训练出特定目标行为的语言模型。现有MO几乎都通过窄域后处理监督微调构造，这类MO上测得的可解释性结果能否外推到常规训练中自然涌现的行为，以及MO构造方法对可解释性评测结果的影响程度，此前没有系统研究。
summary.importance: 结果说明基于窄域SFT构造MO的基准得到的可解释性结果普遍偏乐观，无法可靠代表方法在真实模型上的表现。更重要的是，工作提供了明确证据：相同的外在行为可以由完全不同的内部表征支撑，训练方式（后处理SFT/DPO/融入正式后训练流程）对表征结构的影响远大于行为层面的相似性，这对理解post-training如何修改模型内部表征、设计更可靠的对齐评测方法都有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构造了严格控制变量的MO测试集，共54个模型，基于OLMo2-1B和Gemma-3-1b-it两个底座，覆盖三类良性触发-反应行为：烘焙错误事实、食物语境下的意大利餐偏好、军事语境下的潜艇话题执念。每类行为下分别用7种训练方式构造MO变体：标准后处理转录蒸馏（TD）、合成文档微调（SDF），两种方法分别设置加/不加无关通用数据混合的版本；后处理DPO，同样设置加/不加通用数据混合的版本；以及更贴近真实流程的集成式训练：将行为相关数据直接混入OLMo原生的DPO后训练阶段共同训练。所有MO都校准到相同的行为触发率和反应强度，且控制行为不会泄露到无关语境。之后用四类主流白盒可解释性方法（激活预言机、基于激活差的引导、logit lens方法、稀疏自编码器）测试每个MO中植入行为的可检测程度，控制变量对比训练方法、行为类型、模型架构的影响。
summary.experiments: 核心结果包括三点：第一，外在行为完全匹配的MO，仅因训练方式不同，可解释性方法的检测成功率差异可达1.2-20.4倍；第二，传统窄域后处理SFT构造的MO可检测性最高，即最容易被解释，而最贴近真实后训练流程的集成式DPO构造的MO可检测性显著最低；第三，不同可解释性方法在不同训练方式MO上的表现排序，在不同行为类型、不同模型架构之间没有一致的泛化性，即一个方法在某类MO上表现好，不代表在其他训练方式得到的MO上同样有效。结果对训练随机性、数据顺序鲁棒，不是随机波动导致。全部54个MO、训练数据和代码已开源。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注核心结论部分——相同外在行为在不同训练方式下的内部表征可解释性差异，以及对现有MO基准有效性的讨论，这部分对理解post-training对表征的影响最有价值。各类MO的具体训练超参数、可解释性方法的实现细节可以跳过，如果做可解释性相关工作，再参考3.3节的集成式MO构造方法和3.4节的行为匹配控制流程。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Model organisms (MOs) — language models intentionally trained to exhibit specific target behaviors — are the standard testbed for white-box interpretability evaluation. Nearly all existing MOs are built via narrow post-hoc supervised fine-tuning, and it remains untested whether interpretability results on these artificial MOs generalize to behaviors that emerge during regular model training, or how strongly MO construction methodology affects measured interpretability performance.
summary_en.importance: Results show that interpretability benchmarks built on narrow SFT MOs produce consistently overoptimistic results, and do not reliably predict method performance on models trained via more realistic pipelines. Beyond implications for interpretability evaluation, the work provides clear evidence that identical observable behavior can be supported by drastically different internal representations: training methodology (post-hoc SFT / DPO / integrated post-training) has a far larger effect on representational structure than surface-level behavioral similarity. This is relevant to understanding how post-training modifies model internals, and to designing more robust alignment evaluation protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach: A controlled suite of 54 MOs is constructed on OLMo2-1B and gemma-3-1b-it bases, covering three benign trigger-reaction quirks: false cake baking facts, Italian food preference in food contexts, and submarine fixation in military contexts. For each quirk, 7 training variants are produced: standard post-hoc transcript distillation and synthetic document fine-tuning (each with and without unrelated general data mixing), post-hoc DPO (with and without general data mixing), and a novel integrated construction method that inserts quirk data directly into OLMo’s official DPO post-training pipeline. All MOs are calibrated to identical quirk trigger rates and response strength, with controls to prevent quirk leakage into irrelevant contexts. Four standard white-box interpretability techniques (activation oracles, activation difference steering, logit lens, sparse autoencoders) are used to measure quirk detectability across all MOs under controlled conditions.
summary_en.experiments: Three core findings emerge: First, MOs with identical observable behavior exhibit 1.2–20.4× variation in quirk detectability, driven solely by training method. Second, standard narrow post-hoc SFT MOs are the most easily interpretable, while integrated DPO MOs (closest to realistic post-training pipelines) are consistently the least detectable. Third, performance rankings of interpretability methods across training protocols do not generalize across quirk types or model architectures, meaning strong performance on one MO variant does not predict performance on others. Results are robust to training nondeterminism and data ordering, and are not explained by random variation. All 54 MOs, training data, and code are open-sourced.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the core result that behaviorally identical models have drastically different interpretability based on training method, and the discussion of limitations in current MO benchmark design — these are the most relevant insights for understanding post-training representational changes. Skim detailed training hyperparameters and interpretability method implementation details unless actively building interpretability benchmarks; if so, refer to Section 3.3 for the integrated MO construction method and Section 3.4 for the behavioral matching control protocol. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 重要的方法论警示——模型生物的构造方法会严重影响可解释性实验结果，做机制研究的研究员需要注意MO构造的效度问题，重点看§4的实验结果。
recommendation.en: Important methodological warning—MO construction methods heavily affect interpretability experiment results; researchers doing mechanism studies need to be aware of MO validity issues; focus on §4 experimental results.

paper.title: Towards Physical Intuitions for Alignment Dynamics: A Case Study With Randomness Crystallization
paper.abstract: The alignment of language models is typically studied through the lens of capability benchmarks, but the dynamics of how models change during post-training remain poorly understood. We argue that the physical sciences, and thermodynamic phase-transition theory in particular, offer a principled and underexplored vocabulary for reasoning about these dynamics. As a case study, we instantiate this position through the lens of material Crystallization, which is a well-studied thermodynamic phase tran

summary.core_problem: 论文关注的不是对齐后模型在某个 benchmark 上变强或变弱，而是 post-training 过程中行为分布如何发生结构性变化。作者用“随机数生成”等有限输出空间任务作为显微镜，研究 base model、SFT、DPO/RL 各阶段如何把原本高熵、prompt-sensitive 的输出分布压缩成稳定、低熵、近似确定的行为模式。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的价值在于给 pretrain-posttrain 接口提供了一个可检验的动态视角。核心观察是：SFT 可能已经决定了后续对齐的主要行为支撑集，DPO/RL 更多是在这个支撑集上重新分配概率质量，而不是自由地发现新行为。对基座研究员而言，这提示了两个问题：第一，base model 中潜伏的多个输出分布会被怎样的 SFT 数据“选中”；第二，后续 RL 能改多少，可能受限于 SFT 形成的吸引子。贡献更偏机制分析和研究框架，不是直接给出新的训练 recipe，但对理解 alignment dynamics 有实用意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把物理结晶过程映射到 LLM 对齐动态。类比中，base model 是“液相”：同一个随机任务在不同 prompt 下可以诱导出多种分布，熵较高，prompt sensitivity 强。SFT 是“成核”：模型输出分布突然塌缩到一个 seed distribution，这个 seed 不是凭空产生，而是已经存在于 base model 的潜在行为集合中。DPO/RL 是“settling/tempering”：概率进一步集中到 SFT 成核后的峰值附近，但通常不跳出 SFT 创建的支撑集。与常见的 mode collapse 描述不同，论文试图回答 collapse 发生在什么时候、为何落到某个分布、后续阶段还能否改写它。实验选择有限支持集任务，是因为可以直接比较完整输出分布；作者也明确指出该版本框架在大输出空间和开放式生成上会失效，需要更丰富的分布度量。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 15 个随机性任务，在 OLMo 2 和 Tulu 3 这两类公开且具有完整训练阶段 checkpoint 的模型上检查对齐轨迹。关键现象包括：base 阶段存在多个可由 prompt 诱导的随机输出分布；SFT 后 prompt 间差异迅速减小，输出分布塌缩到某个已有 seed；DPO/RL 阶段继续降低熵并强化高概率输出，但很少改变 SFT 后形成的主要支撑集。论文还报告了不同 LLM 之间可能共享 seed distribution 的现象，说明某些随机任务上的“偏好晶核”可能来自预训练语料、tokenization、数字频率或通用指令格式，而不只是某个 post-training recipe 的偶然产物。负结果同样重要：当输出空间变大或任务变成开放式生成时，简单的有限支持集分布比较不够用，结晶框架需要新的距离度量和结构化行为表征。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 和 Section 2，它们定义了液相、成核、settling 三阶段，并说明为什么随机任务适合作为观测窗口。实验部分重点看 15 个 stochastic tasks 上跨 checkpoint 的分布曲线、熵变化、prompt sensitivity 变化，以及 SFT 与 DPO/RL 的阶段差异。值得深挖的是两点：一是 seed distribution 如何在 base model 中被识别，二是 DPO/RL 是否真的受 SFT 支撑集约束。局限性部分也要看，因为作者承认有限输出任务与开放式生成之间还有距离，这决定了该框架能否扩展到更真实的 alignment 行为分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how model behavior changes during post-training, rather than only measuring the final aligned model on capability benchmarks. It uses finite-support stochastic tasks, such as random digit generation, to observe how a pretrained model with many prompt-dependent output distributions becomes a low-entropy, stable, and nearly deterministic aligned model.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a testable account of the pretrain-to-posttrain transition. The key claim is that SFT can already select the behavioral support that later alignment stages operate on, while DPO or RL mostly sharpens probability mass within that support. For pretraining researchers, this matters because it links latent distributions in the base model to the attractors selected by post-training data. It also suggests that the controllability of RL may be bounded by earlier supervised fine-tuning. The contribution is conceptual and diagnostic rather than a new training algorithm, but it gives a useful language for studying alignment dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors map LLM alignment dynamics to physical crystallization. The pretrained model corresponds to a liquid phase: high entropy, many degrees of freedom, and strong prompt sensitivity. SFT acts as nucleation: output distributions collapse abruptly onto a seed distribution that was already latent in the base model. DPO and RL act more like settling or tempering: they concentrate probability on the peaks created by SFT without typically escaping the support selected during nucleation. This goes beyond the usual observation of mode collapse by asking when collapse happens, why a particular distribution is selected, and how much later optimization can still change. The focus on finite-support tasks is deliberate, because complete output distributions can be measured and compared directly.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study covers 15 stochastic tasks and uses public training trajectories from OLMo 2 and Tulu 3, where checkpoints are available across the alignment pipeline. The main findings are consistent across the two model families: base models expose multiple promptable distributions; after SFT, prompt sensitivity largely disappears and behavior collapses onto a single seed-like distribution; DPO and RL further reduce entropy and sharpen the dominant outputs but rarely move outside the support induced by SFT. The paper also reports that seed distributions can be shared across different LLMs, which points to sources such as pretraining data, tokenization, frequency effects, or common instruction formats. The authors also document where the current framework breaks down: large output spaces and open-ended generation require richer metrics than direct finite-support distribution comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction and Section 2 carefully, because they define the liquid, nucleation, and settling phases and make the crystallization analogy operational. In the experiments, focus on figures or tables that track output distributions, entropy, and prompt sensitivity across checkpoints. The most useful details are the SFT transition and the comparison between SFT and DPO/RL. The limitations are also important: the finite-support setting makes the evidence clean, but extending the framework to open-ended generation will require better behavioral distance metrics and more structured representations.

recommendation.zh: 相变视角解释SFT/RL对预训练分布的作用机制，SFT仅坍缩已有模式的结论值得立刻在内部消融复现。
recommendation.en: Proposes a phase-transition view of alignment; the claim that SFT only collapses existing pretrain modes deserves immediate internal replication.

paper.title: NebulaExp-8B: An Empirical Post-Training Pipeline via Full-Scale Ablation Research
paper.abstract: Post-training alignment determines the reasoning and human preference following capabilities of large language models, yet most existing works withhold detailed data construction, filtering rules and training recipes, which hinders community reproducibility and lightweight model optimization. This work presents NebulaExp, a fully transparent, ablation-driven post-training pipeline built on Qwen3-8B-base, covering two orthogonal model branches: general instruct model and complex reasoning-special

summary.core_problem: NebulaExp-8B 关注 8B 级开源基座模型的可复现 post-training recipe：在缺少公开数据过滤规则、训练配方和系统消融的情况下，如何把 Qwen3-8B-base 分别训练成通用指令模型和复杂推理模型。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在模型结构，而在 pretrain 到 posttrain 的接口。它把 SFT 数据、可验证 RL 数据、难度分级、任务分类、教师蒸馏和多维过滤放在同一个流水线里做消融，有助于理解小中型基座模型的能力主要受哪些后训练信号限制。对做 base model 的人，重点是观察：哪些能力可以靠后训练补齐，哪些能力仍然依赖预训练语料和基座能力上限。
summary.technical_approach: 方法围绕两条分支展开：一条是 general instruct branch，用于提升指令跟随、通用问答、代码和常识能力；另一条是 reasoning-specialized branch，用于强化数学、代码、科学和逻辑推理。数据侧从 3.84M 多来源 SFT 样本和 200K 可验证 RL 候选池出发，经过教师模型响应蒸馏、规则过滤、模型打分、交叉验证、任务分类、难度分级和多样性控制。训练侧采用分阶段 post-training，而不是只做一次 SFT 或单一偏好优化。全文给出的动机是把 DeepSeek-R1 式 cold-start、reasoning distillation、rejection sampling、GRPO 等思路拆成可消融模块，观察各模块对 8B 模型的边际收益。
summary.experiments: 已给出的关键信息包括：基座为 Qwen3-8B-base；原始 SFT 语料规模为 3.84M；可验证 RL 候选池为 200K；评测覆盖 IFEval、LiveCodeBench、Math-500、AIME’25、GPQA-Diamond、MMLU-Redux、AutoLogi、ZebraLogic 等指令、代码、数学、科学和逻辑任务。由于提供的全文片段主要是引言，具体训练轮次、batch、学习率、各阶段数据配比、RL 算法细节和消融数字无法确认。阅读时应特别检查后续实验表是否把数据过滤、难度分级、蒸馏、拒绝采样和 RL 阶段分别拆开报告，而不是只给最终模型分数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–40 分钟。重点看三部分：数据构建流程图和过滤规则；训练 pipeline 的阶段划分；全量消融表。若时间有限，先看数据规模、过滤后保留率、不同任务类型配比，以及 general instruct 与 reasoning branch 的差异。最值得深挖的是可验证 RL 候选池的构造方式，因为这决定了强化学习阶段是在学习真实可验证信号，还是在放大教师模型偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: NebulaExp-8B studies how to build a reproducible post-training pipeline for an 8B open base model, using Qwen3-8B-base as the starting point and producing both a general instruction model and a reasoning-specialized model.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining is the interface between base-model capability and post-training signals. The work is useful if its ablations isolate how much instruction following, reasoning, coding, and preference behavior can be induced after pretraining, and where the base model still sets the ceiling. Its value is less about a new optimizer and more about exposing data construction and stage-wise training choices that are often hidden in model releases.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline starts from a 3.84M-sample multi-source SFT corpus and a 200K verifiable RL candidate pool. It uses teacher response distillation, rule-based filtering, model-based scoring, cross-verification, task classification, difficulty grading, and diversity control before training. The design separates a general instruction branch from a complex reasoning branch, instead of forcing a single recipe to serve both use cases. The framing follows the recent shift from plain SFT or static preference optimization toward staged recipes that combine cold-start data, reasoning distillation, rejection sampling, and verifiable RL-style training.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content confirms the base model, data scales, and evaluation scope: Qwen3-8B-base, 3.84M raw SFT samples, 200K verifiable RL candidates, and benchmarks including IFEval, LiveCodeBench, Math-500, AIME’25, GPQA-Diamond, MMLU-Redux, AutoLogi, and ZebraLogic. The available full-text excerpt does not expose the detailed numerical ablations, learning-rate schedule, batch size, training length, filtering retention rate, or per-stage gains. Those details are necessary to judge whether the pipeline gives reusable engineering guidance or mainly reports a final aligned checkpoint.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–40 minutes. Focus on the data processing pipeline, the split between the general and reasoning branches, and the ablation tables. The most important checks are the filtering criteria, data retention rates, task mixture after filtering, and whether the RL candidate pool is genuinely verifiable. If the paper reports per-stage deltas for distillation, filtering, rejection sampling, and RL, those tables are the most useful part for base-model researchers.

recommendation.zh: 读消融表，不必迷信模型名；若过滤规则写得足够细，可直接转成内部 posttrain 数据质检 checklist。
recommendation.en: Read the ablation tables, not the model branding; if the filters are specified cleanly, they can become a post-training data QA checklist.

paper.title: Soft Token Alignment for Cross-Lingual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Multilingual large language models often produce inconsistent reasoning and answers for semantically equivalent prompts in different languages. Prior work suggests that intermediate representations can be relatively language-agnostic, but generation becomes increasingly language-specific as models commit to discrete output tokens. This is problematic because language-specific lexical choices can cause semantically equivalent reasoning paths to diverge across languages. These divergences motivate

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理多语言推理中的一致性问题：语义相同的不同语言 prompt，模型可能给出不同推理路径和不同答案。作者把问题定位在生成后段的离散 token 选择上：中间层语义可能已经对齐，但最终层要落到具体语言和文字系统，概率分布被压成某个离散 token 后，推理轨迹开始分叉。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于语言建模接口，而不只是多语言 SFT 技巧。SOLAR 用 next-token distribution 的 embedding expectation 作为对齐对象，相当于在“隐状态”和“离散 token”之间取了一个连续的软 token 表示。这个信号更贴近 LM 的输出分布，又比具体 token identity 更少受语言脚本影响。它提示一个方向：跨语言、跨模态或 reasoning trace 对齐时，不一定只能对齐 hidden states 或最终文本，也可以对齐模型在词表上的软决策。这对 tokenizer 共享不足、低资源语言推理不稳、以及连续 reasoning 表示都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: SOLAR 是 SFT 阶段的辅助目标。给定英文和非英文的平行 reasoning trace，模型先按常规自回归方式得到每个位置的 next-token distribution。然后把这个分布投到 embedding matrix 上，计算概率加权的 embedding expectation，形成 soft-token representation。作者再对一个 trace 内多个位置做 mean pooling，得到单个连续向量。训练时以英文为 pivot，最小化英文向量和各非英文向量之间的 cosine distance，同时保留标准 SFT loss。它和 inference-time soft thinking 的区别在于：soft thinking 主要在解码时把软 token 作为下一步输入，SOLAR 则把软 token 改造成训练期的跨语言对齐信号。它也不同于直接对齐离散答案或 token 序列，因为同一语义在中文、泰语、日语、泰卢固语等脚本中没有稳定的一一 token 对应。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B，在多个多语言推理 benchmark 上比较 base、常规 SFT、inference-time soft thinking 和 SOLAR。对 Qwen3-4B，SOLAR 相比 SFT 在 AIME 2024 上 accuracy 最高提升 +3.8，cross-lingual consistency 最高提升 +4.5，低资源语言如 Swahili 的收益更明显。表示分析显示，base model 的 soft token 在 final layer 上比 discrete token 带有更强的跨语言信号；经过 SOLAR 后，final-layer cross-lingual alignment 明显强于 SFT 和仅推理期 soft thinking。行为分析也检查了一个重要副作用：模型是否会被英文 pivot 拉向英文输出。MGSM 上，SOLAR-tuned Qwen3-4B 使用目标语言脚本推理的比例为 98.13%，接近 base 的 98.81%；SOLAR-tuned Qwen3-8B 为 98.16%。这也修正了 base 8B 在部分非中文语言上退化到英文推理的问题，其中 Ja/Th/Te 低于 5%，四语言平均只有 27.43%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中关于 final-layer language specialization 的假设；然后读 SOLAR 方法部分，重点确认 soft token 的定义、top-k 或温度处理、mean pooling 位置、cosine alignment loss 以及它和 SFT loss 的权重关系。实验部分建议优先看 AIME 2024 和 MGSM 的 accuracy/consistency/native-script 三类结果，因为它们分别对应能力、一致性和语言保持。表示分析值得多看几眼，尤其是 soft token 与 discrete token 在 final layer 对齐强度上的差异。若要复现，最需要核查的是平行 CoT 数据质量、英文 pivot 是否引入答案风格偏置，以及 alignment loss 过强时是否损害目标语言表达。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses inconsistent reasoning in multilingual LLMs: semantically equivalent prompts in different languages can lead to different reasoning paths and different answers. The proposed explanation is that intermediate representations may be relatively language-agnostic, while the final generation stage becomes language- and script-specific when the model commits to discrete output tokens.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is the modeling interface between hidden states and discrete tokens. SOLAR uses the expected embedding under the next-token distribution as an alignment target. This representation is closer to the language model’s output decision than a generic hidden state, but less tied to a particular token identity or writing system than the generated text. The idea is useful beyond multilingual SFT: when aligning reasoning traces across languages, tokenizers, or modalities, the soft decision distribution can be a meaningful training signal instead of aligning only hidden states or final strings.
summary_en.technical_approach: SOLAR is an auxiliary objective used during supervised fine-tuning. For parallel reasoning traces in English and non-English languages, the model computes the next-token distribution at each autoregressive position. That distribution is mapped into the embedding space by taking a probability-weighted expectation over the vocabulary embedding matrix, producing a soft-token representation. The representations are mean-pooled over positions to obtain one continuous vector for the trace. English is used as the pivot, and SOLAR minimizes cosine distance between the English vector and each non-English counterpart while retaining the standard SFT loss. This differs from inference-time soft thinking, which feeds soft tokens back during decoding; SOLAR instead uses soft tokens as a training-time cross-lingual alignment signal. It also avoids requiring token-level correspondence across scripts, which is fragile for languages such as Chinese, Thai, Japanese, and Telugu.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across multilingual reasoning benchmarks, comparing regular SFT, inference-time soft thinking, and SOLAR. For Qwen3-4B, SOLAR improves accuracy by up to +3.8 over SFT and cross-lingual consistency by up to +4.5 on AIME 2024, with larger gains on lower-resource languages such as Swahili. Representation analysis shows that soft tokens carry a stronger final-layer cross-lingual signal than discrete tokens in base models, and that SOLAR produces stronger final-layer alignment than SFT or inference-time soft thinking alone. The behavioral checks are also important: SOLAR does not simply force English reasoning. On MGSM, SOLAR-tuned Qwen3-4B reasons in the target script 98.13% of the time, close to the base model’s 98.81%; SOLAR-tuned Qwen3-8B reaches 98.16%. This also fixes a base 8B failure mode where reasoning collapses to English for several non-Chinese languages, with Ja/Th/Te below 5% and a four-language average of 27.43%.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the motivation around final-layer language specialization. Then read the SOLAR method carefully: the definition of soft tokens, any top-k or temperature choices, the pooling operation, the cosine alignment loss, and how it is weighted against SFT. In the experiments, focus on AIME 2024 and MGSM because they separate accuracy, cross-lingual consistency, and preservation of target-language reasoning. The representation analysis is the most informative part for modeling researchers, especially the comparison between soft-token and discrete-token alignment at the final layer. For reproduction, check the quality of parallel CoT data, whether the English pivot introduces style bias, and whether too much alignment pressure harms target-language fluency.

recommendation.zh: 想做“跨语言推理一致性”时，这个soft-token对齐损失比对齐离散token更像正解；但要重点审计对齐配对与解码控制，否则提升可能是评测噪声。
recommendation.en: If you care about cross-lingual reasoning consistency, soft-token alignment is the right abstraction vs. discrete token matching; scrutinize pairing quality and decoding controls, or the gains may be evaluation noise.

paper.title: Helpfulness Hurts: Domain-Dependent Degradation of Mid-Trained Compassion Values Under Post-Training
paper.abstract: Standard post-training pipelines apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) to make language models helpful, but these processes may inadvertently degrade values instilled during pre-training. We investigate whether the domain of post-training data differentially affects the retention of animal compassion values in a Llama 3.1 8B model mid-trained on compassion-oriented synthetic data, using both SFT (helpfulness via Dolly-15k vs. coding via Magicoder-110K) and GRPO (help

summary.core_problem: 研究 SFT 和 RL 这类 post-training 是否会破坏模型在 mid-training 阶段注入的特定价值偏好，尤其是动物关怀相关价值。
summary.importance: 贡献是 pretrain/mid-train 与 post-train 接口上的干扰分析。虽然主题很窄、机构和实验规模有限，但它触及一个实际问题：后训练数据域会覆盖或重写早期训练中形成的偏好与价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以一个经过 compassion-oriented synthetic data mid-training 的 Llama 3.1 8B 为起点，比较两类后训练数据：通用 helpfulness 数据与 coding 数据。SFT 使用 Dolly-15k 与 Magicoder-110K，GRPO 使用 RLHFlow helpfulness 数据与 Magicoder coding 数据，并在动物伤害与道德推理基准上测量价值保留。
summary.experiments: 模型为 Llama 3.1 8B。AHB 2.2 上，helpfulness 训练相对 coding 训练显著降低动物关怀表现：SFT 为 35.7% vs. 65.2%，GRPO 为 18.7% vs. 32.0%。英文 MORU 项上，helpfulness 训练将一般道德推理表现从 71.9% 降至 46.4%，下降 25.5 个百分点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether SFT and RL post-training can erode values injected during mid-training, focusing on animal-compassion preferences.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an interference analysis at the mid-train/post-train interface. The topic is narrow and the lab setting is not a major foundation-model effort, but the question is relevant: downstream post-training domains can overwrite preferences established earlier in training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from a Llama 3.1 8B model mid-trained on compassion-oriented synthetic data, the paper compares helpfulness-oriented post-training with coding-oriented post-training. SFT uses Dolly-15k versus Magicoder-110K, while GRPO uses RLHFlow helpfulness data versus Magicoder coding data. Retention is measured on animal harm and moral reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.experiments: The base model is Llama 3.1 8B. On AHB 2.2, helpfulness training degrades animal-compassion performance relative to coding training: 35.7% vs. 65.2% for SFT, and 18.7% vs. 32.0% for GRPO. On English MORU items, helpfulness training reduces general moral reasoning from 71.9% to 46.4%, a 25.5-point drop.

recommendation.zh: 当作 post-train 覆盖 mid-train 偏好的弱证据；数字刺眼，但价值域太窄，先看实验表即可。
recommendation.en: Treat it as weak evidence that post-training can overwrite mid-training preferences; the numbers are sharp, but the domain is narrow.

paper.title: Provable Benefits of RLVR over SFT for Reasoning Models: Learning to Backtrack Efficiently
paper.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated that reinforcement fine-tuning of pretrained base models can lead to significant gains in reasoning performance at inference time. In this work, we theoretically analyze why reinforcement fine-tuning induces better reasoning ability than purely supervised fine-tuning (SFT) methods. We model chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning as a pathfinding problem on graphs and compare the popular method of reinforcement learning with verifiable r

summary.core_problem: 后训练阶段中，带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在推理任务上显著优于监督微调（SFT），但缺乏对二者性能差异的原则性理论解释；尤其针对复杂推理核心的回溯能力，尚无正式框架区分两类方法的学习效果。
summary.importance: 1. 首次从回溯能力维度给出SFT与RLVR的严格理论对比，填补了后训练方法性能差异的理论解释空白；2. 证明纯金路径SFT的固有缺陷——无法学习回溯策略，直接解释了SFT易产生伪推理、过拟合金示范的经验现象；3. 推导两类方法推理时计算量的指数级分离结论，同时证明RLVR轨迹蒸馏可转移回溯能力，为当前主流的「RL探索→SFT蒸馏」流程提供了理论支撑；4. 为预训练-后训练闭环的信号设计提供明确指导：仅靠金示范数据不足以支撑复杂推理，必须引入探索产生的失败路径或回退信号（通过RL或显式合成回溯数据均可）。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 任务建模：将思维链（CoT）推理抽象为有向多图上的寻路问题，构造带分支的路径-星型多图（源节点→分叉节点→W条深度为K的分支，每条分支含K个菱形子图，每个菱形子图有L条多重边，仅金路径可到达目标叶子节点）；推理模型被建模为边级linear-softmax二元组或节点级三元组的预训练世界模型。2. 分析框架：采用梯度流（对应SFT）和符号策略梯度流（对应RLVR）做动力学特征分析。3. 核心理论推导：① 严格证明仅在金最短路径上训练的SFT，梯度流不会收敛到任何回溯策略——训练数据完全不包含死端或回退状态的梯度信号，模型仅会学习沿金路径前进的行为；② 证明仅带长度惩罚的结果级奖励的RLVR，会通过on-policy探索产生的失败rollout获得回溯动作的梯度信号，在有限时间内收敛到一致的回溯策略；③ 定量复杂度分离：收敛后RLVR模型到达任意目标的期望时间为Θ(WK)，SFT模型需要Θ(WL^K)（L>1时为指数级差距）；④ 进一步证明将RLVR生成的含回溯过程的推理轨迹，用监督学习蒸馏到基座模型，可转移高效回溯能力，恢复到Θ(WK)的推理时计算效率。
summary.experiments: 所有结论均附严格数学证明（置于附录）；通过构造的图寻路玩具任务的动力学仿真，验证了理论预测的正确性：SFT训练的模型遇到死端时无法有效回退，会反复尝试无效路径，而RLVR训练的模型会快速回溯到分叉节点，二者的推理步数差距随分支深度K和多重边数L的增大呈指数级扩大。
summary.reading_guide: 1. 先读第2节问题建模部分，结合图1重点理解路径-星型多图的构造逻辑，确保掌握推理任务的抽象方式；2. 第3节是核心，重点读3.1节SFT的梯度流分析、3.2节RLVR的符号策略梯度流分析的推导过程，关注两类方法的梯度信号来源差异；3. 第4节的复杂度分离结论和蒸馏有效性证明是延伸核心，需理解为什么包含回溯过程的轨迹蒸馏可以转移能力而非仅做行为克隆；4. 附录的完整证明可根据数学背景选读，重点关注引理3.1（SFT回溯动作梯度为零的条件）和引理3.5（RLVR回溯动作的梯度下界）；5. 值得深挖的方向：如何将玩具图的结论迁移到真实CoT的高维状态空间，预训练阶段能否通过合成回溯数据提前注入回溯能力，RLVR奖励设计的最小充分条件是什么。

summary_en.core_problem: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) consistently outperforms Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on reasoning tasks during post-training, but there is no principled theoretical explanation for this performance gap; specifically, no formal framework distinguishes the learning effects of the two methods on backtracking — a core capability for complex chain-of-thought reasoning.
summary_en.importance: 1. Provides the first rigorous theoretical comparison between SFT and RLVR along the backtracking capability dimension, filling the gap in explaining post-training method performance differences. 2. Proves the inherent limitation of pure golden-path SFT: it cannot learn backtracking strategies, directly explaining empirical observations of SFT being prone to pseudo-reasoning and overfitting to expert demonstrations. 3. Derives an exponential separation of test-time compute between the two methods, and proves that RLVR trajectory distillation can transfer backtracking capability — offering formal support for the mainstream "RL exploration → SFT distillation" workflow. 4. Delivers explicit guidance for signal design in the pretrain-posttrain closed loop: golden demonstrations alone are insufficient for complex reasoning, and failure path or rollback signals generated via exploration (either via RL or explicit synthetic backtracking data) are mandatory.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Task modeling: Abstracts CoT reasoning as a pathfinding problem on a directed multigraph, constructing a branched path-star multigraph (source node → fork node → W branches of depth K, each branch containing K diamond subgraphs with L multiedges per diamond; only the golden path reaches the target leaf node). The reasoning model is formalized as a pretrained world model, either an edge-level linear-softmax bigram or node-level trigram. 2. Analysis framework: Uses gradient flow (for SFT) and sign policy gradient flow (for RLVR) for dynamical characterization. 3. Core theoretical derivation: ① Rigorously proves that SFT trained only on golden shortest paths has gradient flow that never converges to any backtracking strategy — training data contains no gradient signals for dead-end or rollback states, so the model only learns to advance along the golden path. ② Proves that RLVR with only outcome-level reward (plus length penalty) obtains gradient signals for backtracking actions via on-policy failed rollouts, and converges to a consistent backtracking policy in finite time. ③ Quantitative complexity separation: After convergence, the RLVR model reaches any target in Θ(WK) expected time, while the SFT model requires Θ(WL^K) (exponential gap when L>1). ④ Further proves that distilling RLVR-generated reasoning traces (including backtracking steps) into the base model via supervised learning transfers efficient backtracking, recovering Θ(WK) test-time compute efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: All conclusions are supported by rigorous mathematical proofs (deferred to the appendix). Dynamical simulations on the constructed graph pathfinding toy task validate theoretical predictions: SFT-trained models fail to roll back effectively when hitting dead ends and repeatedly attempt invalid paths, while RLVR-trained models quickly backtrack to the fork node. The gap in inference steps between the two methods grows exponentially with branch depth K and multiedge count L.
summary_en.reading_guide: 1. Start with Section 2 (problem formulation), combine with Figure 1 to grasp the construction logic of the path-star multigraph and fully understand how reasoning tasks are abstracted. 2. Section 3 is the core: prioritize the gradient flow analysis of SFT (Section 3.1) and sign policy gradient flow analysis of RLVR (Section 3.2), focusing on the difference in gradient signal sources between the two methods. 3. Section 4 covers the extended core conclusions: the complexity separation result and the proof of distillation effectiveness — understand why trajectory distillation with backtracking steps transfers capability instead of just performing behavior cloning. 4. Selectively read full proofs in the appendix based on mathematical background, especially Lemma 3.1 (condition for zero gradient of SFT backtracking actions) and Lemma 3.5 (gradient lower bound for RLVR backtracking actions). 5. Worth deeper investigation: how to migrate conclusions from toy graphs to the high-dimensional state space of real CoT, whether backtracking capability can be injected during pretraining via synthetic backtracking data, and the minimal sufficient conditions for RLVR reward design.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变对“多给金标 CoT 就够了”的 prior；应检查证明假设，并在 RLVR ablation 里测 backtracking 行为。
recommendation.en: This challenges the prior that more gold CoT traces are enough; check the assumptions and add backtracking diagnostics to RLVR ablations.

paper.title: DataClaw0: Agentic Tailoring Multimodal Data from Raw Streams
paper.abstract: Massive unstructured multimodal streams suffer from high "data entropy," impeding both efficient human knowledge acquisition and high-quality AI post-training. Existing passive annotation paradigms, heavily reliant on heuristic rules or general VLMs, are costly, monotonous, and fail to unlock the deep procedural logic embedded in raw data. We elevate data processing to a learnable capability, proposing a paradigm shift towards Agentic Data Tailoring, which actively refining and structuring data

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是原始多模态数据流难以直接转化为高质量后训练数据的问题，尤其是现有被动标注方式难以抽取程序性知识和复杂结构。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是数据合成与后训练范式创新，重点不在预训练本身，而在“让数据处理能力本身成为可学习 agent 能力”。对基座研究员的价值在于：它把数据构造从静态清洗推进到 agentic tailoring，这对 post-train 数据生产线、以及 pretrain↔post-train 闭环都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Agentic Data Tailoring 范式，并构建两阶段流水线：先用确定性的 Factual Anchors 约束生成式语义合成，缓解纯生成数据的漂移和幻觉；再基于该数据训练 DataClaw0-9B。训练上结合 SFT 与 GRPO，使模型学会按用户意图主动精炼、结构化和重组原始多模态流。核心原创点不只是一个模型，而是把“数据整理”定义为可训练 agent 任务。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示作者构建了覆盖五类物理与数字场景的大规模数据集，并训练了 9B 模型。实验重点是复杂数据精炼与结构化任务上的对齐能力和稳健性，但摘要没有给出标准 benchmark 名称、具体提升幅度或与哪些强基线对比。证据方向是对的，但需要看正文确认评测是否 clean，以及 GRPO 带来的增益是否独立于数据规模。
summary.authors_note: 从摘要无法可靠确认机构归属与作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the difficulty of turning raw multimodal streams into high-quality post-training data, especially when passive annotation pipelines fail to extract procedural logic and rich structure.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training data and methodology contribution rather than a pretraining one. Its value for foundation-model researchers is that it reframes data processing itself as a learnable agent capability, which is relevant to post-train data production and the pretrain↔post-train feedback loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose an Agentic Data Tailoring paradigm and a two-stage pipeline: deterministic Factual Anchors first ground generative semantic synthesis to reduce drift and hallucination, then the resulting data is used to train DataClaw0-9B. Training combines SFT with GRPO so the model learns to actively refine, structure, and reorganize raw multimodal streams according to downstream intent. The main novelty is not just the model, but the reframing of data curation as a trainable agent task.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates a large-scale dataset spanning five physical and digital domains and a 9B model. Evaluation appears focused on alignment with complex data-refinement tasks, but the abstract does not provide standard benchmark names, exact gains, or strong baseline details. The direction is interesting, but the paper needs a close read to verify whether the evaluation is clean and whether GRPO contributes beyond simply scaling data.
summary_en.authors_note: The abstract alone does not allow reliable confirmation of institutional affiliation or author background.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该从“数据生产线自动化”而不是“又一个 agent”去看；重点读数据构造和 GRPO 贡献拆分，别被概念包装带跑。
recommendation.en: Read this as automated data-production infrastructure, not as just another agent paper; focus on the data pipeline and the GRPO ablation before buying the framing.

paper.title: SFT Overtraining Predicts Rank Inversion via Entropy Collapse Under RLVR
paper.abstract: The standard heuristic of selecting the SFT checkpoint with the highest pass@1 for GRPO can fail when SFT compresses the rollout distribution. For binary rewards, the expected within group advantage variance is $p(1{-}p)(g{-}1)/g$; when early GRPO drives $p$ below $p^*(g)$, most groups have identical rewards and provide no group relative signal. We study SFT depth ladders for Qwen2.5-Coder-3B and DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B. We test Qwen2.5-Coder-3B across five depths and three seeds, and DeepSeek-Coder

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 SFT checkpoint 选择如何影响后续 RLVR，核心问题是：用 SFT 后 pass@1 最高的 checkpoint 做 GRPO，可能因为输出分布熵塌缩而得到更差的 RL 结果。它关注的不是 RL 算法本身是否有效，而是 SFT 训练深度如何改变 rollout 分布，从而改变 GRPO 可用的组内相对优势信号。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 pretrain/posttrain 接口有直接启发。常见做法把 SFT 看成提高初始能力的阶段，默认 SFT 指标越高越适合接 RL。论文给出一个反例：更深的 SFT 提高 greedy pass@1，却压缩采样分布，导致 RLVR 需要的 reward variance 消失。对基座训练研究来说，这提示评估 checkpoint 时不能只看单点正确率，还要看采样温度下的熵、pass@k 形态和 reward 方差。它也解释了为什么某些模型在 SFT 后看似更强，但 RL 训练阶段难以继续提升：训练信号已经被上游 SFT 压窄。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先给出一个简单但有用的二元 reward 分析。对于 group size 为 g 的 GRPO，如果单个 rollout 成功概率为 p，组内 advantage variance 的期望为 p(1-p)(g-1)/g。当 p 接近 0 或 1 时，组内样本大多得到相同 reward，relative advantage 变小；当早期 GRPO 把 p 推到低于某个 p*(g) 区间时，多数组会变成全错组，几乎没有可学习信号。实验部分用 SFT depth ladder 隔离训练深度变量：同一 base model、同一数据、同一超参，只改变 SFT epoch，再把各 checkpoint 接到相同 GRPO recipe。论文重点比较 Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Base 和 DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Base。Qwen 出现 rank inversion：SFT 越深，pre-RL pass@1 越高，但 GRPO 后 peak pass@10 越低。DeepSeek 则处在更安全的区间，pass@1 保持在 p*(8) 之上，GRPO 排名只是压缩而非反转。论文还测试 KL penalty 和 label smoothing，发现不能救回已经熵塌缩的 checkpoint，说明问题主要发生在 RL 之前。
summary.experiments: 实验设置较干净。Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Base 使用 5 个 SFT 深度、3 个随机种子；DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Base 使用 4 个匹配深度、3 个随机种子。SFT 数据为 5,000 个中等难度 KodCode-V1 问题，和 HumanEval、MBPP 做 embedding 去污染，阈值 0.70，丢弃 20.8% 候选池。CoT 由 Gemini 2.5 Flash 重新生成，目标是较短推理，median 518 tokens，以适配 2,048 context。SFT 使用 BF16 LoRA，r=128、alpha=128，作用于所有 linear layers 和 embeddings；AdamW 8-bit，learning rate 1e-5，batch size 16，constant schedule，weight decay 0.001，并有 100 step 的格式 warmup。GRPO 训练集来自未用于 SFT 的 KodCode-V1，经过三轮去污染；用中间 checkpoint 做 16 次采样校准，T=1.0、top_p=0.95，只保留 pass_count 在 1 到 14 的题，Qwen 得到 1,096 条，DeepSeek 得到 1,104 条。每个 checkpoint 做 400 step GRPO/DAPO，group size 8，beta=0，无 KL penalty，learning rate 1e-6，gradient clip 0.1。关键结果是 Qwen 上 pre-RL pass@1 随 SFT 深度上升，但 peak GRPO pass@10 从 0.806 降到 0.481，且最高 pass@1 checkpoint 在每个 seed 中都输给更浅 checkpoint。pre-RL entropy 与 GRPO 结果正相关。DeepSeek 上没有出现同样的排序反转，而是排名差距被压缩。KL penalty 和 label smoothing 对 Qwen 的塌缩 checkpoint 没有救回效果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读理论推导、SFT depth ladder 结果图、entropy/reward-variance 诊断三部分。理论推导给出 p(1-p)(g-1)/g，值得检查它如何连接到 GRPO 的组内 advantage 信号。实验结果要重点看 Qwen 的 rank inversion：pre-RL pass@1 上升，但 post-RL pass@10 下降，这比单个指标相关性更有信息。诊断部分建议看 entropy、reward variance、degenerate group 比例和不同 SFT 深度的 rollout 分布。DeepSeek 对照也很重要，它说明结论不是“深 SFT 一定有害”，而是当 SFT 把采样分布压到低熵区域时，RLVR 风险上升。预计精读需要 45 到 60 分钟；如果只服务于 checkpoint 选择，可以先看 Methods、§4 和 Appendix A.3。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode in the SFT-to-RLVR handoff: choosing the SFT checkpoint with the best pass@1 can lead to worse GRPO outcomes when SFT has compressed the rollout distribution. The issue is not whether RLVR works in general, but whether the selected checkpoint still provides enough stochastic reward variation for group-relative optimization.
summary_en.importance: The result is directly relevant to the interface between pretraining, SFT, and RL. A stronger greedy checkpoint is not necessarily a better RL initialization. If SFT overtraining collapses entropy at the sampling temperature used by GRPO, most rollouts in a group may receive identical binary rewards, removing the relative advantage signal. This suggests that checkpoint selection should include rollout entropy, pass@k shape, and reward-variance diagnostics, not only pass@1. It also gives a concrete mechanism for a common observation: a model can look better after longer SFT yet become harder to improve with RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper starts from a binary-reward analysis. For GRPO with group size g and per-rollout success probability p, the expected within-group advantage variance is p(1-p)(g-1)/g. When p is close to 0 or 1, groups are likely to have identical rewards and contribute little group-relative signal. The empirical design isolates SFT depth as the main variable. The authors train ladders of SFT checkpoints with the same architecture, data, hyperparameters, and evaluation protocol, then run the same GRPO recipe from each checkpoint. The main ladder uses Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Base; a contrastive ladder uses DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Base. On Qwen, deeper SFT increases pre-RL pass@1 but reduces the best post-GRPO pass@10, producing a rank inversion. On DeepSeek, the checkpoints remain in a safer regime and the GRPO rankings compress rather than invert. KL regularization and label smoothing are tested as interventions, but they do not rescue the collapsed Qwen checkpoints, indicating that the failure is upstream of these GRPO variants.
summary_en.experiments: The Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Base study uses five SFT depths and three seeds. The DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Base study uses four matched depths and three seeds. SFT uses 5,000 medium-difficulty KodCode-V1 problems, decontaminated against HumanEval and MBPP with an embedding cosine threshold of 0.70, dropping 20.8% of the pool. Chain-of-thought traces are regenerated with Gemini 2.5 Flash, with a median length of 518 tokens, to fit a 2,048-token context. Training uses BF16 LoRA with rank 128 and alpha 128 on all linear layers and embeddings, AdamW 8-bit, learning rate 1e-5, batch size 16, a constant schedule, weight decay 0.001, and a 100-step format warmup. The GRPO data is drawn from held-out KodCode-V1 problems and decontaminated in three passes. A middle checkpoint performs 16 stochastic rollouts per problem at T=1.0 and top_p=0.95; only problems with pass_count from 1 to 14 are kept, giving 1,096 Qwen records and 1,104 DeepSeek records. Each checkpoint is trained for 400 GRPO/DAPO steps with group size 8, beta 0, learning rate 1e-6, and gradient clipping at 0.1. On Qwen, peak GRPO pass@10 falls from 0.806 to 0.481 as SFT depth increases, even though pre-RL pass@1 rises. The highest-pass@1 SFT checkpoint loses to shallower checkpoints in every seed. Pre-RL entropy is positively associated with the GRPO outcome. DeepSeek does not show the same inversion, supporting the paper’s claim that entropy collapse, not SFT depth alone, is the risk signal.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the variance derivation first, especially the p(1-p)(g-1)/g result and how it maps to group-relative learning signal. Then inspect the SFT-depth ladder plots for Qwen: the key evidence is the divergence between rising pre-RL pass@1 and falling post-RL pass@10. The entropy and reward-variance diagnostics are the most useful parts for practice, because they translate the failure into measurable checkpoint-selection signals. The DeepSeek comparison should not be skipped; it clarifies that deeper SFT is not automatically harmful, but becomes risky when it compresses the sampled rollout distribution. A focused reading of the methods, main results, and Appendix A.3 should take about 45 to 60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 直接推翻“选SFT最高pass@1做RL”的默认启发式，熵信号可立即加入内部SFT/RL checkpoint筛选流水线，建议优先复现两阶段诊断逻辑。
recommendation.en: Directly overturns the default heuristic of selecting the highest-pass@1 SFT checkpoint for RL; entropy signals can be immediately added to internal SFT/RL checkpoint selection pipelines, and the two-stage diagnostic logic is worth prioritizing for reproduction.

paper.title: How Post-Training Shapes Biological Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Scientific reasoning models for biology combine language models with foundation models trained on multimodal biological data, including DNA, RNA, and proteins. These models are built through post-training, yet how each stage shapes reasoning and generalization remains poorly understood. We study when post-training improves performance and when it induces over-specialization. Across genomics, transcriptomics, and proteins, we train and evaluate more than 100 biological reasoning models under cont

summary.core_problem: 生物科学推理模型通过CPT、SFT、RL多阶段后训练构建，但各阶段对推理能力与分布外泛化的具体影响机制缺乏系统对照研究。
summary.importance: 原理分析+大规模消融贡献，通过100+模型的受控变量实验，系统量化后训练三阶段对生物推理模型域内/域外性能的差异化影响。
summary.technical_approach: 控制骨干模型、后训练阶段（持续预训练CPT/监督微调SFT/强化学习RL）为变量，在基因组、转录组、蛋白质三个生物领域训练100+模型，同步测量域内与域外性能变化。
summary.experiments: 覆盖基因组/转录组/蛋白质三类任务；实验发现：CPT通过对齐生物语言提升下游性能；SFT稳定提升域内性能但域外性能先升后降，存在过拟合拐点；RL阶段的泛化影响随任务与设置变化。
summary.authors_note: 作者含Bryan Perozzi、Sham Kakade、Marinka Zitnik等知名研究者，来自Google DeepMind、哈佛大学、华盛顿大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Biological scientific reasoning models are built via multi-stage post-training including CPT, SFT, and RL, but the specific impact of each stage on reasoning ability and out-of-distribution generalization lacks systematic controlled study.
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic analysis and large-scale ablation contribution: systematically quantifies the differential impacts of three post-training stages on in-domain and out-of-domain performance via controlled experiments on 100+ models across three biological domains.
summary_en.technical_approach: Backbone models and post-training stages (continued pretraining / supervised fine-tuning / reinforcement learning) are treated as controlled variables; over 100 models are trained across genomics, transcriptomics, and proteins, with both in-domain and out-of-domain performance measured.
summary_en.experiments: Covering genomics, transcriptomics, and protein tasks; key findings: CPT improves downstream performance by aligning models with biological language; SFT consistently boosts in-domain performance but OOD performance peaks early then declines, showing an overfitting inflection point; RL's generalization impact varies across tasks and setups.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include well-known researchers such as Bryan Perozzi, Sham Kakade, and Marinka Zitnik, affiliated with Google DeepMind, Harvard University, University of Washington, and other institutions.

recommendation.zh: SFT域外性能先升后降的拐点结论对通用LLM后训练配比有直接参考，重点看§4.2 SFT阶段的性能曲线与数据量消融。
recommendation.en: The finding that SFT OOD performance rises then falls has direct implications for general LLM post-training data budgeting; focus on §4.2 SFT performance curves and data size ablations.

paper.title: VibeThinker-3B: Exploring the Frontier of Verifiable Reasoning in Small Language Models
paper.abstract: This technical report introduces VibeThinker-3B, a compact dense model with 3B parameters developed to investigate how far verifiable reasoning can be pushed within a strictly small-model regime. Building upon the Spectrum-to-Signal post-training paradigm, we systematically enhance the model through an optimized pipeline that includes curriculum-based supervised fine-tuning, multi-domain reinforcement learning, and offline self-distillation. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that VibeThinker-

summary.core_problem: 探索3B参数级小语言模型在可验证推理任务上的性能上限，缩小与大模型的推理能力差距
summary.importance: 工程突破+方法创新，提出面向小模型的可验证推理后训练流水线，在小模型regime下达到一线推理系统的性能水平
summary.technical_approach: 基于Spectrum-to-Signal后训练范式，组合课程式SFT、多域RL、离线自蒸馏三个阶段的优化，针对数学、代码等可验证推理任务做专项增强
summary.experiments: 3B稠密模型，AIME26得分94.3（测试时缩放后97.1），LiveCodeBench v6 Pass@1 80.2，未见过的LeetCode竞赛接受率96.1%，追平远超其规模的旗舰推理模型
summary.authors_note: 新浪微博 Inc 团队，无公开知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Explore the performance upper bound of 3B-parameter small language models on verifiable reasoning tasks, narrowing the gap with large models
summary_en.importance: Engineering breakthrough + methodological innovation; proposes a post-training pipeline for small-model verifiable reasoning, achieving top-tier performance in the small-model regime
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on the Spectrum-to-Signal post-training paradigm, combines curriculum SFT, multi-domain RL, and offline self-distillation for targeted enhancement of math/code verifiable reasoning tasks
summary_en.experiments: 3B dense model achieves 94.3 on AIME26 (97.1 with test-time scaling), 80.2 Pass@1 on LiveCodeBench v6, 96.1% acceptance rate on unseen LeetCode contests, matching flagship models orders of magnitude larger
summary_en.authors_note: Sina Weibo Inc, no publicly well-known researchers identified

recommendation.zh: 小模型推理后训练的完整可复现recipe，§3的训练阶段配置、数据配比和测试时缩放trick值得在内部小模型ablation中参考
recommendation.en: Reproducible end-to-end post-training pipeline for small-model reasoning; §3 stage configs, data mixture, and test-time scaling trick are worth referencing in internal small-model ablations

paper.title: Select and Improve: Understanding the Mechanics of Post-Training for Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has rapidly emerged as a key component in the training of reasoning and coding models, yet it remains poorly understood from a mechanistic perspective. We study how and through what underlying processes capabilities are acquired or enhanced via reinforcement learning post-training. Our analysis, based on controlled math reasoning experiments with Qwen-2.5-1.5B, reveals two core mechanisms: strategy selection and strategy improvement. Our results highlight the role of SFT d

summary.core_problem: 揭示强化学习后训练提升大模型推理能力的底层机制，明确SFT与RL数据在能力提升中的具体功能分工。
summary.importance: 机制分析类核心贡献，首次拆解出RL后训练提升推理的两个独立子机制（策略选择、策略改进），为预训练数据设计、后训练数据配置提供可操作的量化指导。
summary.technical_approach: 基于Qwen-2.5-1.5B开展受控数学推理实验，通过控制SFT数据的推理策略多样性、RL训练数据的难度梯度两个变量，分别观测两个机制的激活条件与性能贡献。
summary.experiments: 使用Qwen-2.5-1.5B作为基座模型，在数学推理任务集上开展多组受控ablation；验证了SFT多样策略数据可激活策略选择能力，RL难度递增数据可实现策略改进，二者结合可最大化推理性能。
summary.authors_note: Akshay Krishnamurthy 为微软研究院资深研究员，长期从事机器学习理论与大模型训练机制研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Uncover the underlying mechanisms by which reinforcement learning post-training improves LLM reasoning capabilities, and clarify the specific functional division of SFT and RL data in capability enhancement.
summary_en.importance: Core mechanism analysis contribution, first decomposing two independent sub-mechanisms (strategy selection, strategy improvement) for RL post-training to boost reasoning, providing actionable quantitative guidance for pretraining data design and post-training data configuration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Conducts controlled math reasoning experiments on Qwen-2.5-1.5B, controlling two variables (reasoning strategy diversity of SFT data, difficulty gradient of RL data) to observe activation conditions and performance contributions of the two mechanisms respectively.
summary_en.experiments: Uses Qwen-2.5-1.5B as the base model, conducts multiple controlled ablations on math reasoning task sets; verifies that SFT data with diverse strategies activates strategy selection, RL data with increasing difficulty achieves strategy improvement, and their combination maximizes reasoning performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Akshay Krishnamurthy is a senior researcher at Microsoft Research, with long-term work on machine learning theory and LLM training mechanisms.

recommendation.zh: RL后训练的双机制拆解直接修正对SFT/RL数据分工的认知，应立刻在内部后训练ablation中验证。
recommendation.en: The dual-mechanism decomposition of RL post-training directly revises understanding of SFT/RL data division; should be immediately validated in internal post-training ablations.

paper.title: Pythagoras-Prover: Advancing Efficient Formal Proving via Augmented Lean Formalisation
paper.abstract: Modern Lean theorem provers achieve strong performance only with substantial training and inference compute, driven in part by scarce verified proof data and the long reasoning traces of formal proof search, making both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and sampling expensive. We introduce Pythagoras-Prover, a compute-efficient open-source family of Lean theorem provers built for practical compute budgets. The family spans two generation paradigms: autoregressive models at 4B and 32B parameters, and

summary.core_problem: 现有 Lean 定理证明器需要极高训练和推理计算量，受限于稀缺的验证证明数据和长推理 trace，SFT 和采样都很昂贵。
summary.importance: 在实用计算预算下训练高性能 Lean 定理证明器的重要探索，首次提出 diffusion-based 形式证明器 (4B) 概念验证，并引入 augmented Lean formalisation 和课程 SFT 策略。
summary.technical_approach: Pythagoras-Prover 家族包括：(1) 4B 和 32B AR 模型；(2) 4B diffusion-based 证明器（推理时迭代精化 Lean 证明）。训练效率通过：Lean-verified 语料分层为易/中/难进行课程 SFT；动态 proof-reasoning 过滤保持 informative trace 且在 8k token 预算内。
summary.experiments: 在 Lean 形式证明 benchmark 上对比现有强证明器，报告在 4B 和 32B 规模上的性能，强调 compute-efficient 训练策略的效果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自多所高校。Shay B. Cohen (爱丁堡大学) 是 NLP 和形式推理领域知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Modern Lean theorem provers require extreme training and inference compute, limited by scarce verified proof data and long reasoning traces, making both SFT and sampling expensive.
summary_en.importance: Important exploration of training high-performance Lean provers under practical compute budgets; first proof-of-concept diffusion-based formal prover (4B), plus augmented Lean formalisation and curriculum SFT strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pythagoras-Prover family includes: (1) 4B and 32B autoregressive models; (2) a 4B diffusion-based prover (iteratively refines Lean proofs at inference). Training efficiency via: Lean-verified corpus stratified into easy/medium/hard for curriculum SFT; dynamic proof-reasoning filtering preserves informative traces within an 8k-token budget.
summary_en.experiments: Compared against strong existing provers on Lean formal proof benchmarks; performance reported at 4B and 32B scales, emphasizing compute-efficient training gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from multiple universities. Shay B. Cohen (University of Edinburgh) is a well-known researcher in NLP and formal reasoning.

recommendation.zh: Diffusion-based 形式证明器是新颖方向，对理解非 AR 建模范式在复杂推理任务上的表现有参考。课程 SFT 和动态过滤策略也值得做 reasoning 数据的研究员关注，看 §3.2-3.3。
recommendation.en: Diffusion-based formal prover is a novel direction worth noting for understanding non-AR paradigms on complex reasoning. Curriculum SFT and dynamic filtering in §3.2-3.3 are also relevant for reasoning-data researchers.

paper.title: IterCAD: An Iterative Multimodal Agent for Visually-Grounded CAD Generation and Editing
paper.abstract: Computer-Aided Design is pivotal in modern manufacturing, yet existing automated methods predominantly rely on open-loop, one-shot generation, creating a mismatch with iterative real-world practices. In this paper, we present IterCAD, a unified multimodal agent framework for closed-loop, interactive CAD generation and editing. We formulate the task as a multi-turn interaction between a multimodal agent and an executable CAD sandbox, covering three tasks: Drawing-to-Code, Text-to-Code, and Intera

summary.core_problem: 解决现有自动化CAD生成方法多为开环一次性生成、与真实工业迭代式设计流程不匹配的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新+Benchmark贡献；提出闭环多模态CAD Agent框架，配套数据合成管线与评测套件IterCAD-Bench
summary.technical_approach: 将CAD生成建模为多模态Agent与可执行CAD沙箱的多轮交互，覆盖绘图转代码、文本转代码、交互编辑三类任务；用融合工业制造特征的数据合成管线生成训练数据，通过渐进式SFT+带可行前缀掩码的几何感知RL优化Agent

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the mismatch between existing open-loop one-shot automated CAD generation methods and real-world iterative industrial design workflows

summary_en.technical_approach: Formulates CAD generation as multi-turn interaction between a multimodal agent and executable CAD sandbox; uses industrial feature-augmented data synthesis pipeline for training; optimizes agent via progressive SFT + geometry-aware RL with viable-prefix masking

recommendation.zh: 特定CAD领域的代码Agent工作，可行前缀掩码提升可执行性的思路可参考，但领域过窄，仅看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Domain-specific coding agent for CAD; viable-prefix masking for executability is marginally informative, but narrow scope means only the abstract is worth reading

paper.title: Demystifying Data Organization for Enhanced LLM Training
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized various fields, yet their training efficiency is heavily reliant on effective data curation. While data selection has been widely studied, the strategic data organization for enhanced training remains an underexplored area, particularly since current LLMs are often trained for only one or a few epochs. This paper systematically explores the influence of data organization on LLM training by reusing pre-computed sample-level scores originally genera

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 训练中样本顺序和数据组织方式是否会影响训练效率与最终能力，尤其是在当前预训练通常只跑一到数个 epoch 的设定下。
summary.importance: 贡献点在于把“数据组织”从经验性 shuffle 问题提升为可系统调参的训练变量。它不是新增语料，也不是单纯数据筛选，而是利用已有 sample-level score 重新安排训练顺序，尝试在几乎不增加计算的前提下改善预训练和 SFT。
summary.technical_approach: 论文复用数据效率研究中已有的样本级打分，提出四条组织原则：Boundary Sharpening、Cyclic Scheduling、Curriculum Continuity、Local Diversity。基于这些原则设计 STR 和 SAW 两种排序方法，核心是控制难度/质量边界、周期性重复、课程连续性和局部 batch 多样性之间的张力。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖不同模型规模和数据规模，并同时考察 pre-training 与 SFT 阶段。摘要未给出具体参数量、token 数和提升幅度，但声称两种排序方法在多种设置下验证了这些 guideline 的有效性，并且额外计算开销很低。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Nanyang Technological University、Microsoft Research 和 The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology。该工作来自 Microsoft Research 参与的数据与训练效率方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether sample ordering and data organization affect LLM training efficiency and final performance, especially when modern LLMs are trained for only one or a few epochs.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is to treat data organization as a controllable training variable rather than a default shuffle choice. It is not a new corpus or a pure data selection method; it reuses existing sample-level scores to improve pre-training and SFT with little extra compute.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method reuses pre-computed sample-level scores and formalizes four principles: Boundary Sharpening, Cyclic Scheduling, Curriculum Continuity, and Local Diversity. It then introduces two ordering algorithms, STR and SAW, to balance quality or difficulty boundaries, cyclic exposure, smooth curricula, and local batch diversity.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover multiple model scales and data sizes across both pre-training and SFT. The abstract does not provide exact parameter counts, token budgets, or gains, but reports consistent validation of the proposed guidelines and low additional computational overhead.
summary_en.authors_note: The institutions include Nanyang Technological University, Microsoft Research, and The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. The work is connected to Microsoft Research's data and training-efficiency interests.

recommendation.zh: 预训练组应读方法和消融：如果结论稳，数据顺序不再只是 dataloader 细节，而是低成本 recipe 变量。
recommendation.en: Pretraining teams should read the method and ablations: if stable, ordering is no longer a dataloader detail but a cheap recipe knob.

paper.title: Compatibility-Aware Dynamic Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is the predominant paradigm for aligning large language models (LLMs), yet it suffers from optimization instability and limited generalization. Recent work attributes this issue to pathological gradient scaling and proposes Dynamic Fine-Tuning (DFT) to correct it at the token level. However, DFT assumes all demonstrations are equally suitable learning targets, an assumption violated by the strong heterogeneity of large-scale instruction data, where demonstration-poli

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是 SFT 在大规模异质指令数据上的优化方差问题，而且把问题分成两层。第一层是已有 DFT 关注的 token-level pathology：低概率 token 在 teacher forcing 下会触发过大的梯度。第二层是这篇论文新增强调的 sample-level mismatch：即便 token 级缩放被修正，不同样本与当前策略的兼容性仍然差异很大，过难、分布偏移或风格不匹配的 demonstrations 会带来高方差更新，拖累稳定性和泛化。CADFT 的目标就是在不引入 RL machinery 的前提下，把 DFT 从“只修 token”扩展到“同时管样本”。
summary.importance: 对 pretrain/post-train 接口的意义比对纯预训练更直接。它延续了近来把 SFT 重新解释为一种受限 policy optimization 的路线，关注训练信号质量而不是单纯堆数据。启发点在于：对齐阶段的优化稳定性，不只是 loss 形式问题，也和数据是否处在模型当前可学习区域有关。这个视角与 curriculum、data annealing、continual pretrain、cold-start RL 初始化都有联系。如果方法和结果可靠，它更像一种 alignment recipe 改进，而不是基座预训练范式变化。
summary.technical_approach:
方法建立在 DFT 之上。DFT 的出发点是，标准 SFT 的 NLL 梯度对低概率 token 有 inverse-probability amplification，导致 rare token 产生异常大的更新；DFT 通过把更新重写为与 (1+log pt) 成比例的形式，避免 pt→0 时梯度发散。CADFT 接着指出：即使 token 级梯度被压平，样本级别仍有异质性，某些 demonstration 整体上与当前策略不兼容，会持续制造高方差梯度。

为此，作者引入 compatibility signal。它是一个 policy-dependent、动态更新的样本权重，依据模型对整条 demonstration 的似然或归一化对数似然来估计“当前模型是否有能力从这条样本稳定学习”。兼容性高的样本保留较强监督，兼容性低的样本被降权，而不是直接丢弃。这里的关键设计有三点。

第一，compatibility 是相对量而不是绝对阈值。作者会对当前 batch 或训练阶段中的 likelihood 进行归一化，避免随着模型整体变强，所有样本权重一起漂移。

第二，兼容性调制发生在 sample level，与 DFT 的 token-level 修正相乘或组合。也就是说，最终更新既考虑 token 是否异常难，也考虑整条样本是否偏离当前 policy 的可学习区域。

第三，作者加入 delayed rewriting。对于长期低兼容的样本，不是立即让模型自我改写，而是在 warm-up 之后、低频触发地把这些样本重写成更接近模型当前 feasible region 的目标。这个设计是为了避免过早 self-reinforcement：如果模型一开始能力不足就频繁重写，容易把高质量难样本改写成低质量简单样本，形成退化闭环。

从理论解释上，作者把 CADFT 视为 variance-controlled estimator：DFT 控制 token-level variance，CADFT 再进一步控制 sample-level variance。这个理论框架不算很强，但足以解释为什么它可能比 vanilla SFT 和纯 DFT 更稳。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验覆盖 language、code、multimodal reasoning，以及 cold-start RL initialization 几类场景，目标是证明三件事：训练更稳、泛化更好、作为后续 RL 初始策略更合适。

论文在引言里没有给出完整数字表，但关键信号比较明确。第一，作者声称低 compatibility 样本对应更高梯度方差，并通过重加权后显著改善优化稳定性。这里通常要看训练曲线、梯度范数分布、loss spike 频率，以及不同 compatibility 分桶的统计；阅读时应重点确认这些证据是否充分。

第二，CADFT 相比 SFT 和 DFT，在 reasoning-heavy 任务、代码生成和多模态推理上都有一致提升。由于论文把 heterogeneity 作为主因，最有价值的结果不是平均分本身，而是分布外或高难样本上的收益，以及是否在不牺牲 easy samples 的情况下提升 hard samples。

第三，作者强调对 downstream RL initialization 有帮助。这一点如果成立，说明 CADFT 学到的不只是更高 imitation accuracy，而是更低方差、更可优化的初始策略。阅读时要看 RL cold-start 实验是否控制了 base model、数据量和后续 RL budget，否则很难判断收益来自初始化质量还是别的因素。

第四，rewriting 机制应当有单独消融：何时启动、触发频率、是否只对 persistent low-compatibility 样本生效。如果没有这些消融，rewriting 的贡献会和 reweighting 混在一起。按作者叙述，rewriting 是保守、低频、延迟触发的辅助模块，不应成为主要收益来源。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议按“问题定义—方法—证据”三步走。

先看 Introduction 和 related motivation，确认作者如何把 SFT 的问题拆成 token-level 与 sample-level 两层。这里决定 CADFT 是否只是又一个 sample reweighting 方法，还是确实建立在 DFT 的病理分析之上。

再看方法部分里 compatibility 的定义、归一化方式、以及它与 DFT loss 的组合形式。重点不是公式推导多复杂，而是三个实现细节：compatibility 用什么 likelihood 统计量；归一化是 batch-wise、running-stat 还是 curriculum-style；权重函数是否有截断或温度参数。这些细节决定方法是否稳、是否容易复现。

最后看实验中的三类消融：一是与 SFT、DFT 的主对比；二是 compatibility reweighting 与 rewriting 的拆分；三是不同任务异质性强弱下的效果变化。如果时间有限，优先看训练稳定性图、主要结果表和 ablation。预计 35 到 50 分钟可以判断这篇工作是否只是合理工程技巧，还是对 SFT 优化目标有更扎实的推进。

阅读时也要留意几个风险点：compatibility 由当前模型 likelihood 定义，容易把“难但有价值”的样本长期降权；rewriting 可能引入自蒸馏偏差；如果收益主要集中在特定 benchmark，而不是普遍降低方差，那方法的普适性会有限。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets optimization variance in supervised fine-tuning on heterogeneous instruction data, and it separates the issue into two levels. The first is the token-level pathology already addressed by DFT: under teacher forcing, low-probability tokens induce disproportionately large gradients. The second, which this paper emphasizes, is sample-level mismatch: even after token-level correction, demonstrations differ greatly in how compatible they are with the current policy. Overly difficult, distribution-shifted, or poorly matched samples can still produce high-variance updates. CADFT is proposed to extend DFT from token-level stabilization to sample-level variance control without introducing RL machinery.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is stronger for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface than for core pretraining itself. The paper continues a useful line of work that reinterprets SFT through the lens of policy optimization and training-signal quality rather than treating it as plain maximum likelihood. The main takeaway is that alignment stability depends not only on the loss form, but also on whether the data lies inside the model’s current learnable region. That connects naturally to curriculum design, annealing, continual pretraining, and cold-start RL.
