paper.title: OpenSeeker-v2: Pushing the Limits of Search Agents with Informative and High-Difficulty Trajectories
paper.abstract: Deep search capabilities have become an indispensable competency for frontier Large Language Model (LLM) agents, yet their development remains dominated by industrial giants. The typical industry recipe involves a highly resource-intensive pipeline spanning pre-training, continual pre-training (CPT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL). In this report, we show that when fueled with informative and high-difficulty trajectories, a simple SFT approach could be surprisingly

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是预训练本身，而是搜索型 agent 训练里一个更贴近 post-train 的问题：在没有持续预训练和强化学习的大规模工业流水线支持下，单靠监督微调，能否把通用基座模型训练成强搜索 agent。作者给出的答案是可以，但前提不是更复杂的训练目标，而是更难、更信息密集、步骤更长的轨迹数据。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接相关性有限，因为主体贡献落在 agent SFT 数据构造，而不是预训练目标、架构或训练动态。不过它对 pretrain↔post-train 接口有一个清楚的启发：当任务能力高度依赖长程工具使用和多跳信息整合时，数据难度分布可能比训练阶段堆叠更关键。换句话说，某些看起来需要 CPT+SFT+RL 才能得到的能力，可能有相当一部分其实来自轨迹数据的覆盖度和难度筛选，而不是 RL 本身。这对研究“后训练信号到底在教什么”有参考价值，但贡献更多是工程配方层面的，不是基础范式推进。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接，核心是三项数据合成改动，然后在一个现成 thinking 基座上做单阶段 SFT。第一，扩大任务合成时使用的知识图谱或证据子图规模，把原来较小的局部图扩展成更大的 evidence subgraph。这样生成的问题更容易要求多节点证据聚合，而不是单跳检索。第二，扩充工具集，让 agent 在 ReAct 轨迹中接触更多工具类型，学习更丰富的交互模式。第三，做严格的 low-step filtering，把工具调用步数低于阈值 T_min 的轨迹直接丢弃，强行抬高训练集难度下限。最终只保留约 10k 条高难轨迹，对 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 做标准 SFT。方法上的关键判断是：与其在训练算法上继续加 RL，不如先把监督数据从“可解”提升到“必须长程搜索才能解”。这也是它与很多 agent 工作的区别，后者常把重点放在框架、记忆或工具编排，而这里主要押注数据分布。
summary.experiments: 论文报告的主结果是：仅用约 10.6k 条高难轨迹做一次 SFT，就让 30B 级模型在多个搜索/agent benchmark 上取得很强表现。文中给出的数字包括：BrowseComp 46.0%，BrowseComp-ZH 58.1%，Humanity’s Last Exam 34.6%，xbench 78.0%。作者还拿 Tongyi DeepResearch 这类采用 CPT+SFT+RL 流水线的工业系统做对比，后者对应成绩为 43.4%、46.7%、32.9%、75.0%，OpenSeeker-v2 在这些基准上均有领先。对阅读者更有价值的是其隐含结论：数据压缩得很小，但难度和信息密度被显著抬高后，SFT 的能力上限比很多人预期更高。可惜从给出的全文片段看，消融细节还不够充分，尤其是三项数据改动各自的边际贡献、不同 T_min 的敏感性、以及是否存在 benchmark-specific overfitting，这些都需要在正文表格里进一步核实。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，不需要逐段细抠。先看 Introduction，明确作者是在挑战“强搜索 agent 必须依赖 CPT+RL”的常见配方。然后直接看方法部分的三项数据改动：graph size、tool set、low-step filtering，这三点就是全文主线。实验部分重点看主表和消融，尤其要确认提升到底来自更大工具集、更多证据图，还是简单地把容易样本删掉。若只想判断是否值得跟进，15 到 20 分钟足够。若关心 post-train 数据工程，可进一步检查训练集构造细节、轨迹长度分布和 benchmark 泄漏风险。

summary_en.core_problem: This work is not about pretraining in the narrow sense. It tackles a post-training question for search agents: can a strong deep-search agent be built with plain supervised fine-tuning alone, without the heavy industrial recipe of continual pretraining plus RL, if the training trajectories are sufficiently informative and difficult? The paper argues yes, and places the burden on data quality rather than on a more complex optimization pipeline.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited, since the main contribution is in agent trajectory synthesis rather than training objectives, scaling laws, or optimization dynamics. Still, it offers a useful signal for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. It suggests that some capabilities often attributed to RL or multi-stage training may in practice come from the difficulty distribution and informational richness of the supervision. That is a meaningful observation if one is trying to disentangle what post-training stages actually teach. The contribution is therefore more about data-centric post-training design than about core LM methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is straightforward. The authors start from an existing thinking-oriented base model, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507, and apply a single SFT stage on a compact but deliberately hard dataset. The dataset is produced with three modifications to the trajectory synthesis pipeline. First, they enlarge the source graph used for task generation, so each synthetic query is conditioned on a richer evidence subgraph with more possible reasoning paths and stronger multi-hop requirements. Second, they expand the tool set available to the ReAct-style agent, encouraging more diverse interaction patterns and broader functional coverage. Third, they apply strict low-step filtering: any trajectory solvable in fewer than a threshold number of tool calls is discarded. This raises the minimum difficulty floor and removes shallow lookup-style examples. The final training set contains only around 10k high-difficulty trajectories. The key design choice is to spend the complexity budget on the supervision distribution rather than on RL, memory modules, or more elaborate agent frameworks.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result is that a single SFT run on roughly 10.6k hard trajectories is enough to produce a strong 30B-scale search agent. Reported benchmark numbers are 46.0% on BrowseComp, 58.1% on BrowseComp-ZH, 34.6% on Humanity’s Last Exam, and 78.0% on xbench. The paper compares these results against industrial systems such as Tongyi DeepResearch, which reportedly uses a CPT+SFT+RL pipeline and scores 43.4%, 46.7%, 32.9%, and 75.0% on the same benchmarks. The interesting takeaway is not only the absolute scores, but the compression of supervision: a very small dataset, if made hard enough, can push SFT much further than expected. What remains to be checked carefully in the full paper is the ablation depth. The most important questions are the marginal contribution of each data modification, sensitivity to the minimum-step threshold, and whether the gains are robust rather than benchmark-specific.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Read the introduction to understand the claim being challenged: that frontier search agents require a full CPT+SFT+RL stack. Then go straight to the three data-generation changes—larger evidence graphs, larger tool sets, and strict low-step filtering. Those are the entire story. In the experiments, focus on the main benchmark table and any ablations that separate the effect of each change. If the goal is only to judge whether the idea is worth tracking, 15–20 minutes is enough. If you care about post-training data engineering, spend extra time on dataset construction details, trajectory length statistics, and possible benchmark leakage.

recommendation.zh: 读数据过滤和 benchmark 对照即可；10.6k SFT 打到这个水平很刺眼，但先查泄漏、工具预算和题目重合。
recommendation.en: Read the data filtering and benchmark comparisons; 10.6k SFT getting this far is striking, but first audit leakage, tool budget, and benchmark overlap.

paper.title: Act2See: Emergent Active Visual Perception for Video Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) typically rely on static initial frames for video reasoning, restricting their ability to incorporate essential dynamic information as the reasoning process evolves. Existing methods that augment Chain-of-Thought (CoT) with additional frame information often exhibit suboptimal CoT quality and lack the crucial ability to synthesize visual information for hypothetical or counterfactual scenarios. We introduce Act-to-See (Act2See), a novel framework that enables active

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是视频推理里的一个具体短板：大多数 VLM 在推理开始时只看到固定采样的视频帧，后续 CoT 再长，也只能围绕这批静态证据展开，无法像人一样在思考过程中主动补充视觉信息。更进一步，现有方法即便能在 CoT 中插入检索到的帧，也很难处理反事实或假设性问题，因为这类问题需要“生成并检查一个不存在于原视频中的场景”。作者要做的是让模型在文本推理链中主动决定何时检索已有帧、何时生成假设帧，并把这些视觉结果重新并入 CoT。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献不强，它主要是一个 post-train/SFT 框架。但它对基座研究仍有两点启发。第一，它把“视觉证据获取”从输入预处理变成了推理过程中的显式动作，这对未来原生多模态模型的训练目标设计有参考意义。第二，它说明高质量 reasoning trace 的监督信号可以显著改变模型的感知策略，而不只是改变答案风格。若从 pretrain↔posttrain 接口看，这类工作提示：模型是否需要在预训练阶段就学习何时请求更多感知、何时构造假设世界，而不是只在 SFT 阶段补上。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名 Act2See，核心不是改 backbone，而是构造一种带“视觉动作”的 CoT 监督数据，再对现有 VLM 做 SFT。作者定义了两类工具调用 token：<retrieve>...</retrieve> 和 <generate>...</generate>。训练数据构造时，先用 Gemini 2.5 Pro 按特定模板生成带工具调用的推理链；如果模型在某一步判断现有视觉信息不足，就会输出检索查询或生成查询。随后离线工具执行该操作：检索工具从视频中找相关帧；生成工具则先按查询检索一张参考帧，再结合查询做条件式 image-to-image generation，以提高生成质量和与原视频语境的一致性。

拿到新帧后，系统把前面已经生成的 CoT 保留，并把新视觉帧插回推理链中，再继续生成后续 reasoning trace。这样得到的是视频-文本交错的完整 CoT，而不是单纯在答案前后附几张图。为了控制数据质量，作者没有直接接受 frontier model 生成的所有 CoT，而是利用带人工标注 CoT 的数据集 MINERVA、CausalVQA、Social Genome，把自动生成的推理链与人工 ground-truth 做相似度过滤，低质量样本被剔除。最终构造出的 SFT 数据中，47% 的 trace 含有检索或生成帧。

训练阶段较直接：用这些交错 CoT 对 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 做监督微调。方法上的关键点有两个。第一，模型学到的不是“如何调用一个固定工具 API”，而是何时需要额外视觉证据，以及该用检索还是生成。第二，生成帧被纳入 CoT，使模型能在反事实问题上借助显式视觉想象，而不是只靠文本内隐推理。
summary.experiments:
作者在五个视频推理 benchmark 上评测：Video-MME、VideoEspresso、EgoNormia、VCR-Bench、ViTIB，覆盖时空推理、物理与社会因果、复杂感知、逻辑推理以及视频-文本交错验证。论文声称 Act2See 超过同量级标准 VLM，包括 InternVL2.5-8B、Video-LLaMA3-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking、Video-R1，也优于多种视频文本交错 CoT 方法，如 Chain-of-Shot、FrameMind、ReWatch-R1。给出的全文片段没有列出具体分数，因此不适合编造绝对提升值，但可以确认作者把“同尺寸 backbone + 更强主动感知”作为主要比较设置。

实验上最值得看的不是总分，而是几类分析。第一，含 retrieve/generate 的 trace 占比达到 47%，说明作者不是只在少量样本上演示工具调用，而是把它作为普遍监督信号。第二，论文强调 inference-time emergent capability：即使测试时没有人工指定何时调用工具，模型也会在 CoT 中自行插入检索或生成动作。第三，若正文包含消融，重点应看：只用 retrieve、不用 generate；不做人工 CoT 过滤；只给最终答案监督、不训练完整 interleaved CoT；以及不同工具质量对最终推理表现的影响。这些实验决定提升究竟来自主动感知机制，还是仅仅来自更长、更丰富的 CoT 数据。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Figure 1 和 Algorithm 1，把数据构造流程读顺：frontier VLM 如何生成工具调用、离线工具如何返回帧、帧如何重新插入 CoT。然后看 Table 1 的 prompt 模板，理解模型被教会的动作语法。接着直接跳实验，重点看 benchmark 主表、是否有按问题类型拆分的结果，以及 retrieve/generate 的消融。

预计 20–30 分钟可以判断这篇工作的真实价值。值得留意的点有三个：一是质量过滤是否足够严格，避免把 frontier model 的噪声 CoT 蒸馏进去；二是生成帧是否真的帮助反事实推理，还是只是增加了视觉上下文；三是这种能力是否能迁移到更通用的多模态 agent 设置，而不局限于视频 QA。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a concrete limitation in video reasoning: most VLMs only see a fixed set of sampled frames at the start, so even a long chain of thought can only reason over static evidence. Existing methods may insert retrieved frames into CoT, but they still struggle with counterfactual or hypothetical questions, where the model needs to reason about a scene that does not exist in the original video. Act2See aims to let the model decide during reasoning when to retrieve an existing frame and when to generate a hypothetical one, then fold that visual result back into the CoT.
summary_en.importance: Its direct contribution to pretraining is limited; this is primarily a post-training/SFT method. Still, it matters for foundation-model research in two ways. First, it turns visual evidence acquisition from a preprocessing choice into an explicit reasoning action, which is relevant to future training objectives for native multimodal models. Second, it shows that high-quality reasoning-trace supervision can change not only answer style but also the model’s evidence-gathering behavior. From a pretrain–posttrain interface perspective, it raises a useful question: should models learn when to request more perception or construct hypothetical worlds earlier in training, rather than only through SFT?
summary_en.technical_approach:
Act2See does not mainly modify the backbone. Its core idea is to build CoT supervision with explicit visual actions, then fine-tune an existing VLM on that data. The method defines two tool-call tokens: <retrieve>...</retrieve> and <generate>...</generate>. During data construction, Gemini 2.5 Pro is prompted with a template that encourages it to emit reasoning traces containing these calls. Whenever the model judges that current visual evidence is insufficient, it outputs either a retrieval query or a generation query. An offline tool then executes the action: the retrieval tool finds a relevant frame from the video, while the generation tool first retrieves a reference frame and then performs conditional image-to-image generation using the query, improving visual quality and consistency with the original scene.

After the new frame is obtained, the existing partial CoT is preserved, the frame is inserted into the reasoning trace, and generation continues. The result is a fully interleaved video-text CoT rather than a plain answer with extra images attached. To control data quality, the authors do not simply accept all frontier-model traces. They use datasets with human-annotated CoTs—MINERVA, CausalVQA, and Social Genome—and filter generated traces by similarity to the human ground truth. Low-quality traces are removed. In the final SFT dataset, 47% of traces contain retrieved or generated frames.

Training is straightforward supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking on these interleaved traces. The key methodological point is that the model is not only learning a tool syntax. It is learning when additional visual evidence is needed, and whether retrieval or generation is the right operation. By inserting generated frames into the CoT, the model can also externalize hypothetical visual reasoning instead of relying only on implicit text-side imagination.
summary_en.experiments:
The model is evaluated on five video reasoning benchmarks: Video-MME, VideoEspresso, EgoNormia, VCR-Bench, and ViTIB, covering spatiotemporal reasoning, physical and social causality, complex perception, logical reasoning including counterfactuals, and video-text interleaving verification. The paper reports that Act2See outperforms similarly sized standard VLMs such as InternVL2.5-8B, Video-LLaMA3-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, and Video-R1, and also surpasses several video-text interleaved CoT methods including Chain-of-Shot, FrameMind, and ReWatch-R1. The provided excerpt does not include exact scores, so it would be unsafe to state numerical gains, but the intended comparison is clearly “same-scale backbone, stronger active perception.”

The most informative parts of the experiments are likely not the aggregate scores but the analyses. First, 47% of traces containing retrieve/generate actions indicates that tool use is a substantial training signal rather than a rare demonstration. Second, the paper emphasizes an emergent inference-time behavior: the model can insert retrieval or generation actions into its own CoT without being manually told when to do so. Third, the most important ablations to inspect are: retrieve-only versus retrieve+generate, with and without human-CoT filtering, final-answer supervision versus full interleaved-CoT supervision, and sensitivity to the quality of the retrieval/generation tools. Those results determine whether the gains come from active perception itself or simply from richer long-form supervision.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with Figure 1 and Algorithm 1 to understand the data-construction loop: how the frontier VLM emits tool calls, how offline tools return frames, and how those frames are inserted back into the CoT. Then read the prompt template in Table 1 to see the action syntax the model is trained on. After that, jump to the experiments and focus on the main benchmark table, any breakdown by question type, and the retrieve/generate ablations.

About 20–30 minutes should be enough to judge the paper’s real value. Three points deserve attention: whether the quality filtering is strict enough to avoid distilling noisy frontier-model CoTs, whether generated frames truly help counterfactual reasoning rather than merely adding context, and whether this behavior can transfer to broader multimodal agent settings beyond video QA.

recommendation.zh: 值得看数据构造和动作接口设计；核心不是视频分数，而是 CoT 中插入视觉检索/生成动作这一训练信号。
recommendation.en: Read the data construction and action-interface design; the useful part is visual retrieval/generation inside CoT, not the video benchmark score.

paper.title: Decouple before Integration: Test-time Synthesis of SFT and RLVR Task Vectors
paper.abstract: SFT and RLVR represent two fundamental yet distinct paradigms for LLM post-training, each excelling in distinct dimensions. SFT expands knowledge breadth while RLVR enhances reasoning depth. Yet integrating these complementary strengths remains a formidable challenge. Sequential training can cause catastrophic forgetting, and joint optimization often suffers from severe gradient conflicts. We analyze SFT and RLVR through the lens of task vectors and reveal three structural properties behind thes

summary.core_problem: 如何把同一个 base model 上分别得到的 SFT（知识/覆盖面）与 RLVR（可验证奖励驱动的推理深度）能力可靠地融合，同时避免顺序训练的遗忘与联合训练的梯度冲突；并进一步追问：这些失败是“配方问题”，还是两类后训练在参数空间存在结构性不相容。
summary.importance: 对 post-train→pretrain 闭环的价值在于：用 task vector 的几何/统计证据把“为什么 SFT+RLVR 难共训”说清楚，并给出一个几乎不需要再训练的融合路径。它不直接改预训练目标，但对后训练阶段的稳定性、能力组合、以及“用参数空间操作替代昂贵训练”的思路有现实影响：把融合成本从数百 GPU 小时降到约 20 GPU 小时量级，并展示一定的跨任务系数可迁移性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两层：
1) 诊断：把 SFT 与 RLVR 都视为从 base checkpoint 出发的 task vector（Δθ）。全文的关键不是“能线性相加”，而是量化了三类导致失败的结构性因素：
- 量级失配：SFT 的 Δθ L2 norm 在各层约为 RLVR 的 30×，直接相加会被 SFT 主导，RLVR 的推理信号被淹没。
- 符号干扰：两向量在参数维度上约 44.91% 符号相反，意味着接近一半参数更新方向冲突，对应联合优化中的 persistent gradient conflict。
- 模块分布异质：SFT 的“重要更新”更集中在 LayerNorm（文中给出约 19.9% 的占比），RLVR 则更分散地作用于 attention / LayerNorm / LM head，暗示两者并非完全争夺同一子空间，也存在互补。
2) 处方（DoTS, Decoupled Test-time Synthesis）：不在训练时强行共存，而是分别独立训练出 SFT checkpoint 与 RLVR checkpoint，在推理时做参数空间合成：θ = θ0 + λ_sft * Δθ_sft' + λ_rlvr * Δθ_rlvr'。
- 关键操作是 selective sparsification：对 task vector 只保留按幅值排序的 top-k% 参数，其余置零；然后对保留部分做 rescale 以保持原向量范数，避免“稀疏后信号变弱”。这一步同时针对量级失配与符号干扰：通过丢弃大量小幅但可能冲突的维度，把 sign interference 从 44.91% 降到最低约 7.1%（取决于 k）。
- 系数搜索：用少量无标注 query，通过 Bayesian optimization 搜索两个标量系数 λ_sft 与 λ_rlvr，优化信号由一致性与困惑度（perplexity）等代理指标引导。重点在于：不更新模型参数，只调两个标量，计算成本显著低于再训练式融合。
summary.experiments:
论文报告的主结果集中在数学推理：AIME 2024/2025、AMC、MATH500、OlympiadBench 等。DoTS 在多项基准上达到或超过训练式融合方法，同时计算成本约为其 3%：系数搜索约 20 GPU 小时，对比训练式方案超过 600 GPU 小时。
在更强的后训练 checkpoint 上（文中点名 ExGRPO 与 ReLIFT），DoTS 达到平均 50.6 分，比强基线 LUFFY 高 1.4 分。
迁移性：在数学推理上学到的 λ 系数可直接迁移到 ARC-C、GPQA、MMLU-Pro 等 QA 基准，无需重新调参，作者据此主张它更像“能力融合模式”而非任务特化技巧。
诊断实验的关键数字包括：SFT vs RLVR task vector 范数约 30× 差异；原始符号冲突 44.91%；稀疏化后最低可到约 7.1%；模块重要更新分布中 SFT 在 LayerNorm 约 19.9%。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 task-vector 诊断部分：三条结构性结论各自对应哪些统计量与可视化（层级范数曲线、符号冲突比例、按模块的更新分布）。这里决定了 DoTS 的设计是否“对症”。
- 再看 selective sparsification 的定义：top-k 的选择、rescale 方式、以及它如何同时缓解量级失配与符号干扰；重点确认作者是否比较了“只缩放不稀疏”“只稀疏不保范数”等对照。
- 最后看系数搜索：Bayesian optimization 的目标函数由哪些代理指标组成、无标注 query 的规模、以及系数跨基准迁移的证据（这是全文最像“可复用技巧”的部分）。
如果只想拿走可复现结论：优先复现三条诊断统计 + 稀疏化前后符号干扰变化 + 20 GPU 小时的系数搜索流程。

summary_en.core_problem: How to reliably combine the complementary gains from SFT (knowledge breadth) and RLVR (verifiable-reward-driven reasoning depth) on the same base model, without catastrophic forgetting from sequential training or gradient conflicts from joint optimization—and whether the difficulty is rooted in a structural incompatibility in parameter space rather than just recipe tuning.
summary_en.importance: The paper’s main contribution is diagnostic clarity plus a low-cost fusion alternative: it quantifies why SFT+RLVR merging often fails using task-vector geometry/statistics, then proposes a test-time composition method that avoids additional training. While not a pretraining objective paper, it matters to the pretrain↔post-train loop by offering a practical way to compose capabilities with ~3% of the compute of training-based integration, and by framing SFT/RLVR interaction as a parameter-space interference problem.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two-stage design:
1) Task-vector analysis. Define task vectors as Δθ between a post-trained checkpoint and the base model. The paper reports three structural properties:
- Magnitude disparity: SFT task vectors have ~30× larger L2 norms than RLVR across layers, so naive linear merging is dominated by SFT.
- Sign interference: ~44.91% of parameters have opposite signs between the two vectors, explaining persistent gradient conflicts in joint training.
- Module-wise heterogeneity: SFT concentrates “important” updates in LayerNorm (reported ~19.9%), whereas RLVR spreads updates across attention, LayerNorm, and the LM head, suggesting partial complementarity.
2) DoTS (Decoupled Test-time Synthesis). Train SFT and RLVR separately, then synthesize at inference: θ = θ0 + λ_sft Δθ_sft' + λ_rlvr Δθ_rlvr'.
- Selective sparsification: keep only top-k% coordinates by magnitude in each task vector, zero the rest, then rescale to preserve the original norm. This is positioned as the key fix for both magnitude imbalance and sign conflicts, reducing sign interference from 44.91% down to as low as ~7.1%.
- Coefficient search: use Bayesian optimization over two scalars (λ_sft, λ_rlvr) on a small set of unlabeled queries, guided by proxy signals such as consistency and perplexity. No parameter updates; only scalar tuning.
summary_en.experiments:
Results are mainly on math reasoning benchmarks (AIME 2024/2025, AMC, MATH500, OlympiadBench): DoTS matches or exceeds training-based SFT–RLVR integration while using ~20 GPU-hours for coefficient search versus >600 GPU-hours for training-based alternatives (~3% compute).
On stronger post-trained checkpoints (named ExGRPO and ReLIFT), DoTS reports an average score of 50.6, beating the LUFFY baseline by 1.4 points.
Transfer: coefficients tuned on math reasoning reportedly transfer to QA benchmarks (ARC-C, GPQA, MMLU-Pro) without re-tuning.
Key diagnostic numbers: ~30× norm gap; 44.91% sign conflicts; down to ~7.1% after sparsification; SFT LayerNorm share ~19.9%.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Start with the task-vector diagnostics: verify how the three claims are measured (layerwise norms, sign-conflict ratios, module-wise importance distributions).
- Read the selective sparsification definition carefully (top-k criterion, norm-preserving rescale) and check ablations against simpler fixes (scaling-only, sparsify-without-rescale).
- Then inspect the Bayesian optimization setup: what proxy objective is optimized, how many unlabeled queries are used, and the evidence for cross-benchmark coefficient transfer.
If you want one reproducible takeaway: replicate the diagnostics + the sign-interference reduction curve vs k + the two-scalar tuning loop.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 task-vector 分析，不是合并技巧本身；若 30×/45% 在你模型上复现，应调整 SFT/RLVR 串联习惯。
recommendation.en: The task-vector analysis matters more than the merge trick; if the 30x and 45% effects reproduce on your stack, revisit SFT→RLVR sequencing.

paper.title: Diversity in Large Language Models under Supervised Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is essential for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with user intent, yet it is believed to suppress generative diversity. Although this reduction is frequently referenced, formal empirical testing of the phenomenon remains limited. The expressiveness of LLMs by itself was addressed by multiple prior methods. Their varying perspectives suggest that deeper analysis could yield further improvements. In this study, we attribute the decline to two primary drivers: the

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是一个常被提到但少有系统拆解的问题：SFT 为什么会让模型输出变窄，以及这种“变窄”到底来自哪里。作者把原因分成两部分。第一，标准 CE 在小而精的 instruction 数据上会优先拟合高频模式，长尾回答形式和低频表达被持续压低；第二，SFT 会覆盖预训练阶段已经学到的分布性知识，导致模型对同一 prompt 的可行回答空间收缩。论文的目标不是单纯提高某个多样性指标，而是在不明显伤害回答质量和对齐性的前提下，同时缓解“忽视低频模式”和“遗忘预训练知识”这两个来源。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于提出了一个通用新损失，而在于把 post-train 阶段的多样性退化问题明确地连回了 pretrain 表征保留。这个视角有两点价值。其一，它提醒人们：SFT 不是简单的监督适配，而是在重写预训练分布；如果损失设计不当，后续 RL、探索式推理、best-of-N 采样都会受限。其二，作者把“保留预训练知识”和“照顾长尾样本”放进同一个目标里，这比只做 label smoothing、只做 entropy regularization、或只做 sample reweighting 更接近真实训练中的矛盾。贡献量级偏中等，属于对 SFT 目标函数设计有启发的工作，不是预训练范式层面的变化，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口研究是相关的。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者先回顾并比较了几类面向多样性的 SFT 损失，包括标准 CE、强调分布保真的目标，以及带有显式正则的变体。论文的关键判断是：单独解决一个问题不够。若只强调 rare pattern，模型可能仍然遗忘预训练分布；若只强调保留原模型分布，又会继续让高频监督样本主导训练。基于这个判断，作者引入 TOFU（Tempered Focal）loss。

从名字和文中动机看，TOFU 是把 focal-style reweighting 与 tempered/distillation-like 保守更新结合起来。Focal 部分的作用是降低“已经很容易预测”的 token 对梯度的主导，让低概率、低频、难样本获得更高权重，从而缓解 instruction 数据内部的头部模式垄断。Tempered 部分则不是简单的 KL 蒸馏，而是通过温度化的参考分布约束，减弱对预训练模型原有分布的过度偏移，避免 SFT 把原本存在的多种合理 continuation 一并压掉。换句话说，TOFU 试图同时控制两种梯度：一类来自监督标签的尖锐拉动，另一类来自参考模型的分布保持。

这和已有方法的区别在于：
1. 相比纯 CE，TOFU 不把所有 token 误差等价处理，而是显式提升难样本和长尾模式的训练信号；
2. 相比单纯 focal loss，TOFU 不是只做 sample difficulty reweighting，而是额外加入对 base model 分布的保留；
3. 相比只做 KL/anchor regularization 的方法，它不是一味保守，而是允许在真正需要纠偏的 token 上保留足够更新幅度。

如果从训练动力学理解，这个损失是在做更细粒度的“更新预算分配”：把一部分预算从高频、低信息量 token 挪给长尾 token，同时用 tempered reference 抑制灾难性漂移。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可以确认，作者做了跨模型家族、跨数据集、跨 benchmark 的大规模评测，并且把现有 diversity-oriented SFT objectives 放在统一框架下比较，还单独评估了 focal loss 作为 SFT 目标的效果。实验结论是：TOFU 在生成多样性上优于标准 CE，同时回答质量保持竞争力；focal loss 本身已经能改善对低频模式的覆盖，但若没有 tempered 约束，仍不足以稳定保留预训练知识。

不过，当前提供的正文片段没有包含完整实验表、参数规模、训练 token 数、具体 benchmark 名称和精确数值，因此无法负责任地填写诸如“在某模型上提升 x%”这类细节。能较确定地提炼出的实验洞察有三点：
1. 多样性退化不是某个模型家族的偶发现象，而是标准 SFT 在多种设置下都能观察到的稳定趋势；
2. 只优化质量指标会掩盖分布收缩，必须联合看 diversity 与 quality；
3. rare-pattern reweighting 与 reference-preserving 结合后，效果优于各自单独使用。

如果需要精确数字，必须查看实验章节中的主表、ablation 表，以及 diversity metric 的定义与统计方式，否则容易误读结果。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读而不是逐式推导。建议优先看四部分。
1. Introduction：作者如何把多样性下降拆成 ignorance 与 forgetting 两个来源，这决定了后面损失设计是否站得住。
2. Theoretical preliminaries：重点看作者如何解释 CE、GEM、FL 等目标各自偏向什么训练行为，不必纠结所有公式细节，关键是理解梯度会把概率质量往哪里推。
3. TOFU 定义与 ablation：这里最值得看。要确认 tempered 项到底是对 base model logits、概率分布，还是某种温度化 target 做约束；也要看 focal 指数和温度参数如何影响质量-多样性的平衡。
4. 实验部分：重点看 diversity metric 是否可靠，是否区分 lexical diversity、semantic diversity、self-BLEU、distinct-n、或基于 judge/model 的多样性；再看质量是否通过 win-rate、helpfulness、或 task accuracy 控制住。

预计阅读时间 30–45 分钟。若只关心方法启发，看方法定义、主结果表和 ablation 即可。若关心 pretrain↔post-train 接口，值得额外看作者对 forgetting 的分析是否真的测到了“预训练知识保留”，还是只是输出熵变大。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a familiar but under-analyzed issue in supervised fine-tuning: why SFT tends to collapse generation diversity, and which mechanisms actually drive that collapse. The authors separate the problem into two sources. First, standard cross-entropy on small curated instruction datasets overfits dominant response patterns and under-trains the long tail. Second, SFT partially overwrites distributional knowledge acquired during pretraining, shrinking the set of plausible continuations the model is willing to assign mass to. The goal is not merely to increase a diversity metric, but to preserve response breadth without materially degrading answer quality or alignment.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining-oriented readers is mostly at the pretrain–post-train interface. The paper makes explicit that SFT is not a harmless adaptation step; it rewrites the pretrained distribution, and poor objective design can reduce exploration, best-of-N gains, and downstream RL headroom. A second useful point is that it treats long-tail coverage and pretrained-knowledge retention as a coupled optimization problem. That is more realistic than methods that only add entropy, only reweight samples, or only anchor to the base model. The contribution is moderate rather than foundational: it is not a new pretraining paradigm, but it is relevant for loss design in post-training when one cares about preserving pretrained expressivity.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper first reviews several diversity-oriented SFT objectives, including standard CE, distribution-preserving alternatives, and regularized variants. The central claim is that fixing only one side of the problem is insufficient. If one only emphasizes rare patterns, the model may still forget the pretrained distribution. If one only preserves the base model distribution, head patterns in the supervised data still dominate learning. This motivates TOFU, a Tempered Focal loss.

From the formulation and motivation described in the text, TOFU combines two ideas. The focal component downweights easy, already-high-probability targets so that hard tokens and low-frequency patterns receive stronger gradient signal. This addresses the tendency of instruction tuning to concentrate on a narrow set of dominant responses. The tempered component acts as a conservative update mechanism relative to the pretrained model, reducing excessive drift away from the base distribution and preserving alternative plausible continuations that are not explicitly present in the SFT data. In effect, TOFU tries to control two gradient sources at once: the sharp pull from one-hot supervision and the stabilizing pull from the reference model.

Relative to prior methods:
1. unlike plain CE, it does not treat all token errors equally and explicitly reallocates learning signal toward hard and tail events;
2. unlike plain focal loss, it is not only a difficulty-based reweighting scheme, because it also tries to retain pretrained knowledge;
3. unlike pure KL anchoring or distillation-style regularization, it is not uniformly conservative and still allows substantial updates where the supervised signal is genuinely corrective.

From a training-dynamics perspective, the method can be read as a more selective budget allocation rule: spend less update budget on high-frequency, low-information tokens, spend more on tail tokens, and use a tempered reference to avoid catastrophic distributional drift.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper rather than a line-by-line theory read. Four parts matter most.
1. Introduction: check whether the decomposition into ignorance and forgetting is argued carefully enough to justify the loss design.
2. Theoretical preliminaries: focus on how the paper interprets CE, GEM, FL, and related objectives in terms of probability-mass movement and gradient behavior. The exact derivations are less important than the training intuition.
3. TOFU definition and ablations: this is the key section. Verify what exactly is tempered: logits, probabilities, or a temperature-adjusted target distribution. Also inspect how the focal exponent and temperature trade off quality against diversity.
4. Experiments: pay close attention to the diversity metrics. Distinct-n, self-BLEU, semantic diversity, and judge-based diversity can tell different stories. Also check whether answer quality is controlled via win rate, helpfulness, or task accuracy.

Estimated reading time is 30–45 minutes. If the main interest is method intuition, read the loss definition, the main tables, and the ablations. If the interest is the pretrain–post-train interface, examine whether the forgetting analysis truly measures retention of pretrained knowledge or merely higher output entropy.

recommendation.zh: 可参考TOFU损失的设计思路优化预训练到SFT的能力保留，重点读§3的成因分析即可
recommendation.en: Refer to TOFU loss design for optimizing capability retention from pretraining to SFT, only read §3 for causal analysis

paper.title: Shorthand for Thought: Compressing LLM Reasoning via Entropy-Guided Supertokens
paper.abstract: Reasoning in Large Language Models incurs significant inference-time compute, yet the token-level information structure of reasoning traces remains underexplored. We observe that reasoning tokens split into two functional types: low-entropy \textit{structural} tokens (recurring phrases that scaffold the reasoning process) and higher-entropy \textit{organic} tokens (problem-specific content that drives toward a solution). This asymmetry motivates a simple, model-agnostic compression pipeline: app

summary.core_problem: CoT 推理的 token 很长，推理成本高。现有压缩多从“减少推理内容”（蒸馏、latent reasoning）入手，但很少分析推理文本内部的信息结构。论文要解决的是：能否在不删推理步骤、保持可读 CoT 的前提下，仅通过改变 tokenization，把推理里大量低信息密度的“结构性套话”压缩成更少 token，从而降低推理时的 token 数与计算。
summary.importance:
对基座研究的启发点主要在 tokenizer/数据效率接口：
- 证明了 CoT 里存在稳定的低熵片段（结构性 reasoning tokens），它们更像“控制流标记”而不是内容；这为“任务/域自适应 tokenizer”提供了一个可操作的目标函数（用模型自身的条件熵来找可合并片段）。
- 方法是后训练（SFT）驱动的词表扩展，但思路可反哺预训练：在 mid-train/cooldown 阶段引入 reasoning-aware merges，或在多域 tokenizer 里显式给结构性短语留容量。
整体贡献量级偏工程与分析：压缩幅度中等（~8%），但胜在简单、可解释、模型无关。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三步：
1) 采样推理轨迹：用目标模型在 OpenThoughts3 提示上生成 CoT traces，得到“模型自己会写的推理语言”。
2) 熵驱动的结构/有机划分：用信息论视角看每个位置的条件熵 H_θ(t_i|t_<i)。作者观察到大量 token 落在“多 token 固定短语”里，一旦短语开头出现，后续 token 近乎确定（低熵）。把这类模式称为 structural tokens；与之相对的是携带题目特定信息的 organic tokens（变量、算式、中间结论等，高熵）。并给出一个压缩上限的推导：若合并跨度内平均熵 h_M 远小于 log|V|，则理论压缩率近似等于参与合并的 token 比例 ρ。
3) 生成并学习 supertokens：在推理 traces 上做 cross-word BPE merges（用 SuperBPE），把高频 n-gram 合并成“推理 supertokens”，追加到原词表。为避免少数高重复样本主导 merge，做了 per-sample 计数上限（每样本最多计 10 次）。随后用 SFT 教模型使用这些新 token；训练时只更新 embedding、LM head 和少量 transformer 层，降低对原模型能力的扰动。

关键取舍：它压缩的是“表达形式”（结构短语的 tokenization），不压缩“推理内容”；因此可读性保留，且 supertokens 本身可作为可解释的推理结构标记。
summary.experiments:
作者报告在三类模型、五个数学推理基准上平均缩短推理轨迹 8.1%，准确率变化在 95% 置信区间内不显著（基本持平）。
从全文片段可确认的实验设计要点包括：
- supertokens 是“按模型家族定制”的：每个模型用自己的 traces 学自己的 merges。
- 熵分析以 QwQ-32B 为代表模型展开，跨模型泛化在附录（Appendix H）。
- 统计显著性用置信区间而非单点差值（Appendix J）。
但在给定片段中未看到各基准逐项数字、词表新增规模（新增 token 数）、SFT 预算（步数/样本量/更新层数具体配置）等，精读时需要回到实验章节与附录表格核对。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先读 Information-Theoretic Motivation：看他们如何用条件熵把“结构短语可压缩”说清楚，以及压缩上限 Δ≈ρ 的推导假设。
- 再读 supertoken 学习细节：cross-word BPE 的候选过滤、计数上限、以及新 token 的初始化与只更新少量层的训练策略。
- 最后看实验与附录：重点核对新增词表大小 vs 压缩率的关系、不同模型/基准是否一致、以及是否出现“压缩后更容易跑偏/更难自检”的失败案例。
如果你关心预训练反哺：额外建议思考把这些 structural supertokens 作为显式控制符，是否能在预训练阶段形成更稳定的推理规划表征。

summary_en.core_problem: Chain-of-thought reasoning is expensive largely because it emits long token sequences. Prior compression often removes or distills reasoning content (latent reasoning, step pruning), but the internal information structure of reasoning text is less studied. This paper targets a narrower question: without deleting any reasoning steps and while keeping CoT fully readable, can we reduce inference tokens by changing tokenization so that repetitive low-information “structural” phrases are emitted as single supertokens?
summary_en.importance:
The main value for foundation-model researchers is at the tokenizer / data-efficiency boundary:
- It operationalizes a hypothesis that CoT contains a large fraction of low-entropy, formulaic control-flow language, which is costly to generate token-by-token but carries little information.
- The approach is post-training (vocab extension + SFT), yet it suggests a pretraining feedback loop: reasoning-aware merges during mid-train/cooldown, or allocating vocab capacity to structural reasoning markers in multi-domain tokenizers.
The reported compression is moderate (~8%), but the method is simple, model-agnostic, and interpretable.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Pipeline:
1) Collect model-native CoT traces by sampling reasoning outputs from the target model on OpenThoughts3 prompts.
2) Entropy-based framing: compute per-token conditional entropy H_θ(t_i|t_<i). The paper argues reasoning tokens split into (a) structural tokens—recurring multi-token phrases whose continuation becomes near-deterministic once started (low entropy), and (b) organic tokens—problem-specific content (math expressions, bindings, intermediate results) with higher entropy. They derive a compression ceiling showing that if the mean entropy inside merge spans is much smaller than log|V|, the achievable compression is approximately the fraction of tokens covered by merges.
3) Learn “reasoning supertokens” via cross-word BPE (SuperBPE) on the reasoning traces only, append them to the base vocabulary, and teach the model to use them via SFT. To limit distribution skew, n-gram counts are capped per sample. Training updates embeddings, LM head, and only a small subset of transformer layers to minimize disruption.

Design choice: compress the surface form (tokenization of structural phrases) rather than the reasoning content, preserving full readability; supertokens also act as explicit, human-readable markers of reasoning moves.
summary_en.experiments:
They report an average 8.1% reduction in reasoning-trace length across three model families and five math reasoning benchmarks, with accuracy changes statistically indistinguishable from zero at 95% confidence.
From the visible text: entropy analysis is centered on QwQ-32B; cross-model generality is discussed in an appendix; significance is handled via confidence intervals. However, the excerpt does not include per-benchmark numbers, the number of added tokens, or detailed SFT budgets—those need to be verified in the main experiments section and appendices.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim in 30–45 minutes:
- Read the information-theoretic section to see how conditional entropy motivates why structural phrases are the right compression target and what assumptions the ceiling relies on.
- Read the supertoken construction details (cross-word BPE, count capping, token initialization, which layers are updated).
- Check experiments/appendices for the trade-off curve: added vocab size vs. compression, consistency across models/benchmarks, and any failure modes (e.g., degraded self-checking or altered reasoning style).
If you care about pretraining implications, consider whether these structural supertokens could be treated as explicit control tokens during pretraining to stabilize planning-like representations.

recommendation.zh: 思路不大，但切口干净：把CoT里低熵模板显式token化再SFT，值得看方法和误差条；若你做latent reasoning或reasoning compression，可直接复现。
recommendation.en: The idea is modest but clean: explicitly tokenize low-entropy CoT scaffolding and SFT the model to use it; worth reading for the method and error bars, and easy to reproduce if you work on latent reasoning or reasoning compression.

paper.title: Compute Aligned Training: Optimizing for Test Time Inference
paper.abstract: Scaling test-time compute has emerged as a powerful mechanism for enhancing Large Language Model (LLM) performance. However, standard post-training paradigms, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL), optimize the likelihood of individual samples under a base policy, creating a misalignment with test time procedures that rely on aggregated or filtered outputs. In this work, we propose Compute Aligned Training, which aligns training objectives with test-time strategies. By con

summary.core_problem: 标准预训练和后训练（SFT/RL）目标优化的是单个样本的似然，这与测试时依赖聚合或过滤输出（如 Pass@N、多数投票、Best-of-N）的推理策略不一致，导致模型在测试时扩展计算（test-time scaling）时表现次优。
summary.importance: 提出了一种统一的理论框架，将测试时策略视为对基础策略的算子，从而推导出与推理策略对齐的新损失函数。这为解决训练目标与测试时策略不匹配的普遍问题提供了一种计算高效的精确梯度缩放机制，对提升模型在复杂推理任务中的表现具有启发意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出计算对齐训练（Compute Aligned Training, CAT）。核心思想是将推理策略概念化为算子 $\mathcal{T}$，它将基础策略 $\pi_{\theta}$ 转换为有效的测试时分布 $\tilde{\pi}_{\theta}$。通过对这个转换后的分布执行梯度下降来最小化损失，从而使模型训练与其部署环境对齐。无论是 SFT 还是 RL，CAT 都会根据样本对聚合结果的“边际效用”重新加权梯度，且不增加额外开销。该框架统一并推广了先前的 Direct Coverage Optimization (DCO) 方法。
summary.experiments: 论文在 SFT 和 RL 范式下，针对 Pass@N、多数投票等常见测试时策略实例化了 CAT 损失函数。实证结果表明，CAT 广泛提高了测试时扩展的性能，不仅适用于 LLM，还成功扩展到了蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Method 部分关于如何将推理策略形式化为算子的理论推导，以及 CAT 如何在 SFT 和 RL 中具体实例化的细节。关注实验部分中 CAT 在不同测试时策略下的性能提升幅度，特别是与标准训练方法的对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard pre-training and post-training (SFT/RL) objectives optimize the likelihood of individual samples, which is misaligned with test-time inference strategies that rely on aggregated or filtered outputs (e.g., Pass@N, Majority Vote, Best-of-N), leading to suboptimal performance during test-time compute scaling.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a unified theoretical framework that conceptualizes test-time strategies as operators on the base policy, deriving new loss functions aligned with inference strategies. This provides a computationally efficient, exact gradient scaling mechanism to address the pervasive mismatch between training objectives and test-time strategies, offering insights for improving model performance on complex reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Compute Aligned Training (CAT). The core idea is to conceptualize inference strategies as operators $\mathcal{T}$ that transform the base policy $\pi_{\theta}$ into an effective test-time distribution $\tilde{\pi}_{\theta}$. By performing gradient descent to minimize the loss with respect to this transformed distribution, model training is aligned with its deployment environment. For both SFT and RL, CAT re-weights gradients based on the 'marginal utility' of a sample to the aggregate outcome without additional overhead. This framework unifies and generalizes the prior Direct Coverage Optimization (DCO) method.
summary_en.experiments: The paper instantiates CAT loss functions for common test-time strategies like Pass@N and Majority Vote under both SFT and RL paradigms. Empirical evidence shows that CAT broadly improves performance under test-time scaling, extending successfully not only to LLMs but also to Protein Language Models (PLMs).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Method section for the theoretical derivation of formalizing inference strategies as operators, and the specific instantiations of CAT in SFT and RL. Pay attention to the performance gains of CAT under different test-time strategies in the experiments, especially the comparison with standard training methods.

recommendation.zh: 训练与测试对齐的思路可复用至预训练目标设计，重点看§3损失函数推导部分即可。
recommendation.en: The training-test alignment idea can be reused for pretraining objective design, focus on §3 loss derivation.

paper.title: Preserving Long-Tailed Expert Information in Mixture-of-Experts Tuning
paper.abstract: Despite MoE models leading many benchmarks, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for the MoE architectures remains difficult because its router layers are fragile. Methods such as DenseMixer and ESFT mitigate router collapse with dense mixing or auxiliary load-balancing losses, but these introduce noisy gradients that often degrade performance. In preliminary experiments, we systematically pruned experts and observed that while certain super experts are activated far more frequently, discarding less use

summary.core_problem: MoE模型在监督微调阶段易出现路由崩溃，现有优化方法引入的辅助损失或直通估计器会带来梯度噪声，且仅保留高频激活的超级专家会导致性能明显下降，长尾稀疏专家的知识难以在微调中有效保留。
summary.importance: 验证了长尾稀疏专家的不可替代性，为MoE模型的后训练优化提供了新的设计思路，对MoE微调、压缩策略的开发有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出无辅助损失的ExpertCondenser微调框架，结合偏置驱动的稀疏路由和始终激活的门控凝专家（condenser expert），构建输入自适应的持久计算路径，将分散在长尾专家中的知识整合到凝专家中，缓解梯度饥饿问题，缩小训练与推理阶段的路由差异。
summary.experiments: 在GPT-OSS和DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite上的剪枝实验显示，仅保留Top75%的激活频率最高的专家时，模型性能下降超过10%，证明长尾专家的不可替代性；在常识推理、数学推理等基准上，该方法比现有MoE SFT方法平均高4个百分点以上。代码已开源。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第2节的专家剪枝实验结果，理解长尾专家的实际价值；第3节的方法概述部分了解凝专家的核心设计思路，无需精读理论推导，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: MoE models are prone to routing collapse during supervised fine-tuning. Existing optimization methods introduce auxiliary losses or straight-through estimators that bring gradient noise, and only retaining high-frequency activated super experts leads to significant performance degradation, making it difficult to preserve knowledge from long-tail sparse experts during fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: It verifies the irreplaceability of long-tail sparse experts, provides a new design idea for post-training optimization of MoE models, and offers reference for the development of MoE fine-tuning and compression strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: An auxiliary-loss-free fine-tuning framework named ExpertCondenser is proposed, which combines bias-driven sparse routing and always-active gated condenser experts to construct an input-adaptive persistent computing path, consolidates knowledge scattered in long-tail experts into condenser experts, alleviates gradient starvation, and narrows the routing gap between training and inference stages.
summary_en.experiments: Pruning experiments on GPT-OSS and DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite show that model performance drops by more than 10% when only retaining the top 75% most frequently activated experts, proving the irreplaceability of long-tail experts. On benchmarks including commonsense reasoning and mathematical reasoning, this method outperforms existing MoE SFT methods by more than 4 percentage points on average. The code is open-sourced.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the expert pruning experiment results in Section 2 to understand the practical value of long-tail experts. Read the method overview in Section 3 to learn the core design idea of condenser experts, no need to read the theoretical derivation intensively, estimated reading time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式级 MoE 论文，但 pruning 观察很值得看：若低频专家真有信息量，你们现有的 router 正则和 SFT recipe 可能一直在悄悄抹掉长尾能力；先读 pruning 和 ablation 部分。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm-shifting MoE paper, but the pruning result is worth your time: if low-usage experts really carry signal, your current router regularization and SFT recipe may be quietly erasing long-tail capability; read the pruning and ablation sections first.

paper.title: Parallel-SFT: Improving Zero-Shot Cross-Programming-Language Transfer for Code RL
paper.abstract: Modern language models demonstrate impressive coding capabilities in common programming languages (PLs), such as C++ and Python, but their performance in lower-resource PLs is often limited by training data availability. In principle, however, most programming skills are universal across PLs, so the capability acquired in one PL should transfer to others. In this work, we propose the task of zero-shot cross-programming-language transfer for code RL. We find that, for Llama-3.1, RL training for c

summary.core_problem: 在代码 RL 后训练里，模型在源编程语言（如 Python/C++）上通过 RL 获得的提升，为什么很难零样本迁移到目标编程语言（低资源 PL），甚至会退化？论文把问题定位为：RL 阶段学到的改进过度贴合源语言表面形式，缺少跨语言可复用的“语义对齐”初始化。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对“pretrain↔posttrain 接口”有现实启发：RL 的泛化上限很大程度由 SFT 初始化决定；如果初始化没有把不同 PL 的表示空间对齐，RL 可能把策略推向更语言特化的局部最优，导致跨 PL 迁移失败。对做持续训练/中期训练（mid-train）的人来说，这也提示：在进入高信号但高偏置的优化阶段（RL）前，先用结构化数据把表示空间“校准”，往往比在 RL 里硬指望泛化更稳。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Parallel-SFT：在 SFT 数据混合中加入“并行程序”——跨编程语言功能等价（execution-equivalent）的合成程序对/组。目标不是增加多语言覆盖的表面样本量，而是用语义等价约束把不同 PL 的表示拉近。
实验设置是：先做 SFT（对比单源 PL、普通多 PL、Parallel-SFT），再在源 PL 上做 RL（如 GRPO 一类可验证 RL），最后零样本评测到目标 PL。并做表示分析：Parallel-SFT 使并行程序在表示空间更相似，且能泛化到未见 PL。
summary.experiments:
关键结论：
- 直接在源 PL 上做 RL，源内提升稳定，但跨 PL 迁移弱，甚至负迁移。
- 加入 Parallel-SFT 后，跨 PL 的 RL 迁移显著改善；在部分设置下，甚至超过“直接用目标 PL 训练”的 oracle 方案（论文强调这一点来说明并行语义约束的效率）。
- 覆盖两个任务：代码生成（pass@k）与代码验证（布尔准确率），并用并行程序表示相似度分析支持其机制假设。
（具体提升幅度与训练细节需要以正文表格为准；你给的全文片段未包含数值表。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：30-45 分钟。
- 先看 Introduction 里对“RL 迁移失败”的实证现象与任务定义（zero-shot cross-PL transfer）。
- 再看方法图（Parallel-SFT 的数据构造与混合方式）以及实验主表（不同 SFT 初始化 + 源 PL RL + 目标 PL 评测）。
- 最后快速看表示分析部分，确认它不是只报结果，而是给出“并行语义对齐→表示更近→RL 改进可迁移”的证据链。

summary_en.core_problem: In code RL post-training, improvements learned via RL in a source programming language often fail to transfer zero-shot to other target languages, and can even hurt them. The paper frames this as an initialization problem: RL updates are highly sensitive to surface-form regularities of the source PL unless the SFT stage already induces language-agnostic, semantically grounded representations.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain↔posttrain interface. It provides evidence that cross-domain generalization during RL is bottlenecked by the representation alignment achieved during SFT. Without such alignment, RL can push the policy toward source-language-specific optima, producing negative transfer. For practitioners designing mid-training or continual training pipelines, the takeaway is pragmatic: do structured alignment before high-signal RL, rather than expecting RL to discover transferable structure on its own.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Parallel-SFT, augments the SFT mixture with synthetically generated parallel programs: execution-equivalent implementations across multiple programming languages. The goal is not merely multi-PL exposure, but semantic grounding via equivalence constraints.
The evaluation protocol is: (i) SFT with different strategies (single-source, standard multi-PL, Parallel-SFT), (ii) RL in a source PL using verifiable rewards (e.g., GRPO-style), and (iii) zero-shot evaluation on target PLs. The paper also includes representation analyses showing higher embedding similarity for parallel programs, including in unseen PLs.
summary_en.experiments:
Main findings:
- Source-PL RL reliably improves in-language performance but transfers poorly across PLs, sometimes causing negative transfer.
- Parallel-SFT substantially improves cross-PL RL transfer; in some settings it even outperforms an “oracle” baseline that trains directly on the target PL, suggesting better data efficiency from semantic alignment.
- Results are reported on two tasks: code generation (pass@k) and code validation (binary accuracy), plus representation-similarity analyses supporting the alignment hypothesis.
(Exact numbers and training details should be taken from the paper’s tables; they are not present in the provided excerpt.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim in ~30–45 minutes.
- Read the task definition and the empirical failure mode of RL transfer in the Introduction.
- Inspect the Parallel-SFT data construction/mixing figure and the main result tables comparing SFT initializations under the same RL setup.
- Briefly check the representation analysis section to see the evidence chain from parallel equivalence to improved transfer, rather than treating it as a pure empirical recipe.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的不是“代码跨语言”本身，而是它把一个常见脏现象说清了：RL 不会自动抽象出共享技能，初始化表示没对齐时还会负迁移；先看 Parallel-SFT 的数据构造和 ablation。
recommendation.en: The real value is not code transfer per se, but the clean demonstration that RL does not magically discover shared skills; with a misaligned SFT initialization it can induce negative transfer—read the Parallel-SFT data construction and ablations.
